jobs.title: Associate Product Manager Intern
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

 This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027.

 As an Associate Product Manager (APM) Intern, you'll spend 12 weeks partnering with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to build products that bring the world onchain. Coinbase's product managers play a pivotal role in shaping the future of cryptocurrency and creating an open financial system, and you'll experience that firsthand. You'll own a meaningful product area, ship real features used by millions of customers, and develop the strategic thinking that defines great product managers.

 Product Group Teams (internship location = San Francisco): 

• Consumer - Shape the fastest way to access crypto through the Coinbase retail app, advanced trade, dApps, and staking, paving the way for the future onchain.

• Developer - Drive the roadmap for simple, secure APIs and SDKs that bring a million builders onchain across payments, trading, wallets, and stablecoins.

• Institutional - Lead product initiatives enabling thousands of large financial institutions to securely custody digital assets, stake, and participate in the crypto economy.

• Platform - Own product strategy for the scalable, compliant foundational systems (Identity, FinHub, Payments) that underpin all Coinbase products and leverage machine learning to drive intelligent automation.

 Core Teams (internship location = New York City): 

• Enterprise Applications and Architecture (EAA) - Drive the roadmap for internal platforms that enhance customer support, HR tools, and compliance through automation and customer-first engineering.

 What you'll do: 

• Own the definition of product requirements and drive execution of a product launch alongside engineering, design, and data partners.

• Build a forward-looking product strategy for your assigned area using user research, market data, and competitive analysis.

• Lead user research and feedback loops to maintain a customer-centric approach and guide product decisions with measurable data.

• Set success metrics for your launches and analyze results at each stage to inform iteration and future roadmap priorities.

• Develop deep expertise in Coinbase's competitive position across the onchain ecosystem, including DeFi, NFTs, Layer 2 blockchains, and trading infrastructure.

 Required Skills and Experience: 

• Prior internship or project experience in software product management, product design, or a technical cross-functional role where you shipped a product or feature.

• Demonstrated experience with cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, or crypto-powered products through coursework, personal projects, prior internships, or active participation in the ecosystem.

• Quantitative aptitude demonstrated through coursework, projects, or prior roles requiring data analysis, A/B testing, or metrics-driven decision-making.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager VC Firm
jobs.description:
We are a VC firm located in the Transamerica Pyramid with over $400 million in assets under management. We have an opening for a Manager position in our Finance Team . 
 The Accounting Manager is responsible for fund accounting and reporting for five funds and related entities. The person is also responsible for the management company accounts and transactions. 
 Responsibilities include: 
 - Prepare quarterly and annual financial reporting packages for five fund entities. This includes updating portfolio investment schedules, portfolio company summaries, and preparing capital account statements. 
 - Prepare quarterly portfolio company valuations via public market comparables analysis, 409A review, and liquidation waterfalls. 
 - Forecast weekly cash flows at fund level 
 - Assist in the preparation of and process capital calls and distributions. 
 - Manage the annual audit for all funds. Prepare all schedules for the audit. 
 - Work with general partners and portfolio company management to fund investments. Manage receipt of capitalization tables and financing documents from portfolio companies. 
 - Manage investor inquiries and information requests, including audit confirmations. 
 - Maintain fund and management company general ledgers including, but not limited to recording of expenses and journal entries in Quickbooks. 
 - Assist with preparation of external presentations for fundraising and the annual investor meeting. Manage fundraising ShareFile data room. 
 - Manage all A/P and oversee the administrative team on Expensify and expense reports. 
 - Prepare pro-forma financial statements and projected financial statements for the funds, including IRR calculations. 
 - Perform special projects for the Managing Partners. 

 Ideal Qualifications 
 2 to 3+ years of experience in venture capital or private equity 

 Self-motivated and able to prioritize and juggle multiple tasks and projects
 Strong organizational skills
 Proficient in all Microsoft Office applications
 Bachelor degree in Accounting or similar major 
 CPA a plus 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

 Rembrandt Venture Partners (RVP) was established in 2004 to provide private equity capital to early stage technology companies. We focus our investments on a variety of sectors including internet infrastructure, application software delivered as a service, communications, mobile products and services, and new media convergence.
 At RVP, we're entrepreneurs first and foremost. Our Partners are proven investors and entrepreneurs who can effectively capitalize on various technology opportunities. We view our role as full partners with our entrepreneurs and management teams to empower them to succeed.
 Our sole concentration is to help early-stage entrepreneurs build great companies and change the way we live and work. RVP embraces a collaborative, team-oriented investment culture and puts the full weight of our partnership behind every entrepreneur. We are focused on being the firm of choice for providing capital, support, and expertise to the best entrepreneurs in Silicon Valley.

This in-semester fellowship is for students currently enrolled in an MBA program interested in gaining hands-on experience in venture capital. This fellowship is virtual and will run from October 27, 2026 to April 30, 2027. jobs.title: VC Fellow, Fall 2026
jobs.description:
2048 Ventures is a thesis-driven, early-stage venture capital firm leading pre-seed and seed rounds in Vertical AI, Deep Tech, Health, and Bio. We are based in Boston and NYC, and partner with visionary founders at the earliest moments in their journeys.
 Introducing 2048 Ventures VC Fellows Fall '26
 Some of our best companies and partnerships first emerged on campus, inside labs, and within student founder communities. We're excited to launch the 2048 Ventures VC Fellowship Fall '26, a program for the next generation of investors and builders.
 We're all in on Boston. We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional people. We're looking for Fellows who naturally gravitate toward ambitious builders.
 Who We’re Looking For
 We’re building a small, highly curated cohort of Fellows across Boston. You should consider this program if:
 • You are a full-time student at a university in Boston and expect to graduate in 2028 or later.
• Undergraduate students in their sophomore or junior year
• MBA and master's students in their first year
• PhD students in their second or third years
• You have a passion for startups and venture capital.
• You're resourceful, love meeting ambitious people, and naturally build relationships across campus.
• You have a strong network within your campus startup ecosystem.
• You meet founders regularly, love learning about their businesses, and love helping them.
• You’re naturally curious about emerging trends in AI, Deep Tech, Health, or Bio.
 What You’ll Do
 • Identify and source exceptional talent across your campus. You’ll act as our eyes and ears on campus.
• Present and discuss startups you find with other Fellows and the 2048 Ventures team.
• Embed yourself in the campus startup ecosystem. Meet founders early: in dorm rooms, labs, hackathons, accelerators, and coffee chats.
• Build relationships and new networks.
 What You’ll Get
 • Real exposure to venture capital and a front-row seat to pre-seed investing.
• Direct access to the 2048 Ventures investment team.
• Learning sessions, workshops, and AMA sessions with our network.
• Pathway into venture: references, introductions, and ongoing support.
• Swag and access to community events in Boston.
 How to Apply
 To apply, visit 2048.vc/fellowship-apply. Applications close on September 18.
 • A startup you recently saw on campus and why you’re excited about them.
• A glimpse into your network.
• A short 2–5 minute video introducing yourself, why you're excited about the fellowship, and an example of how you hustled.

jobs.title: VC Fellowship (AI)
jobs.description:
About the Fellowship
 Join 1752vc's Venture Capital Fellowship and gain hands-on experience sourcing, evaluating, and supporting investments in early-stage startups across AI, Enterprise Software, Fintech, Frontier Technology, Healthcare, and PropTech.
 This fellowship provides direct exposure to how venture capital funds operate while contributing to live deal flow, investment diligence, and portfolio support. 1752vc invests up to $100,000 per company through a structured three-month program focused on identifying and supporting exceptional founders.
 What You'll Do
 As a Venture Capital Fellow, you will:
 • Source and evaluate venture-backed startup opportunities
• Learn how to do market research and investment diligence
• Develop founder outreach and relationship skills
• Analyze companies, markets, and emerging technology trends
• Contribute to investment discussions and deal evaluation
• Learn venture capital frameworks used in real-world investing
 Who This Fellowship Is For 
 This program is designed for:
 • Professionals seeking to build or advance a career in venture capital or private equity
• Startup operators interested in transitioning into investing
• Emerging fund managers establishing or scaling their first funds
• Angels and family offices seeking to strengthen their investment processes
• Individuals interested in joining or launching venture funds, accelerators, or startup studios
• Founders who want to learn how to position themselves to investors
 What You'll Gain
 • Hands-on venture capital experience
• Exposure to live investment opportunities and diligence processes
• Direct interaction with investors
• Practical training in sourcing, evaluation, and investment decision-making
• Access to a growing network within the startup ecosystem
 Location
 The program operates remotely, with select optional in-person opportunities in Los Angeles and other ecosystem events when available.
 Compensation
 This is not a traditional salaried role. Compensation is performance-based and tied to contributions and outcomes, with opportunities for participants to share in the fund's upside.
 Equal Opportunity 
 1752vc is committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion across all programs.

jobs.title: Portfolio Management Internship
jobs.description:
Wavemaker is Southeast Asia's leading VC firm investing in Enterprise, Deep Tech, and

 Sustainability startups. Since 2012, we have backed over 200 companies across multiple funds, guided by our thesis:

 • ﻿We invest in trustworthy & curious founders who have built conviction through experience and industry insights, and identified large opportunities because they see the world diﬀerently.
• We invest in scalable, capital-eﬃcient, defensible businesses that solve meaningful problems 10x better than existing options.
 
 With a large portfolio of early-stage companies, we are building our Portfolio Management team to put our founders at the center of our universe and ensure our startups are optimally supported in their early-stage journey as they build their business

 How you make an impact 

 You play an important role in supporting the database management requirements and data needs of Wavemaker internal teams, while getting a front-row seat to how a VC firm operates – from portfolio tracking to how investment teams use data to make decisions.

 • You will diligently support the Portfolio Management Team in auditing our core relational databases across portfolio companies, entities, and ecosystem contacts – mapping where data points are sourced, surfacing redundancies, and coordinating with other teams to establish the process, platform, and timing behind their data.
• You will help build end-to-end systems for internal teams and external partners, from populating and structuring Airtable bases to designing user interfaces, setting up automations, and preparing databases for AI-powered use.
• You will also help clean, organize, and enrich existing CRM data so it can be used reliably downstream.
• You are numerically strong and have a knack for numbers.
• You're comfortable working with large data sets and drawing insights from analysis of data.
• You are curious about new tools and pick them up quickly.
• You consistently work in a meticulous manner and with a high degree of attention to detail.
 
 What we look for 

 You put people first!

 Motivation 

 You love early-stage tech startups, innovation and venture capital. You want to make a move to immerse yourself into this world.

 Background 

 • You're currently studying towards a Bachelor's or Master's degree. We're open to diﬀerent fields of study!
• You have had at least 1-2 other internships
 
 Skillset 

 • ﻿﻿ You are highly process-oriented and methodical in your approach.
• You can switch easily between working meticulously with a high degree of attention to detail, and looking at the big picture and thinking strategically while being laser-focused on your task at hand, you have no problems juggling multiple balls at the same time.
• You are thoughtful, possessing strong analytical skills and critical thinking skills.
• You are extremely service-oriented and have the ability to build trust and forge long-term relationships with people of all backgrounds
• You are articulate and eloquent both in written and verbal communication
 
 Mindset 

 • You are intellectually curious and have an unquenchable thirst for knowledge.
• You're not afraid to say, "I don't know", but you pick things up quickly and roll up your sleeves.
• While remaining flexible and adaptable, you are able to uphold your integrity and conduct yourself in an ethical manner.
• You are a self-starter with tons of initiative. You don't need to wait around for instructions and you proactively propose solutions.
• You are independent and self-managed, with a bias for continuous contribution to the team.
 
 Why work with us? 

 We put people first!

 Founders 

 We know how much you admire entrepreneurs - their innovation, their grit, and their courage. So do we! Our motivations are aligned to invest in and support these entrepreneurs who have the courage to solve meaningful problems.

 Community 

 We build and nurture a trusted community of successful and inspiring entrepreneurs, advisors and industry experts, visionary and progressive investors, and supportive vendor partners.

 You 

 This opportunity will immerse you deep into the world of startups, innovation and venture capital! You will gain valuable experience and skills in the investment process as well as value creation for startups to help them scale.

 We view wellbeing holistically so for us, it includes physical and mental wellbeing, environmental and social wellbeing, and intellectual and spiritual wellbeing. We run initiatives that ensure all aspects of wellbeing are considered.

jobs.title: Associate, Venture Creation (Fintech)
jobs.description:
Job Location: Toronto, ON or Montreal, QC
 Who we are :
 Diagram is a venture builder and early-stage investor that conceives, launches, and invests in transformative companies in the Fintech and ClimateTech sectors. Since 2016, we’ve raised over $480M and launched or invested in around 50 companies.
 We work hand-in-hand with experienced founders, combining access to capital, hands-on support, and a deep ecosystem of partners to launch and scale businesses. Our ecosystem includes 200+ investors, including 60+ entrepreneurs with exits exceeding $15B, as well as a global network of corporate partners.
 Diagram is part of Sagard, a global multi-strategy alternative investment platform with over US$46B in AUM
 What we are looking for :
 We are looking for an Associate, Venture Creation to help launch new Diagram ventures, reporting to Diagram’s Fintech Venture Creation Principal.
 The successful candidate will bring a highly entrepreneurial mindset and strong desire to build the next generation of technology companies.
 This person will work directly with Diagram Partners, potential founders and expert advisors to lead the development, evaluation, de-risking and building of new Fintech/Insuretech ventures. The Associate will play a key role in turning ideas into companies, and shaping Diagram’s portfolio.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 • Identifying opportunities for new ventures to build and developing in-depth theses and perspectives on opportunity areas;
• Conducting user and market research, assessing business models and unit economics, assessing moat/defensibility to evaluate potential ideas;
• Generating and pitching new venture ideas, including developing pitch decks and investment memos
• Building prototype leveraging AI tools, leading build of MVP in collaboration with engineering, AI experts and other technical expert;
• Owning the work plan and leading the venture during pre-seed (E.g., leading partnerships with early design partners, securing pilot customers);
• Pitching ideas to potential founders, participating in the vetting and team x idea matching process, and building close relationships with founders
• Contributing to building Diagram's culture and brand in the community (e.g. attending startup community events, conferences, etc)
 You should have: 
 • A track record of outstanding performance
• A proven entrepreneurial mindset, high degree of ownership and a self-starter mentality
• Intellectual curiosity and rigor
• Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - be comfortable pitching ideas, and be able to produce high-quality deliverables
• Demonstrated ability to use AI technologies to create/build and leverage to assist in day to day work/activites
• 1-3 years of work experience in relevant fields such as:
• Early stage venture capital investing (Seed or Series A)
• Early-stage tech incl. product management, design-thinking / human-centered design, engineering, or other experience within tech startups
• Consulting or advisory focused on tech products / businesses
• Venture building at a venture studio
• Analytical skills and the ability to build financial models
• A technical (Engineering, Computer Science, Economics) or business degree
• Knowledge, experience or network in FinTech or InsureTech are a plus
 What we offer: 
 • A unique opportunity to learn how to build a VC-backed company 0-1;
• An essential role in something big, meaningful and different;
• The opportunity to push yourself, have ownership and impact;
• A team of accomplished, ambitious and supportive individuals that will help you grow;
• An ecosystem with many stretch opportunities including the potential to join a Diagram portfolio company;
• Competitive compensation, including upside in the companies Diagram creates;
• Beautiful offices in great locations (Montreal, Toronto);
• Generous benefits including a telemedicine service for you and your family.
 How to apply: 
 In order to be considered for the role, please apply to the role and attach: 
 • Your resume
• One thematic analysis - show us an example of how YOU think like a founder/entrepreneur by sharing with us an area you see opportunities for innovation
• Tell us how have you meaningfully used AI in the last 12 months
 Guidance for the thematic idea: Create a max 2 page (word) memo or 10-slide presentation around a Fintech or Insuretech theme of your choice, addressing the following questions:
 • Pain Points: What are big problems to be solved in the theme?
• Market Timing: What makes this area ripe for disruption today? What are the market headwinds and/or tailwinds?
• Market Sizing : How big is the market today? What’s the market size projected in 2040?
• Competition : Who are a few venture backed companies in the space?
• Interesting Angles : What are a few ideas you’d be interested in exploring?
 We are less interested in exhaustive research and more interested in how you think. Approach this as if you are pitching a new venture theme internally at Diagram. We’re looking for sharp insight, strong judgment, and clear venture angles - not a consulting-style industry report.
 We encourage you to focus on a clearly defined theme within Fintech or Insurtech rather than covering the sector broadly. For example, instead of writing about “AI in Fintech,” you might explore a focused theme such as agentic payments infrastructure. Depth within a well-defined wedge is stronger than a high-level overview of an entire category.
 Note: we will select the top applicants to present their thematic analysis to us. Interviews will start following the close of applications.

jobs.title: Venture Scout
jobs.description:
CVX Venture Scout Programme 

 Do you have a passion for sourcing investments and making a difference for growth companies? Do you want to assist an extraordinary team of talented, motivated, driven individuals who all share a deep passion for entrepreneurship? If so, you may be our new Venture Scout. Please note, this is not a full time role, but we will provide remuneration based on success criteria. 

 Introduction 

 The CVX Venture Scout Programme is building a network of highly talented VC scouts, to assist us in sourcing attractive investment opportunities, in their specialist fields. You will learn and develop some of the most important skills required to be in VC, and meet with some of the most interesting and entrepreneurial founders in your market, and help shape the future.

 As part of your role as a CVX Venture Scout, the Investment Team will look to you to identify exciting startups, speak with them and conduct research on them, including their teams, markets, and competition. Based on your findings, you will write a 1-2 page proposal memo summarising your investment thesis, and may be asked to present it in-person or online to the CVX Investment Team.

 Expectations 

 We aim to use our Venture Scout Programme not only to discover exceptional investment opportunities but also to gain a deeper understanding of you and your vision. If you are interested in joining the CVX Investment Team, this is an excellent first step towards not only gaining an introduction to the VC ecosystem and learning essential VC skills, but also demonstrating how you think about investments, analyse them, and present your insights to us. As we grow our Investment Team, the Venture Scout Programme will be the first pool of resource we look to hire from.

 Compensation 

 We want to remunerate good work and give credit to your role in the investment process, where successful. We will therefore compensate you when a deal that you take forward to the investment team receives funding from our network of investors, with an opportunity for you to benefit from the upside too.

 Our Mission 

 CVX is one of Europe's fastest-growing venture investors, and we help ambitious and promising growth companies reach their full potential by investing capital, knowledge, time, skills, and network. We are driven by our conviction that the best investors are often those who, in addition to capital, provide founders with the right knowledge and experiences, skills, and networks in relation to the stage and industry in which the company operates. CVX always invests together with the best business angels for the respective founder, and today we have over 700 partners in our network who invest in companies and bring their skills into play where they can really add value.

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI Hardware)
jobs.description:
Job Description – Product Manager (AI Hardware)

Location: San Francisco (on-site at our offices)

About Artificial Analysis

Artificial Analysis is the leading independent AI benchmarking company. We support labs, engineers and enterprises to understand AI capabilities and make critical decisions about their AI strategies. We are the go-to authority for understanding AI, from AI labs and enterprises to media, investors, and policymakers. Our benchmarks don’t just measure the cutting edge of AI, they are actively shaping the frontier.

Our benchmarks and analysis are trusted by hundreds of thousands of users and are the go-to reference for leading AI labs including OpenAI, Google, Meta, NVIDIA and Anthropic, and major publications including the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, the Financial Times and The Economist.

We are a team of 40+, on track to double by end of year, backed by Nat Friedman (GitHub, Meta), Daniel Gross (SSI, Meta), Andrew Ng (Google Brain, DeepLearning.ai http://DeepLearning.ai, Amazon), Adam D’Angelo (Quora, Poe, OpenAI), Clem Delangue (Hugging Face) and other industry leaders.

The Opportunity

AI hardware is where the next decade of AI economics will be decided, and our hardware benchmarks are becoming the reference point for how the industry measures accelerators. We’re hiring into our hardware pillar to drive that coverage: benchmarking the GPUs, TPUs and custom silicon the AI industry runs on, and building the analysis that helps the industry understand them.

You’ll design and run performance benchmarks across accelerators and inference configurations, extend our hardware benchmarking stack, including AA-AgentPerf and our performance benchmarking suite, build cost and throughput models, and work directly with the leading chipmakers to benchmark their latest silicon. This is a technical, hands-on role at the intersection of silicon and AI, working directly with our founders and hardware pillar lead.

What You’ll Do

• Benchmark AI Accelerators: Design and execute performance benchmarking across GPUs, TPUs and custom inference silicon, measuring throughput, latency and price-performance the way the industry actually deploys

• Build Evaluation Methodology: Develop and maintain the frameworks that define how AI hardware performance and efficiency are measured, extending products like AA-AgentPerf, from tokens per second and time-to-first-token to total cost of ownership

• Analyze Inference Economics: Deeply understand how cost-per-token, utilization and hardware choice interact, and translate that into analysis the industry relies on for deployment and procurement decisions

• Partner with Chipmakers: Work with the top hardware companies in the world, from NVIDIA, AMD and Google to the leading new accelerator companies, at a deep technical level: benchmarking their latest silicon, shaping methodology together, and setting the standards the industry measures by

• Drive Strategic Analysis: Produce reports and data visualizations that communicate hardware performance and economics to technical and non-technical audiences

• Become AI-Native: Embrace an AI-native workflow, using cutting-edge AI tools to generate leverage in a fast-changing industry and maintain our competitive edge in AI benchmarking

What We’re Looking For

You should come from the world of AI accelerators.

Backgrounds include: engineering, product, performance or technical roles at AI accelerator and inference hardware companies (e.g. Cerebras, Groq, SambaNova, d-Matrix, Etched, MatX, Tenstorrent or similar), GPU and accelerator teams at larger players (NVIDIA, AMD, Google, Amazon, Qualcomm), or inference infrastructure companies working close to the silicon.

Required:

• 3+ years of professional experience, including at least 2 years at an AI chip company (e.g. NVIDIA, Cerebras, SambaNova, Groq or similar)

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

• Proficiency in Python and data analysis

• Deep familiarity with AI accelerators and the inference software stack (e.g. CUDA, TensorRT, vLLM or similar serving frameworks)

• Understanding of inference economics: cost-per-token, utilization, and the trade-offs that drive real deployment decisions

• Genuine, demonstrable interest and knowledge of Frontier AI. We want people who have informed opinions about where AI is heading, not just people who use AI tools

Why Artificial Analysis?

• Shape how AI gets built: The leading AI labs track our benchmarks and use them to guide their development priorities. Your work will directly influence the direction of AI.

• Become a world expert in AI: You will evaluate every major model, across every major capability, as they are released. Very few roles offer this breadth of exposure to frontier AI.

• Work with the most important players in AI: You’ll manage relationships with teams at the leading AI labs and major enterprises as a trusted, independent voice.

• Join at a defining moment: We’re 40+ people, on track to double by end of year, backed by some of the most connected investors in AI. The people who join now will shape the product, the team, and the strategy as we scale.

• Competitive compensation including equity

jobs.title: Investment Associate & Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Y Combinator is looking for a full-stack product engineer who also wants to apply their skills to investing, diligence, and founder support. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and investing. You will spend much of your time writing production code — building internal and founder-facing tools — while also contributing directly to company evaluation and investment decisions.
 This is not two jobs stitched together. The core of the role is turning judgment into software: using code to improve how YC evaluates companies, supports founders, and scales its impact after the batch.
 What you'll do: 
 • Product & Engineering (core responsibility) 
 • Design, build, and ship full-stack web applications for partners, founders, and investors

• Own features end-to-end: scoping, design, implementation, and iteration

• Work across frontend, backend, and data layers to improve YC's post-batch and internal platforms (e.g., founder tools, analytics, workflow systems)

• Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment

• Investing & Analysis 
 • Evaluate post-batch and growth-stage companies by analyzing business models, markets, teams, and operating metrics

• Contribute to diligence efforts, including reviewing decks and data rooms, benchmarking KPIs, and conducting market or customer research

• Build and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, or workflows that support investment decisions

• Write clear, structured memos and analyses for partners and our Investment Committee

 This role is ideal for someone who: 
 • Is a strong full-stack engineer and enjoys owning production software

• Likes talking to users and senior stakeholders to decide what to build

• Is curious about investing and wants hands-on exposure

• Prefers ownership and impact over narrowly scoped tickets

• Is energized by ambiguity and comfortable making tradeoffs

• Can translate ambiguous questions into concrete products, systems, or analyses

 Successful candidates have been: 
 • Former founders or early-stage engineers

• Product-minded engineers who've worked closely with business or finance teams

• Engineers with prior exposure to investing, finance, or company analysis

 What we're looking for: 
 • Required 
 • Experience shipping full-stack web applications

• Ability to design systems and reason about tradeoffs independently

• Strong analytical thinking; comfort with metrics and financial concepts

• Clear written and verbal communication

• Excellent judgment, integrity, and ability to work with sensitive information

• Not required, but helpful 
 • Experience with Rails, React, Postgres, or similar frameworks and databases

• Prior experience in venture capital, growth equity, banking, consulting, or corporate development

• Founder or early-stage startup experience

• Experience building internal tools, analytics platforms, or workflow software

• We care far more about your ability to build and ship real software than about any specific framework. If you've built strong full-stack products before, you can learn our stack.

 How we work: YC operates with a small, high-trust team. Roadmaps evolve organically, priorities shift quickly, and people are expected to use good judgment rather than wait for perfect specs. Engineers have real autonomy and work closely with partners and founders to build things that matter.
 Location: Based in the San Francisco Bay Area (or willing to relocate)
 Compensation: $250K to $500K base salary, depending on experience. YC has a profit-sharing program, which is comparable to equity in an early-stage startup or carry in a VC fund.
 Benefits: Our full benefits package includes medical, vision, and dental plans, infertility benefit, STD/LTD, life insurance, commuter benefits, flexible spending account, health savings account, 401(k) + 4% matching, generous parental leave, paid holidays, and flexible paid time off policy.
 Important Note: This role is not a fit if you're looking for:
 • A pure investing or finance role with little hands-on building

• A pure engineering role with tightly defined specs and limited product ownership

• A highly structured environment with rigid roadmaps

 Work Authorization: Y Combinator is willing to sponsor certain employment visas in accordance with company policy.
 Legal note: Y Combinator considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance. We manage $1.6 billion, investing in companies that create new ways to support mobility and emerging technologies, advance the industrial value chain, and accelerate decarbonization and sustainability. Our work connects breakthrough innovators with Toyota's global platform, strengthening the company's capabilities today while creating new opportunities for tomorrow.

 Woven Capital is seeking an AI Associate to join our growing Venture Capital team. Our fund is committed to strategic, growth stage investments in cutting-edge technologies and innovative startups that embody Toyota's vision for the future of mobility. In this role, the AI Associate will be instrumental in identifying, evaluating, and managing investment opportunities that foster growth and innovation within the mobility ecosystem as well as leading our internal AI initiative to build intelligent agents and workflows that make the entire team faster and smarter.

 This is a unique opportunity to work in the venture capital and corporate venture capital industry, supporting a global investment mandate. We firmly believe in building an exceptional team as a cornerstone of our success, and we foster a culture rooted in open discussion and collaboration.

• Internal AI Product Manager: Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI agents to automate repetitive investment workflows. Develop a long-term AI productivity roadmap for the fund.

Assist in managing relationships with key stakeholders and support the Woven Capital team members in their portfolio company board roles.

• Industry Research and Trend Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and market dynamics relevant to Woven Capital's investment focus. Contribute to the development of thought leadership content and market insights.

 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• AI native: Demonstrated hands-on experience building and experimenting with cutting edge AI technologies.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields with an MBA OR Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related fields

• 5+ years of professional experience in investment banking, venture capital, strategic consulting, building technology, and/or product management.

• Demonstrated passion for Technology, Venture Capital, Start-ups, and entrepreneurship.

• Comfortable with understanding technology innovations in deep tech/hard tech sectors.

• Demonstrated experience in deal sourcing, due diligence, financial modeling, and market analysis.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and strong networking skills.

• Patience in dealing with different cultures/languages and different decision-making mechanisms and logic.

• Excited to become a key member of a growing investment team, and to devote oneself to transforming a large traditional automotive company into a digital-ready, frontier mobility company.

• Patience in dealing with different cultures/languages and different time zones.

 NICE TO HAVES
 
• Knowledge of the mobility sector, autonomous mobility, software development, EVs/batteries, electrification and clean energy industries is valuable.

• Experience working, studying, or living in different cultures and geographies is a plus but not required.

• Having an extensive network in the startup and VC ecosystem is a plus.

• Bachelor's degree in STEM field and MBA degree is a plus.

• Experience in co-founding a startup is a plus.

jobs.title: Funds Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Funds Operations Associate
 Wefunder helps founders raise from the people who believe in them.
 About Wefunder
 We've raised over a billion dollars for thousands of founders in all 50 states, from ostrich farms to unicorns like Substack, Replit, & Mercury.
 We're a Public Benefit Corporation with a mission to keep the American dream alive. We're fighting to keep America defined by optimism, innovation, and opportunity—the best place for the ambitious to turn ideas into reality.
 We believe America is full of untapped talent, and that helping more founders get off the ground leads to a better future. Our goal is to help 20,000 more founders get off the ground. We're just getting started.
 We're a team of founder types: enjoy autonomy, responsibility, the opportunity to learn, and no red tape. Just make it happen.
 The Role
 • SHAPE THE PORTFOLIO EXPERIENCE
 Manage our portfolio product. Research and validate portfolio company investment data, and help improve the view that allows investors to track the value of their investments.

• GUIDE POST-FUNDING MILESTONES
 Lead founders through post-funding events, including subsequent financing rounds, acquisitions, and IPOs. Make these processes smooth for both founders and investors who may not be familiar with them.

• OWN FUND TAX OPERATIONS
 Handle taxes. Manage 150+ SPVs as well as taxable events for our funds every year. This will require meticulous management of all parties involved — from founders, to our team, to external CPAs.

• STRENGTHEN INVESTOR RELATIONS
 Support investor relations. Help founders communicate with their investors and work with our customer success team to answer complex investor questions.

• CHAMPION FOUNDERS AFTER THE RAISE
 Be the internal champion for founders after they raise on Wefunder. Advocate for them, empathize with them, and set clear expectations for them.
 Location & Culture
 We're strong believers in an in-person culture. Our HQ is in San Francisco — we have two offices, one in the Mission and one in Seacliff with a view of the Golden Gate Bridge.
 We're a small team of ~30 that hires carefully. In this new AI world, one star can outcompete 10 average people. We'd rather stay lean, move fast, and spend our time building — not navigating big-company bureaucracy.
 We're tight-knit enough to spend 10 days on a train together without killing each other. Four times over the years, we've all taken the Amtrak coast to coast, stopping in 12 cities. We're a team of doers and thinkers who are insatiably curious — not just about work, but about kickboxing, mountaineering, chess, and everything in between.
 Read our Favorite Books →
 Culture →
 Skills & Experience

• INCREDIBLE ATTENTION TO DETAIL
 You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

• CURIOSITY
 You learn very quickly and have an innate curiosity to dive deeper. You will need to learn how funds work in the crowdfunding world.

• INITIATIVE, DRIVE, AND URGENCY TO SOLVE PROBLEMS
 You develop systems to be more efficient over time. You’ll leave your mark on how we do things and grow with the company.

• RUTHLESS PRIORITIZATION
 You will be the primary point person for founders as they go through the crazy process of fundraising on top of having dozens of competing priorities. You know how to get things done while also building for the future.

• EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION
 You can code-switch between building rapport with CEOs, alleviating concerns from skeptical CFOs, discussing valuations with investors, and fielding questions from diligent attorneys.

• ABILITY TO THRIVE IN AMBIGUITY
 You’re comfortable asking a lot of questions. You prefer being thrown in the deep end. You aspire to learn every small detail about the fundraising process.

• FUND OPERATIONS EXPERIENCE PREFERRED
 Experience with fund management and taxes is preferred for this job.
 Benefits

• Competitive salary and stock options package

• Unlimited vacation days (mandatory 3 weeks off)

• Medical, dental, & vision insurance

• 401(k) match

• Apple equipment — whatever you want

• Lots of free food and drinks. This includes daily lunch and weekly team breakfast and dinner.

• Reimbursement for classes and conferences
 Ready to apply?
 To apply, email Casey at casey@wefunder.com with your CV or LinkedIn and why you’d like to work with us.
 If you feel like you don't meet all of the points above, but love this role, apply anyways. We built Wefunder by ranking raw talent and drive above experience.

jobs.description:
Wavemaker is Southeast Asia's leading VC firm investing in Enterprise, Deep Tech, and

jobs.title: Product Designer, Marketplace
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 

 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 

 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 

 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. 

 About the Role:

 You will own product design for Vercel Marketplace and Vercel Connect, the products that help developers and agents discover, provision, and connect external services to their workloads running on Vercel. You will design both sides of the ecosystem: builders choosing and managing services, and partners creating and operating integrations across the Vercel dashboard, CLI, API-driven agent flows, v0, and partner tools.

 Both products are live, with active customers and partners. You will improve current journeys while defining how integrations and agent access should work next.

 You will report into Design and collaborate with a Product Manager and dedicated engineering team.  We’re considering candidates at both the Senior and Staff level and will calibrate level based on experience and demonstrated scope and impact. 

 If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

 What You Will Do:

• Own the builder and partner experiences across discovery, installation, billing, management, and removal, and shape what the team builds next with Product and Engineering.

• Define how developers and agents discover, provision, configure, and use databases, services, and integrations across Marketplace and Connect.

• Turn OAuth, permissions, environments, credentials, billing, and provider constraints into experiences that feel simple without hiding details that matter.

• Build and test working prototypes independently, using coding agents to explore product behavior and technical constraints.

• Work directly with customers and partners, using research, support signals, and product data to find opportunities, define success measures, and prove improvements through experiments.

• Work through implementation with engineers and maintain quality through launch and iteration.

• There is no mature design playbook here. Create the reusable patterns and structure Marketplace and Connect need, and adjust course as evidence arrives.

• Take on foundational product problems, including provider dependencies and platform operations. Some high-impact work will be largely invisible to users.

 About You:

• Your portfolio makes your contribution, decisions, shipped outcomes, and impact after launch easy to understand.

• You have independently owned ambiguous, technically complex product work from problem framing through launch and iteration.

• You reason about systems while maintaining a high bar for interaction and visual craft.

• You use qualitative and quantitative evidence, define success measures, and change direction when evidence challenges the hypothesis.

• You make complex products feel clear and trustworthy, including edge cases, recovery, language, and accessibility.

• You work directly with Product and Engineering, read APIs or code when useful, and explain tradeoffs clearly.

• You independently use coding agents to prototype interactions, inspect implementation, and learn unfamiliar systems. Curiosity and agency with these tools are required.

 Production engineering experience is not required. We care more about product judgment, craft, ownership, and how quickly you learn a technical system.

 Bonus If You:

• Have designed a marketplace, integrations platform, partner ecosystem, or other multi-sided product.

• Understand OAuth, permissions, secrets, billing, developer tooling, or infrastructure products.

• Have shipped AI or agent experiences, especially workflows that move between human approval and autonomous action.

• Have an engineering background or experience contributing production web code.

 Benefits:

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  

 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Brand Designer to join our Design Team (working with DevRel, Success, and Enterprise) and help shape our visual storytelling across a variety of mediums. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams, helping us bring our ideas to life with compelling visuals that engage our developer community and amplify our brand at conferences, events, swag, and beyond.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. You will have opportunities to lead, propose, and execute projects across various formats—from polished presentations to impactful print designs—ensuring a cohesive and powerful brand presence across all touchpoints.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Shape our visual storytelling across decks, printed materials, YouTube content, and conference assets.

 - Collaborate with Marketing, DevRel, Success, Enterprise, and Event teams to bring creative ideas to life.

 - Craft cohesive and engaging visual narratives for presentations, digital assets, and physical materials.

 - Maintain strict brand consistency, ensuring all materials adhere to Supabase’s visual identity and messaging.

 - Execute end-to-end design projects across multiple channels, including print, video, and social media.

 - Set high standards for design quality, meticulous attention to detail, and visual communication that resonates with our community.




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have strong proficiency in design tools like Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), and presentation software.

 - Are comfortable designing across digital, print, and video formats (and know the difference between 300gsm and 100gsm paper).

 - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams.

 - Are energized by creative storytelling and building an impactful, memorable brand presence for a developer audience.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, and proactively bringing new ideas to the table.

 - Balance iteration and scale: You focus on high-impact, incremental improvements rather than a "redo everything" approach, and you welcome collaborative feedback.





WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Sail Core
jobs.description:
Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 Sail Core builds Stripe's frontend platform—the data layer, navigation, observability, and developer tooling that 50+ product teams use to ship web applications, with the Dashboard being the largest. We are responsible for enabling a stellar developer experience for frontend engineers at Stripe. We're hiring a deeply technical product manager to own the platform strategy, drive cross-company modernization initiatives, and set the standard for frontend excellence at Stripe.

 What you'll do

 How should a platform team decide what to build when 50 teams depend on you and each one thinks their request is the most urgent? When do you invest in long-term architectural health versus shipping the migration that unblocks next quarter's goal? How do you make 9,000 files at initialization become a fast, traceable, joyful developer experience—without breaking production for millions of merchants along the way?

 Responsibilities

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for Stripe's frontend platform

• Drive the largest frontend modernization initiative at Stripe while holding the line on architectural quality

• Redefine frontend development with agentic tooling

• Define and track key metrics such as latency, build times, and reliability SLOs to make difficult trade-off decisions

• Be the product voice in deeply technical decisions such as API surface design, framework deprecation sequencing, extraction boundaries, and migration tooling

 Who you are

 You think in systems, not features. You go deep on architecture, you don't delegate to engineering. You're the person who reads the RFC before the meeting, asks why the error response looks like that, and frames migrations in terms of user outcomes, not just engineering milestones. You treat developer experience as part of the product, not a byproduct.

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or developer tools teams

• Strong technical fluency in frontend web development—you discuss JavaScript and TypeScript, React component models, build systems, and performance optimization with depth

• Experience driving large-scale migrations or platform transitions across multiple teams, including the sequencing, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment that make them succeed

• Demonstrated use of quantitative metrics to drive platform investment decisions—you've defined the metrics, not just tracked them

• Track record of partnering with engineering to make architectural trade-offs grounded in user impact

 Preferred qualifications

• Engineering background—you've written frontend code professionally and it still shapes how you think about product decisions

• Led or significantly contributed to a legacy extraction or monolith decomposition effort and understand viscerally why they're hard and where they get stuck

• Believe that fast software is the best software

• Naturally default to the platform solution over the one-off fix, but know when speed demands the opposite

• Explain what a cascading re-render is, why it matters, and what to do about it—to an engineer, a designer, and a VP, in three different ways

ABOUT US

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Manager for Voice: real-time, human-quality AI conversations.

Voice is one of the most demanding and important surfaces for AI agents. It requires low latency, high reliability, natural turn-taking, and the ability to handle messy, real-world interactions across phone systems and global customers.

As PM for Voice, you will define how Sierra agents sound, respond, and behave in live conversations. You’ll shape the core voice experience—from first utterance → dialogue → resolution—and ensure agents perform reliably in production across telephony and real-time systems.

This is a zero-to-one and scaling role at the intersection of speech, infrastructure, and product experience.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define the voice interaction model - Shape how agents handle real-time conversations—turn-taking, interruptions, latency, tone, and recovery from errors. Design what “human-quality” voice interaction actually means in practice.

 - Build reliable real-time systems -  Work closely with engineering on streaming architectures, latency budgets, and failure handling. Voice is unforgiving—ensure agents respond quickly and consistently in production environments.

 - Own the voice stack experience - Partner across ASR, TTS, LLMs, and telephony integrations to deliver a cohesive product. Help decide model choices, orchestration strategies, and how different components work together.

 - Make voice measurable and improvable - Define how we evaluate voice agents: latency, interruption handling, resolution rate, and conversation quality. Build feedback loops that improve performance over time.

 - Translate real-world usage into product direction - Work closely with customers deploying voice agents in production. Understand edge cases (noisy environments, accents, call flows) and turn them into product improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3+ years of product management experience, with meaningful exposure to real-time systems, voice, or AI products

 - Experience shipping voice or real-time products - You understand the constraints of latency, streaming systems, and user expectations in synchronous interactions

 - Strong technical depth - Ability to engage deeply with engineers on system design (e.g., speech pipelines, streaming infra, telephony systems, reliability tradeoffs)

 - Experience working with AI systems - Familiarity with LLMs, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech systems and their limitations in production environments

 - Track record of 0→1 product development - Comfortable operating in ambiguous spaces and iterating quickly to reach product-market fit


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. jobs.description: Search Atlas | Product Engineer (Product Manager role, not a Full-stack role) | REMOTE (anywhere, EST hours) | Full-time contractor | $23-$34 USD/hour | https://careers.searchatlas.com/jobs/599248-product-engineer... We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers. Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you. Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it". Process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days. Our ATS forces us to list specific countries but we hire from anywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't on there. Apply at the link and mention HN somewhere, in your pitch or wherever it fits. I'm João Pedro, I read all of them. joao.pedro@searchatlas.com if you need me, though the link's faster.

jobs.title: Investment Operations Associate
jobs.description:
About Sands Capital: 

 Sands Capital is an active, long-term investor in leading innovative growth businesses, globally. Our approach combines analytical rigor and creative thinking to identify high-quality growth businesses that are creating the future. Through an integrated investment platform spanning alternatives, growth equity and public equity, we provide growth capital solutions to institutions and fund sponsors in more than 30 countries (detailed on our website www.sandscapital.com ). 

 Position Summary: 

 Sands Capital is seeking a motivated Investment Operations Associate to support the Portfolio Services function within the Investment Operations Team. This role is responsible for supporting cash flow management, daily reconciliations, transaction and position review, exception research, reporting support, performance, portfolio and fund accounting, and operational control activities for separately managed accounts and funds. In this role, you will work closely with team members, custodians, administrators, and internal stakeholders to maintain accurate records, resolve discrepancies, support client and firm reporting, and identify opportunities to improve process efficiency and control quality. 

 Work Expectations:   

 The work location for this role is Sands Capital’s headquarters in Arlington, Virginia on a hybrid schedule of three days per week in-office (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday), or more as directed by your manager. The hybrid schedule is subject to change at any time. 

 Position Responsibilities: 

• Reconciliation & Exception Management: Perform daily and periodic reconciliations of cash, positions, transactions, income, FX activity, corporate actions, and other account-level activity against custodian, administrator, or service-provider records. 

• Cash Flow Management: Review, process, and monitor client and fund cash flows, including contributions, withdrawals, income, fees, expenses, rebates, management fees, in-kind transactions, and other cash or asset movements. 

• Discrepancy Research: Research and resolve cash, position, transaction, pricing, income, corporate action, and account-data discrepancies, escalating issues with clear facts, analysis, and recommended next steps. 

• Portfolio Recordkeeping: Support accurate and timely portfolio recordkeeping by validating account activity, maintaining data integrity, and ensuring operational information is complete and reliable for downstream use. 

• Reporting & Audit Support: Prepare and review recurring client, firm, audit, financial, and operational reporting deliverables, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and delivered on time. 

• Service Provider Coordination: Communicate with custodians, administrators, and third-party service providers to research open items, monitor outstanding requests, and support timely issue resolution. 

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Portfolio Administration, Trade Settlements, Trading, Compliance, Client Service, Accounting/Finance, Legal, and other internal teams when portfolio services workflows require broader coordination. 

• Process Improvement & Projects: Participate in cross-functional projects focused on improving team efficiency, strengthening controls, and enhancing operational workflows. Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and control weaknesses, and assist with documentation, data validation, testing, reporting enhancements, and practical technology-enabled solutions. 

• Technical : Strong technical aptitude and curiosity, with the ability to learn systems quickly, work effectively with data, and contribute to projects that improve reporting, controls, automation, or operational efficiency; prior exposure to data analytics, workflow tools, or investment operations technology is a plus. 

• Risk & Control Awareness: Follow established procedures, maintain awareness of internal policies and compliance expectations, and contribute to strong operational controls across daily responsibilities. 

• Learning & Development: Demonstrate curiosity, accountability, and a willingness to learn new systems, products, workflows, and industry practices as the business evolves. 

• Performing other position responsibilities, as needed. 

• Exhibiting behaviors consistent with Sands Capital’s Mission, Values, and culture. 

 Position Qualifications: 

• Undergraduate degree from an accredited university, preferably in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field. 

• 1-3 years of relevant professional experience in investment operations, fund accounting, custody, middle/back-office operations, or financial services. 

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce timely, accurate, and high-quality work products. 

• Working knowledge of cash, positions, transactions, portfolio accounting, reconciliation, or investment operations concepts preferred. 

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; comfort reviewing data, validating information, and learning new systems. 

• Experience with or interest in operational technology, reporting tools, workflow automation, or data analytics is a plus. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to research discrepancies, identify root causes, and escalate appropriately. 

• Ability to manage recurring deadlines, prioritize work, and operate with urgency in a fast-paced professional environment. 

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across internal teams and external service providers. 

 Required Behavioral Characteristics: 

 The following are behavioral characteristics that the firm holds in high regard and are critical for high-performing individuals and teams at Sands Capital:  

• Having impeccable integrity. 

• Exhibiting superior client service skills (both internally and externally). 

• Exhibiting strong interpersonal skills. 

• Demonstrating a strong work ethic in a fast-paced, professional environment. 

• Operating with a high degree of initiative, self-discipline, and motivation. 

• Working effectively both independently and as part of a team with a high degree of efficiency and accuracy. 

• Assuming the best of others. 

• Being motivated by a job well-done. 

 Sands Capital’s Values: 

 The following are values that the firm holds in high regard and are critical for high-performing individuals and teams at Sands Capital: 

• Integrity & Trust: Do what is right, not what is popular. Deliver on commitments. 

• Client-Centered: Always act in the best interest of our clients. 

• Commitment to Excellence: Strive to learn and improve. Implement best practices. 

• Focus: Identify and concentrate on “what matters”. 

• Long-Term Perspective: Appreciate that time allows sound decisions to demonstrate their worth. Avoid short-term thinking. 

• Independent Thinking: Have the courage to develop and articulate your own convictions. Debate others openly and honestly. 

• Teamwork: Collaborate to gather facts, develop perspective, build conviction, and support timely decision-making. 

• Positive “Can-Do” Attitude: Demonstrate a willingness to tackle any task. 

• Graciousness: Reflect kindness and courtesy at all times. 

• Balance: Enjoy your work while balancing professional activities with interests beyond the firm. 

• Meritocracy: Know that talent and achievement will drive your success at Sands Capital. 

 How to Apply: 

 To be considered, you must submit an application that specifically outlines your qualifications for the position. If you wish to apply for this position, please do so via Sands Capital’s Careers page under “Professional Opportunities”. You may also scroll to “FAQs” to learn more about what you can expect before applying, to include information regarding length of process and any skills assessments that may be required. See here:  https://www.sandscapital.com/careers-and-staff-benefits/ 

 Salary and Benefits: 

 The compensation for this role includes a base salary range of $70,000 - $75,000 (as determined by the candidate’s professional experience and relevant knowledge, skills, and abilities), as well as a discretionary, performance-based bonus. Bonus targets may vary by position and are based on both individual achievement as well as broader firm performance. 

 Sands Capital offers a generous benefits package, including medical insurance (which includes a discount vision program), dental insurance, life and personal accident insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts (medical and dependent), as well as paid stock market (NYSE) holidays, vacation, sick, and parental leave. We also offer various supplemental services such as a medical concierge service, health and wellness coaches, onsite massage therapy, and more. 
 Sands Capital is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and staff members. For our staff members, equal opportunity includes access to the benefits and privileges that the firm provides to staff members generally. We appreciate the value diversity brings to Sands Capital and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all staff members. 

 We evaluate and select qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, age, religion, disability status, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Discrimination of this kind is also strictly prohibited by a variety of federal, state, and local laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act 1964, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967, and the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. 

 Read more about equal employment opportunity on the EEOC’s website, found here . 

 We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to pregnant individuals, individuals with disabilities, and/or individuals needing accommodation for sincerely held religious beliefs. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an e-mail to emiller@sandscap.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

Your Mission: Find the next startup to become part of the Rhapsody portfolio! You will nurture and expand cooperation between industry and science-based startups to help bring sustainability-oriented technologies from lab to market. 
 Rhapsody’s World: 
 • Bringing “hard-tech” innovations -- things like physical AI infrastructure, engineering innovations, chemistries, photonics -- from the lab to the market is impactful for our planet and our economy, and is an amazingly rewarding mission! 
• Enabling collaborations between startups and industry partners is critical to ensure that startups can bring their world-changing innovations to market successfully. 
• Alongside Rhapsody’s investment activity, we’ve built an innovation ecosystem in which we work intimately with leading corporations around the globe to nurture relationships with innovation sources (startups and universities). This ecosystem has grown rapidly, helping the startups we work with to thrive. 
 You will: 
 • Talk to startups! You will meet with around a dozen a week to find our next investment. 
• Facilitate partnership discussions between startups and industry. 
• Conduct industry and technology deep dives to help guide investment decisions. 
• Work directly with large companies and startups to support the ecosystem in a structured program. 
• Join one of the startups in our portfolio to do operational work such as business development and marketing. 
 You are:  
 • A graduate of a top school with a degree in engineering or in applied science. 
• Curious about the world around you. You are comfortable engaging in purposeful conversations with startup founders to learn their story. 
• At home in the world of science and engineering.  
• Uninspired by the latest app or back office software “innovation.” 
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where decisions are made quickly and you are given broad autonomy to get your work done. 
 If you’re curious about hard tech VC, please share your LinkedIn profile and what intrigues you about Rhapsody below! 
 About Rhapsody Venture Partners 
 Rhapsody Venture Partners is a venture investor in Cambridge, MA that funds early-stage applied science and engineering companies.  Rhapsody’s team works side-by-side with entrepreneurs to develop industry partnerships that reduce time-to-commercialization and accelerate growth. Learn more at www.rhapsodyvp.com . 
 Position is based in Cambridge, MA with domestic and international travel.
