jobs.title: Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
About Moonshots Capital

 Moonshots Capital has been backing early-stage technology companies since 2004, on a single conviction: leadership is what separates the companies that make it from the ones that don't. We look for founders who have demonstrated extraordinary leadership in their past such as military-trained or trial-by-fire repeat entrepreneurs — people who can move others to action, earn trust fast, and plan without a map — and when we see those traits, we invest with conviction. To date: 133 investments, 33 exits, 20 unicorns.

 The firm was founded by Kelly Perdew and Craig Cummings, both West Point graduates and former Army Officers. Across the team we've started and operated 15 businesses of our own, and we put that experience and our network to work for the founders we back long after the wire clears. We work out of Austin and Los Angeles. Candidates preferred in these two locations.

 We're hiring a Marketing Associate , reporting to our Head of Platform & Content, to own our brand, content, and event presence end-to-end. This is a chance to shape how Moonshots shows up in the world — the newsletter, the social presence, the flagship annual event — with the trust and autonomy to make judgment calls independently and put your own stamp on the work.

 Role Overview

 Four areas sit under this role: content and social, events, founder support, and AI.

 The first is content and social . You'll run all three company channels — LinkedIn, X, and Instagram — and write, edit, and schedule the newsletter. You'll keep a content calendar built out in advance rather than assembled the day of, produce original work from our existing photo and video collateral, keep the website current, and build the brand derivatives the firm needs as it goes: Canva graphics, one-pagers, social templates. You'll also report on how it all performs and bring us proposals based on what the data actually shows.

 Second, events . You'll hold a major ownership stake in the AGM, our flagship annual event, from the earliest planning through the post-event content rollout — plus the dinners and smaller gatherings we run through the year. Over time we want you visible in the venture communities we're part of, building relationships of your own there and representing Moonshots at the events worth showing up to.

 Third, founder media and content support . Supporting the Head of Platform & Content, you'll surface founder stories, announcements, and wins across our channels, develop outreach and source press and media opportunities for our founders and GPs, and contribute to our broader portfolio support work — founder-facing resources, playbooks, network access, quarterly reporting, and investment theses.

 The fourth is AI . It's part of our DNA here — we use and build with it religiously across the firm — and this role is the chance to lead that on the marketing side. You'll build and improve AI-driven workflows for content creation, social distribution, newsletter production, and research, then harden them into infrastructure the function runs on.

 We're a small team, which means real impact and real visibility, and it means marketing here moves in real time.

 What Success Looks Like

• Content Rhythm : A dependable publishing cadence — newsletter, social, and web — scheduled in advance, running without reminders, and growing reach and engagement over time.

• Ownership & Execution : Projects delivered end-to-end at a standard that's ready for senior stakeholders without a pass from anyone else.

• AI-First Workflows : Concrete evidence that content, distribution, and research work is faster and better because of the tools and processes you've built and use daily.

• Founder Support : Founder stories, announcements, and wins are getting real visibility across our channels, and media and content requests move quickly once they come in.

• Growth & Analytics : Reporting that tells us what's actually working, paired with a standing point of view on what we should try next.

• Community Presence : A growing, genuine presence for Moonshots — and for you — inside the venture communities we're part of.

 Qualifications

• Experience : 2–4+ years in marketing, communications, or content, ideally including a startup, VC/PE fund, or agency where you had real ownership over a brand or content function.

• Writing : This role is writing-heavy, and writing excellence independent of AI is expected. You write with narrative flow and clear transitions, you know where information belongs — chronological ordering, placement logic, tone — and you link your sources every time.

• AI Fluency : You already use AI tools daily in your own workflow and can point to specific instances where they genuinely improved or accelerated your content, research, or reporting work. You want to build the next set of them: content generators, reporting dashboards, internal assistants.

• Ownership & Managing Up : You may be earlier in your career, but you learn fast and carry the maturity to run your own workload and manage your manager's expectations. You send proactive, frequent updates and you show up to check-ins with an agenda.

• Project Management : You hold several workstreams at once — recurring and ad hoc — prioritize them sensibly, and hit your dates. You're quick, you're fine with ambiguity, and you plan far enough ahead to work well across time zones on a distributed team.

• Data Instinct : You track how content and social are performing, bring the insights back to the team, and always have a view on what to test differently.

• Attention to Detail : Your work is accurate and thorough. You catch the errors before they go out.

• Design Sense : A strong visual eye and reliable instincts for what reads as polished and professional.

• High EQ : You take feedback and apply it broadly rather than narrowly, and you build lasting fixes for recurring problems. On a small team you'll jump in wherever needed — no task too small.

• Tools : Canva or Adobe, newsletter and email platforms, social schedulers, CRM, CMS.

• Nice to have : An existing presence or relationships in the VC/startup ecosystem; military veteran and/or military familiarity; experience supporting or running a flagship annual event (conference, summit, LP or investor day); prior time inside a marketing function.

Overview 
 M12 is the corporate venture capital arm of Microsoft focused on early-stage investments in Artificial Intelligence, B2B SaaS, Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Gaming/Web3. We’ve had the honor of backing and help build over 100 great companies since launching the fund in 2016. Critically, M12 supports our portfolio companies with value-added resources through special access to Microsoft’s platform and services. M12 is headquartered in San Francisco with additional team members in Seattle. 

We’re seeking an Associate to help build thesises around current and new domains of interest, monitor the market, source deals, build relationships with top-tier investors, support the investment processes and due diligence, and assist our portfolio companies as a member of the investment team. We place a premium on diversity of ideas and are excited to add new perspectives to our team. We value accountability, continuous learning, inclusivity, teamwork, transparency, and trust.

 Responsibilities 
 Research and Market Exploration
 • Perform Continuous monitoring of market trends, industry news, and startup companies for potential investments in thematic areas supported by lead investor.
• Track specific VCs, entrepreneurs, industry leaders, sector experts, research organizations, etc.
• Perform high-quality research and analysis on key market and industry trends in defined theme areas to develop new insights and opinionated views
• Help come up and promote new ideas and research activities in defined theme areas
 Deal sourcing and support for Investment processes and Due Diligence
 • Attend industry conferences, building relationships with startups and venture investors
• Source deals aligned to key themes and thesis areas for M12
• Assist with due diligence evaluation of all relevant areas including a solid analysis of risks and opportunities (technological, industrial, intellectual property, commercial, economic, financial, HR, legal, compliance);Financial and unit economics analysis, valuation modeling using multiple methods
• Document startup and investment team meetings
• Track and report on deal flow generated by our team
• Help preparing internal investment memos
 Operational
 • Manage various operations such as (a) metrics tracking (b) financial and operational KPI documentation and reporting (c) production of portfolio presentations for periodic reviews (d) internal investment and valuation tracking
• Generate content for signal exchange with senior leadership and other stakeholders including startup showcase meetings
• Help create media & thought leadership content based on the fund’s investments and market research
• Help to add value to our existing portfolio through research, introductions, and BD activities in partnership with our portfolio development team

 Qualifications 
 Required qualifications
 • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Architecture, or related field AND 3+ years full-time experience in venture investing experience, supporting partners in sourcing, diligence and deal execution; additional experience in investment banking, consulting, strategic consulting, investment banking, venture capital, building technology, product management, and/or enterprise entrepreneurial ventures experience
 • OR equivalent experience.
 • 1+ year(s) experience on a deal team.
 Preferred qualifications
 • A good understanding of financial and business analysis, unit economics and valuation modeling using multiple methods. Knowledge of sector and market analysis; ideally has performed market competitive and consulting presentations and studies
• Demonstrated passion for Technology, Venture Capital, Start-ups, and entrepreneurship
• Critical thinking using superior research and analytical abilities
• Proficient writing, presentation, and verbal communication skills
• Experience managing multiple projects under compressed timeframes
• Ability to develop creative insights, recommendations, and solutions
• Ability to influence internal and external audiences, stakeholders using evangelism, partnership, and networking skills
• Demonstrated experience achieving results through collaboration in a team-centered environment
• Willingness to work at times under time pressure due to competitive deal situations and short investment timescales

jobs.title: Investment Partner
jobs.description:
About the job
 Company Description
 Meravo Capital is an operationally led emerging markets growth equity firm. Infrastructure Networks: Fund I targets African digital 'infrastructure orchestrators' - asset-light fintech and digital platforms at Series B and C.
 Investment opportunities are identified early, with a pipeline built on operating relationships within the African fintech ecosystem, underpinned by the founder trust that secures the best investments. The fund team combines financial, operational and investment depth, building businesses of genuine value with a clear path to internationally recognised exits.
 Meravo Capital exists to bring emerging market opportunities to the mainstream of global institutional investment.
 Role Description
 This is a foundational senior hire and a genuine partnership opportunity. The investment function will be led by the Managing Partner and Investment Partner, supported by a broader platform team. The Investment Partner will work directly alongside the Managing Partner as the fund's senior investment professional, sharing responsibility for deal origination, investment execution, portfolio management and LP relations.
 The Investment Partner will co-lead diligence processes, present to the Investment Committee, represent Meravo Capital at the founder and co-investor level and take relevant board observer or board seats at portfolio companies. The Investment Committee includes a combination of internal partners and independent external members with deep experience across Emerging Markets investing and infrastructure.
 This is the right role for a seasoned investor who wants to move from institutional employee to genuine fund partner - and who has the Emerging Markets depth, investment judgment and personal network to help build something significant from Fund I.
 Responsibilities
 • Lead and co-lead deal origination across Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa and Francophone West Africa, building and maintaining relationships with founders, co-investors and ecosystem participants
• Conduct and oversee investment due diligence at Series B and C stage, including financial modelling, market analysis, regulatory assessment and management evaluation
• Present investment recommendations to the Investment Committee and manage the full documentation process from term sheet through to close
• Take active portfolio management responsibility post-investment, including board representation, KPI oversight, covenant monitoring and follow-on investment assessment
• Contribute to LP fundraising and investor relations, supporting the Managing Partner across institutional conversations and LP reporting
• Build and develop the operating team - Deal Origination, Portfolio Operations, Data & Systems - as the fund scales
• Represent Meravo Capital externally at industry events, conferences and with regulators and ecosystem bodies across target markets
 Qualifications - Essential
 • 10+ years of investment experience, with at least five years in growth equity, venture capital or private equity focused on Emerging Markets
• Demonstrable investment track record at Series B stage or beyond - deal sourcing, execution and portfolio management with specific examples of value creation
• Africa market knowledge: on-the-ground operating or investing experience strongly preferred over purely desk-based coverage
• Strong existing relationships within the fintech and digital infrastructure ecosystem - founders, co-investors, accelerators and regulators
• Financial modelling proficiency and the ability to lead rigorous due diligence across complex, multi-jurisdictional businesses
• Credibility and presence in LP-facing and founder-facing settings across both institutional and emerging market environments
 Qualifications - Highly Desirable
 • Prior experience working at or alongside a DFI - bringing familiarity with development finance investment processes and governance expectations from the inside
• Existing relationships with Series B and C stage African fintech businesses that could represent near-term pipeline for the fund
• Experience sitting on portfolio company boards or in board observer roles
• Network within the investment community including family offices, impact investors and development finance institutions
• Francophone West Africa exposure - language, relationships or operating experience
• Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a fund build-out phase
 Base salary: Competitive, with a contractual step-up on first close. Discussed individually based on candidate profile.
 Carried interest: Meaningful participation in the fund's carried interest pool - structured with a 3-year cliff and ratable vesting over the fund life. Specific allocation discussed individually.
 Co-investment rights: The right to invest personally alongside the fund-on-fund terms.
 Title: Partner, Meravo Capital.
 Location: Flexible, with regular travel across target markets.
 Diversity & Inclusion
 Meravo Capital is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds regardless of gender, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, age or sexual orientation. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen decision-making and are essential to delivering sustainable impact across the markets in which we invest.

jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.description:
Investment Associate
 RemoteUnited States
 **** Cover Letter not required. But if you want to submit something, add something that shows who you are!****
 About MCJ
 MCJ is an early-stage venture capital firm supporting startups overriding critical bottlenecks in the physical economy — challenges made urgent by climate change, rising AI demand, and increasing geopolitical tensions. We focus on energy, infrastructure, and industrials, backing founders that see the next system first.
 The Role
 We’re hiring an Associate to join the MCJ investment team. This role will drive and scale MCJ’s sourcing engine. You’ll build and run the systems that find the earliest, most interesting founders in energy, infrastructure resilience, and industrial automation. You will also own thematic research end-to-end, and lean in on diligence work across our investment portfolio. You will be on the forefront of building AI tools and workflows that make MCJ faster and sharper.
 What You’ll Do
 Sourcing & Pipeline (50%)
 • Own MCJ’s proactive sourcing motion across our three mandates: firm power, operate-under-stress infrastructure, and industrial throughput
• Monitor research labs, DOE/ARPA-E grants, patent filings, university spinouts, and founder activity for pre-company and stealth-stage signals
• Build and maintain thematic pipeline maps (e.g. “every team working on microgrids,” “distributed energy storage networks”) and keep them current as the landscape shifts
• Run first conversations with founders and represent MCJ credibly in early outreach
 Tooling & Systems (25%)
 • Design and maintain the AI-enabled workflows that power sourcing and diligence — using tools like Claude, Harmonic, and others to structure messy datasets, monitor signals at scale, and cut manual research time
• Build lightweight internal tools/scripts/prompts that the investment team can reuse (e.g. competitive landscape generators, memo templates, screening frameworks)
• Start and scale lists, saved searches, and CRM pipeline data clean, current, and genuinely useful — not just maintained for its own sake
• Continuously evaluate new AI/data tools and bring the ones worth adopting into the team’s workflow
 Diligence Support (25%)
 • Partner with GPs on diligence for companies that clear the top of the funnel: market sizing, competitive landscape, reference calls, and technical/founder background checks
• Write clear internal memos on emerging themes, founder backgrounds, market shifts, and specific deal opportunities
• Help prepare materials for investment decision discussions and contribute a point of view, not just data
 Who You Are
 • Can be new to venture capital and startup operations in a professional capacity but have been following the space closely out of personal interest
• Technical background (CS, data engineering, physics, energy systems, materials science)
• Deeply involved in your university’s climate or energy clubs/groups as well as student venture initiatives
• Resourceful and self-directed; you don’t wait to be told where to look, but aren’t afraid to ask for help when you need it
• Genuine obsession with energy, climate tech, and industrial infrastructure — you read Canary Media, Heatmap, and Latitude Media, follow DOE funding announcements for fun, and of course frequently listen to Inevitable podcast!
• Strong builder instinct with software and data: comfortable navigating key databases (e.g., Pitchbook, Harmonic) with smart filtering, and excited to use AI tools to structure messy data and scale workflows rather than do everything by hand
• Excellent spoken and written communication — you can distill a complex deep-tech company into a clear, concise lunch-and-learn meeting, a memo, and you’re comfortable cold-emailing founders to get their attention
• Sound judgment: able to separate signal from noise and defend a point of view to a room of investors
• Experience building internal tools, scripts, or automations (even informally) to support a research or investment workflow
 Geography
 MCJ is a distributed team that primarily works remotely, but we have or are building hubs in geographies that are key to our sourcing engine, and this role needs to be in one of them. This includes: San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, Boston, and Austin.
 Interested in this job?
 Let the hiring team at MCJ contact you! Click I’m interested and enter your Linkedin profile and preferred contact information.

jobs.title: Investment Partner
jobs.description:
About Matrix 

As company builders turned investors, we know the startup ecosystem from all angles. We've been doing this for 40+ years and have seen many trends come and go. Our focus on company building and long-term relationships with founders endures—because we care about them and their success is ultimately what matters. We're excited by good ideas that, when supported properly, can make a big impact in the world. We find these ideas by rejecting conventional wisdom, spotting potential early, and having the conviction to back founders before it's evident to everyone else.

About the role  

We are looking to bring on an Investment Partner. In this role, you will source and evaluate technology startups for investment. Often, the company at that point will consist of little more than a founder with an idea or a prototype. We think those who do well in this job develop unique, high-trust relationships with strong founders. The Investment Partner will work side by side with each of the partners at Matrix, spending time to understand their areas of expertise and work to support them collectively. Additionally, you will be expected to form your own investment thesis, debate this thesis in the larger group, then engage, diligence, champion, advise, and help the highest-potential startups in that area. You should be extremely comfortable evaluating technology projects independently. We will teach you the rest – valuation metrics, term sheets, Board meetings, etc.

Our goal is that people who start in this role will over time grow into senior leaders in the firm.

jobs.title: Product Design Manager, Design Systems
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

 Lyft is looking for a Design Systems Manager to join Design Foundations, the infrastructure layer of Lyft's design organization. Design Systems at Lyft is an integral part of the overall user experience. Our design system spans product surfaces, marketing, and brand, officially known as the Lyft Product Language (LPL) and shipped directly to code. You'll own the craft and execution of that system, partner closely with design, engineering, and marketing, and lead Design systems work through a period of active global growth and capability expansion.

 This role reports to the Director of Design Foundations and works alongside a dedicated DPM and Engineering managers, and a tight-knit team of design systems practitioners.

 Responsibilities:

 Strategy & Vision 

• Set the strategy and roadmap for Lyft Product Language (LPL) across product, marketing, and brand surfaces, in partnership with the Director of Design Foundations and engineering leadership and the Design Systems team

• Lead the AI transformation of the system: integrate AI into LPL tooling, adoption workflows, and the day-to-day designer experience at Lyft

• Represent Design Systems in reviews and other senior leadership forums

 People & Craft 

• Manage and develop a team of design systems designers and illustrators working across iOS, Android, web, and brand

• Hold the quality bar for system-wide design: cross-platform coherence, accessibility (WCAG), road safety, localization, and brand consistency.

• Coach the team on making educated tradeoffs between flexibility, coherency, usability, and efficiency

 Execution & Partnership 

• Partner closely with the Design Systems DPM and engineering managers to maintain system health, sequence work, and unblock teams

• Own the LPL component contribution and review process end-to-end, from intake through release

• Communicate system decisions, adoption expectations, and quality standards upward and across product, engineering, and marketing

 Experience:

• 7+ years in product or brand design, including 2+ years managing designers

• Direct experience leading a design system at scale: components, patterns, guidelines, and shipped-to-code workflows

• Fluency across mobile and web platforms, with a working understanding of how systems are consumed by engineers

• Experience managing a design systems team

• Strong track record of partnership with engineering on architecture, releases, and quality

• Experience setting and defending craft standards across cross-functional stakeholders

• Familiarity with AI-assisted design tooling (Figma MCP, generative workflows, agentic prototyping) is a strong plus

• Excellent written communication; comfortable operating in an async-heavy environment with documented decisions

• Comfortable driving disagree-and-commit decisions and making tradeoffs in ambiguity

 Benefits: 

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

 Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

 Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

 The expected base pay range for this position in the New York City area is $176,000 - $220,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a senior to staff level product manager to join the team.

In this role, you'll be responsible for leading the development of products end-to-end, from conception through development and rollout. If you're excited to have a lot of ownership while remaining in the details day to day, this might be a great fit for you.

Linear is a product-led company that focuses on both building and selling. It's up to you to bring together the building and selling sides of the company in order to create something that our customers will love.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America or Europe time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Perform up-front discovery through user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, etc. and present findings to the team with conviction and rigor

 - Help engineers and designers deeply understand user needs, empowering them to make great product decisions

 - Craft messaging around upcoming features that resonates with users

 - Enable sales and marketing teams to effectively communicate with and win with customers

What we’re looking for

 - 6+ years experience in the software industry

 - Previous experience in engineering and/or design roles

 - Exceptional product and operational judgement

 - World-class design & product taste

 - Shameless curiosity, a propensity to question things deeply

 - Extreme speed and clarity

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco, CA
 Experience: 2–4 years
 Start: Immediate
 ABOUT LEONIS CAPITAL
 Leonis Capital is a research-driven pre-seed and seed venture fund based in Silicon Valley. We back technical founders before their markets become obvious, using research to build investment conviction ahead of consensus.
 Our portfolio includes Viktor, MaintainX, Motion, Spectro Cloud, Orchids, and other AI-native companies. Our research has been cited by Nature, The New York Times, Bloomberg, and CNBC, and HBS has profiled Leonis and our research-driven investment strategy.
 Research is not a marketing function at Leonis. It is how we invest. We build theses around emerging technical capabilities, publish research such as the Leonis AI 100, and have built our own research software, Leonis Alfa, to systematically track technical, talent, and commercial signals across the AI startup ecosystem.
 THE ROLE
 We are looking for an intellectually curious, technically minded Associate to join our investment team.
 You will work directly with Leonis's partners across the full investment lifecycle: finding exceptional founders, developing theses, conducting technical and commercial diligence, and forming investment decisions.
 You’ll operate as an internal researcher-investor: understanding technical shifts before they become market narratives and translating those insights into investment conviction.
 WHAT YOU’LL DO
 Find exceptional technical founders. Source emerging companies through technical communities, research, open-source ecosystems, data, networks, and events.
 Underwrite companies. Evaluate founders, markets, products, technical architectures, business models, competition, customers, and financing, and understand what technically has to be true for a company to win.
 Develop investment theses. Research emerging technologies and markets before they become consensus categories.
 Write. Contribute to investment memos and Leonis research, including projects such as the Leonis AI 100.
 Work directly with the partners. Participate across sourcing, diligence, investment decisions, and selected strategic initiatives with portfolio companies.
 YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU…
 Have 2–4 years of experience in startup ops, product, VC, or technical roles. Prior venture experience is useful but not required.
 Have a technical foundation. You may have studied computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or previously worked in engineering, technical product, data science, or research.
 Are research-driven and technically curious: you actually read research papers, open GitHub repos, or play with new tools before they become mainstream.
 Have high agency: you don’t wait for assignments; you generate them.
 Can form clear judgments from incomplete information and change your mind quickly when the evidence changes.
 Write clearly and think from first principles.
 WHY LEONIS
 Learn investing by doing it. Work directly with the partners from the first founder meeting through the investment decision.
 Build technical investing judgment. Learn to connect changes in AI research and engineering with company formation, markets, and venture outcomes.
 Build the firm with us. Leonis is still small enough that exceptional people can meaningfully shape how we research, invest, and operate.
 Take on real ownership. Strong performers can take increasing responsibility for sourcing, investments, and research over time.
 HOW TO APPLY
 Please send us four things:
 Your CV or LinkedIn.
 A link to something you've built or written.
 A 500-word investment memo. Pick a pre-seed or seed company you think Leonis should invest in. Tell us why, what the market is misunderstanding, and what technical assumption your thesis depends on. This should take under 60 minutes.
 A 150-word critique. Read the Leonis AI 100. Tell us one thing that's wrong with how it's built and what you'd do about it.
 Send everything to partners@leoniscap.com

jobs.title: National Accounts Associate, Broker Dealer Development
jobs.description:
The Company 

 InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. With over US$700 million in investments and 35+ portfolio companies including Palantir, Anthropic, SpaceX, Airbnb, SoFi, Spotify, DocuSign, and many more, we work with leading North American wealth management firms and family office clients to offer multi-position and single-purpose funds.

 InvestX is backed by leading financial institutions including Jefferies, Virtu Financial, and Canaccord Genuity and has been featured in CNBC, Forbes, Bloomberg, U.S. News, Business Insider, Reuters, The Globe and Mail, and other leading publications.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a driven, high-energy National Accounts, Associate to support the growth of InvestX's U.S. Broker Dealer distribution channel. This is a prospecting-heavy sales role for someone who enjoys opening doors, making cold calls, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified opportunities.

 Working closely with the National Accounts Lead, you will be responsible for building the top of the sales funnel across Broker Dealers and other wealth management firms throughout the U.S. You will research target firms, identify key contacts, execute outbound prospecting campaigns, secure meetings, and help move opportunities through the National Accounts pipeline and approval process.

 We're looking for a true hunter mentality: someone persistent, competitive, resourceful, comfortable hearing "no," and motivated by creating opportunities where relationships don't already exist.

 Location: United States (Remote) or Hybrid (3-days in office) New York

 What You'll Do 

 Prospect & Build Pipeline 

• Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into targeted Broker Dealers and wealth management firms across the U.S.

• Cold call, email, and leverage LinkedIn and other prospecting tools to identify and engage prospective National Accounts.

• Research target organizations and identify the right home office contacts, decision-makers, investment teams, due diligence professionals, and other key stakeholders.

• Secure qualified introductory meetings for the National Accounts Lead.

• Consistently build and maintain a strong pipeline of new opportunities.

• Follow up persistently and creatively to turn initial outreach into active conversations.

• Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts, opportunities, and next steps within Salesforce.

 Support National Accounts 

• Partner closely with the National Accounts Lead to prioritize target firms and execute the broader National Accounts strategy.

• Prepare research, meeting materials, prospect intelligence, and follow-up for prospective accounts.

• Support opportunities from initial outreach through due diligence and platform approval.

• Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and Sales throughout the approval and onboarding process.

• Track account progress, outstanding requirements, and next steps to keep opportunities moving.

• Support ongoing engagement with home office contacts, investment committees, due diligence teams, and other stakeholders.

 Develop Market Intelligence 

• Build a strong understanding of the Broker Dealer and wealth management landscape.

• Monitor competitor activity, platform developments, and trends in private markets and alternative investments.

• Gather market feedback on InvestX's products, positioning, and advisor demand.

• Identify new firms, contacts, and opportunities that should be added to the National Accounts pipeline.

 What We're Looking For 

• 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.

• Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting, cold calling, and generating qualified sales opportunities.

• Comfortable spending a significant portion of the day actively prospecting and engaging new contacts.

• A natural hunter who is energized by building relationships from scratch rather than solely managing established accounts.

• Persistent and resilient—you are comfortable with rejection and know consistent follow-up is part of successful sales.

• Strong communication skills and confidence engaging senior investment and wealth management professionals.

• Curious and resourceful, with the ability to research organizations and find the right path into an account.

• Highly organized with strong CRM and pipeline management discipline.

• Self-directed and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

• Collaborative and comfortable supporting a senior National Accounts leader while taking ownership of your prospecting activity and results.

 Nice to Have 

• Existing relationships within the Broker Dealer, RIA, or broader wealth management ecosystem.

• Experience with private equity, private credit, venture capital, hedge funds, or alternative investment products.

• Familiarity with Broker Dealer due diligence and platform approval processes.

• Experience using Salesforce and sales prospecting platforms.

• FINRA Series 7 and 63 or willingness to obtain relevant licensing.

 What Success Looks Like 

 Success in this role will be measured primarily by your ability to create qualified opportunities and expand the National Accounts pipeline, including:

• Consistent outbound prospecting activity and new account penetration.

• Qualified meetings generated with targeted firms.

• Growth of the National Accounts pipeline for new Broker Dealers

• Conversion of prospects into active due diligence and approval opportunities.

• Progression of firms through the approval process.

• Strong CRM discipline and consistent follow-through.

• Contribution to new platform approvals and, ultimately, asset growth.

 Salary & Benefits   

• 2026 base salary range is $130,000 - $160,000 USD plus incentive plan and equity.  

• Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, location, and qualifications for the role.    

• Comprehensive Health & Benefit plan. 

 If this opportunity sounds like it is a good match with your skills, background and career direction, please apply through our Careers Page ( https://www.investx.com/careers/ )
with your cover letter and resume.  

 InvestX   welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples, Indigenous peoples, visible minorities, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Through direct investments, venture funds, and strategic support, IW helps launch and scale high-growth technology companies. IW also manages Riverfront Ventures (RFV), a venture capital fund focused on supporting promising startups and accelerating regional innovation. 
 The Role

 The Investment Associate works closely with the CEO and Senior Investment Associate to evaluate new investment opportunities, manage portfolio data and reporting, coordinate diligence processes, and support investor engagement. The role offers broad exposure to venture investing and the opportunity to work with founders, investors, and ecosystem partners shaping the future of the Pittsburgh technology economy.

 Data & Market Research

 Qualifications

jobs.title: Innovation Product Manager
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

This role blends elements of product management, innovation strategy, solutions design, and forward-deployed partnership. You’ll work directly with leading law firms and corporate legal teams to translate messy, high-value legal work into AI-powered workflows — and ensure they succeed in production.

We don’t build software for lawyers; we build it with them. Our teams sit shoulder-to-shoulder with partners, associates, innovation groups, and CIOs to understand problems at depth, design first-of-kind workflows, and ship products that reshape how legal work gets done.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Serve as a thought partner to top global law firms and enterprises — diagnosing pain points, mapping high-value opportunities, and guiding how Harvey integrates into their practice.

 - Work with the go-to-market team to shape pilots and deployments end-to-end: discovery, workflow design, testing, onboarding, iteration, and firm-wide rollout.

 - Work with innovation leaders, legal operations, and practice groups alongside Customer Success — ensuring the platform becomes embedded in day-to-day legal work

 - Translate user insights into product direction to influence roadmap

 - Help clients evaluate the business impact of AI — from improving associate leverage to transforming workflows across practices like M&A, litigation, regulatory, and transactions.

 - Shape how the legal industry adapts to AI. You’ll be in the room where the new operating model of law is being defined.




WHAT YOU HAVE

You come from the legal world, but you’ve always gravitated toward innovation, experimentation, and systems thinking. You’ve seen how complex legal work happens in practice — and you’re excited to redesign it with cutting-edge AI.

You’ll thrive here if you:

 - Have experience at a top law firm or in-house legal team; innovation, legal ops, or consulting experience is a plus.

 - Familiarity with the legal tech ecosystem as an employee, founder, or advisor to legal tech startups

 - Are product-savvy and tech-curious. You’re not expected to code, but you can navigate conversations about generative AI, workflow design, privacy, governance, and enterprise rollout.

 - Communicate with clarity and confidence across roles — partners, associates, engineers, PMs, CIOs, and legal ops.

 - Can independently run multiple client engagements in parallel.

 - Care deeply about quality and user outcomes while keeping a strong bias for action.

 - Are energized by building something new in a domain going through its biggest shift in decades.

 For over forty years, HarbourVest has been home to a committed team of professionals with an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to deliver impactful solutions to our clients and investing partners. As our global firm grows, we continue to add individuals who seek a collaborative, open-door culture that values diversity and innovative thinking.
 In our collegial environment that’s marked by low turnover and high energy, you’ll be inspired to grow and thrive. Here, you will be encouraged to build on your strengths and acquire new skills and experiences.
 We are committed to fostering an environment of inclusion that promotes mutual respect among all employees. Understanding and valuing these differences optimizes the potential of both the individual and the firm.
 HarbourVest is an equal opportunity employer.
 This position will be a hybrid work arrangement. You will receive 18 remote workdays per quarter to use at your discretion, subject to manager approval. For example, you may choose to work in the office 4 days per week and take one remote day weekly (typically 13 weeks per quarter), leaving 5 additional remote days to be used as needed.
 HarbourVest is currently seeking candidates for our pre-MBA Associate program in the Primary Investment Group in Boston, MA. Our Associate program is designed to offer a unique experience within the private markets that will propel your career in the Private Equity and Venture Capital industry. After training, Associates will be an integral part of HarbourVest’s Primary Team, conducting due diligence on Private Equity and Venture Capital managers and fund opportunities alongside collaborative deal teams.
 As an Associate, you will be responsible for evaluating fund investment opportunities across the Venture Capital, Growth Equity and Private Equity markets, across a variety of sectors.  The ideal candidate is someone who has: 
 • Strong work ethic and ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment

• Proven leadership skills and ability to succeed working independently and in collaborative teams

• Strong quantitative skills with deep experience in Excel

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

• High level of maturity with ability to multi-task

 What you bring:

• Excellent written and verbal communications skills

 Education Preferred

jobs.title: Product Design Manager, Payroll
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, New York, United States; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto 

 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

 About Design at Gusto: 

 Design at Gusto is made up of over 80 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees. We're a cross-functional group that is always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use Gusto. We don't care much about swim lanes and though we care deeply about quality and craft, we are never precious about it. We work closely with cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to design, build, and ship experiences that make a real difference. We believe great design can make hard things possible, even delightful.

 We are building an AI-native design organization — and we mean that seriously. We're looking for designers who are already working this way: using AI to prototype ideas quickly, shorten customer feedback loops, and ship quality UX directly to customers. This isn't a future aspiration — it's how we work now, and it's changing what the design role looks like at Gusto and across the industry.

 About the Role: 

 For the hundreds of thousands of small businesses we serve, our mission starts with one of their most critical responsibilities: paying their team. Getting payroll right isn’t just a feature—it’s the foundation of trust with every business that relies on us. 

 As the Product Design Manager for Payroll, you'll lead design in this senior level position for one of Gusto's most complex and consequential product areas, shaping the future of a product that millions of people rely on for financial stability and personal prosperity. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with broad scope. You'll manage a team of designers and set the UX direction for Payroll, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, Ops, Compliance, and others to take on payroll complexity so our customers don't have to. 

 Your work will include simplifying complex, reciprocal workflows, defining a long-term UX vision and rallying others around it, and leading automation and AI initiatives that make the work of paying a team disappear. You'll also mentor designers, set the quality and judgment standard for AI-assisted design work across the broader Design team, and contribute to platform standards that help others across Gusto build consistent, high-quality experiences. 

 About the Team: 

 Payroll is the foundation of Gusto and our most-used, most-loved product. It’s the first Gusto experience many customers interact with, and it continues to power their success as they grow. Payroll also underpins our broader ecosystem, enabling the adoption of Benefits, Time Tracking, HR tools, and so much more. Our team is tasked with evolving and scaling this core experience for small businesses of all sizes, from solo entrepreneurs to growing companies. We focus on taking on the complexity of payroll so our customers don’t have to—making payroll faster, more flexible, and increasingly hands off. 

 Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: 

• 
 Lead end-to-end design for Payroll — shaping experiences that help small businesses pay their teams correctly, on time, and with confidence. 

• 
 Define and communicate the long-term UX vision for Payroll, and rally multiple teams around it. 

• 
 Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Ops and others to set strategy and roadmaps. 

• 
 Lead product initiatives where AI and automation are central to the user experience, simplifying payroll and reducing manual work without compromising accuracy or trust. 

• 
 Collaborate with Research and Data to uncover customer insights and translate them into clear, actionable UX priorities. 

• 
 Influence product and technical roadmaps by advocating for design quality, customer needs, and long-term system health. 

• 
 Set the quality and judgment standard for all design work — whether AI-assisted or not — including when to push further and when outputs meet the bar. 

• 
 Define and scale shared patterns, principles, and standards that promote quality, consistency, and velocity. 

• 
 Manage and grow a team of designers, providing mentorship, clear direction, and hands-on support across the team. 

• 
 Champion the Payroll experience as the foundation of Gusto's broader People Platform, ensuring seamless integration across Benefits, Time & Attendance, and third-party tools. 

 Here’s what we're looking for: 

• 
 8–10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading and managing design teams. 

• 
 Experience designing in complex domains i.e. financial products, healthcare, or similarly regulated environments. 

• 
 Experience setting UX direction across multiple teams and influencing product strategy — not just executing on it. 

• 
 Experience leading product initiatives where AI or automation is central to the user experience — including how to represent uncertainty, surface errors gracefully, and preserve user agency when automation gets it wrong, particularly in high-stakes contexts. 

• 
 Demonstrated ability to assess AI-generated design directions: knowing when to use them, when to override them, and how to raise the quality bar on AI outputs. 

• 
 Proven ability to drive alignment across cross-functional partners and represent design in high-stakes, strategic conversations. 

• 
 Deep systems thinking, with a track record of turning interconnected, complex workflows into experiences that feel simple and intuitive. 

• 
 Experience leading a team through an AI workflow transition — not just adopting AI personally, but changing how a team works, including establishing new norms and standards. 

• 
 Clear, direct communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and influence partners at all levels. 

• 
 A genuine bond to Gusto's mission and the needs of small businesses. 

 Compensation Details:

 At Gusto, we strive to provide rewards that empower employees to achieve their financial and personal goals. We offer competitive compensation packages with a strong emphasis on equity based compensation (ownership in Gusto). To learn more about Gusto’s compensation philosophy and benefits offerings please view our Total Rewards Approach page.

 Our cash compensation range for this role is $172,000/yr to $215,000/yr in Denver & most remote locations, and $202,000/yr to $253,000/yr in San Francisco, Seattle & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
 
 Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale. 

 Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas. 

 When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

 Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.  

 Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you. 

 Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer .

 Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to  Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice .

jobs.title: Investment Associate – Healthcare Impact VC
jobs.description:
About GHIC 

 The Global Health Investment Corporation (GHIC) is a healthcare impact venture firm focused on investing in transformational technologies and products that will enable a healthier world and safer future for all. A pioneer of impact investing in global health, GHIC has been financing innovation in public health for over a decade.

 GHIC manages the Global Health Security Fund (GHSF), a $353M venture fund launched in partnership with BARDA (Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority), part of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, and a group of mission-aligned investors including CEPI, Flu Lab, and Eli Lilly and Company to accelerate the development of technologies that address public health emergencies, such as pandemics and other health security threats.
 About the Role 

 We are looking for an Associate to join our investment team in New York City. As an Associate, you will source, evaluate, and execute investment opportunities and deeply understand the health security landscape across diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, medical devices, health tech, and biomanufacturing, as well as chemical, biologic, radiologic and nuclear health security events. We offer a flexible work environment, a diverse set of projects, and a best-in-class peer group to learn from. You will collaborate with GHIC's network across government, industry, and the scientific community to identify and support high-impact technologies. This is a unique opportunity to back medical countermeasures and enabling technologies that deliver both public health impact and commercial returns, using the tools of venture investing.
 Responsibilities 

 • Screen and source investment opportunities
• Analyze preclinical and clinical data
• Conduct interviews with subject matter experts and key opinion leaders
• Construct market and company valuation models
• Support negotiation and closing of new investments
• Track progress of portfolio companies post-investment
• Research GHIC's areas of interest to inform and develop investment theses
• Collaborate with the broader GHIC team to provide organizational support as needed
 Qualifications and Required Skills 

 • B.S. in life sciences or related field; an M.D. or Ph.D. is preferred but not a requirement
• 2+ years of work experience in a life sciences sell side, buy side, or consulting role

 This is primarily a deal-focused role; the person will be vital to the successful planning and execution of Generate’s capital formation strategy. They will be closely involved in capital raises for Generate, the optimization of the company’s capital stack and cost of capital, and interfacing with current and prospective investors, banks, and other capital providers.
 This role will work across capital markets functions, offering the individual exposure to a diversity of transaction types, asset classes, sustainable infrastructure markets, and corporate roles. No one day will be the same.
 What you will be doing at Generate Capital as an Associate, Capital Markets: 
 • Work as part of a small but growing team responsible for capital formation analysis, planning, strategy and execution

• Support capital formation activities at the corporate, HoldCo, SPV, and portfolio levels, including raising equity, term loans / bonds, credit facilities, and other types of capital facilities

• Prepare materials presented to investors, lenders, banks, advisors, rating agencies and other external constituents for specific due diligence and ongoing reporting processes

• Build sophisticated financial models in support of capital formation priorities

• Lead / support due diligence processes to help financing counterparties understand Generate’s business and assets

• Contribute to M&A and valuation analyses and processes

• Build, expand and maintain relationships with different types of existing and prospective capital partners, investment banks, and other market participants

• Prepare analysis and materials presented internally pertaining to capital formation activity and planning, in addition to investor, management and board-level presentations

• Contribute to the corporate financial model, ensuring it reflects the most up-to-date financing plans at the project, SPV, and corporate level

• Partner cross-functionally with our development, acquisitions, finance, and asset management teams to drive strategy and optimize tactics as it relates to capital markets

• Support prospective and current investor-facing activity and events

• Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the Company’s internal reporting software platform and be able to efficiently generate needed data requests and reporting

• Keep up with relevant industry trends and information through research reports and issuer pricing releases

jobs.title: Associate, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About General Atlantic 

 General Atlantic is a leading global investor with more than four and a half decades of experience providing capital and strategic support for over 885 companies throughout its history. Established in 1980, General Atlantic continues to be a dedicated partner to visionary founders and investors seeking to build dynamic businesses and create lasting value. Guided by the conviction that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change, the firm combines a collaborative global approach, sector specific expertise, a long-term investment horizon, and a deep understanding of growth drivers to partner with and scale innovative businesses around the world. The firm leverages its patient capital, operational expertise, and global platform to support a diversified investment platform spanning Growth Equity, Infrastructure, and Strategic Solutions. General Atlantic manages approximately $126 billion in assets under management, inclusive of all strategies, as of March 31, 2026, with more than 900 professionals in 20 countries across five regions. For more information on General Atlantic, please visit www.generalatlantic.com. 

 General Atlantic Life Sciences Practice 

 The GA Life Sciences practice provides capital and strategic support for development stage biopharma companies, with an established track record across public and private investments. The Life Sciences team focuses on novel therapies that provide substantial patient benefit and have the potential to redefine standards of care. GA’s differentiated approach to life sciences is characterized by highly thematic investing, scaling significant capital into companies as they advance through clinical development and commercialization, and partnering with management teams to generate value. Investments include Akero Therapeutics (acquired by Novo Nordisk), Karuna Therapeutics (acquired by BMS), Cincor Pharma (acquired by AstraZeneca), and Centessa Pharmaceuticals (potential acquisition by Eli Lilly).

 Position Summary 

 General Atlantic is seeking a Life Sciences investor to join our New York‑based investment team. This role will have exposure to all parts of the investment process, including evaluating new investment opportunities and investment themes in biopharma and life science companies, conducting technical diligence, supporting deal execution, and working with portfolio companies. The ideal candidate will have a scientific background (MD or PhD) and at least two years of relevant industry experience, with the goal of driving strategic growth and generating value for the firm’s portfolio.

 Responsibilities 

• Source, evaluate, and recommend investment opportunities in drug development / biopharmaceutical companies including development and ownership of thematic focus areas

• Support scientific and clinical due diligence, integrating preclinical data, clinical trial results, regulatory strategy, and market dynamics into investment recommendations

• Develop and present rigorous investment theses to senior stakeholders, including the global Investment Committee

• Contribute across the full deal process, including coordination of third-party scientific advisors, KOLs, and commercial consultants

• Monitor portfolio companies and support the GA team’s efforts in capital allocation and value creation

• Leverage clinical and industry networks to generate proprietary deal flow and market intelligence

• Collaborate with professionals across the firm and foster exceptional knowledge-sharing

 Qualifications 

• MD or PhD in relevant scientific field (molecular biology, genetics, biology, chemistry, etc.)

• 2-5 years of post-graduate school professional experience, including at least 2 years of relevant experience in the life sciences sector (e.g., life sciences investing, life sciences strategy consulting, life sciences equity research / investment banking, biopharma operating role)

• Ability to analyze and integrate data from various sources into investment recommendations, including preclinical and clinical data, FDA/regulatory correspondence, and market research

• Strong foundation in financial modeling with a demonstrated commitment to deepening analytical expertise

• Passion for primary scientific literature, including scientific/medical meetings and conferences

• High degree of familiarity with drug development and regulatory processes

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize and present complex information clearly

• Demonstrated maturity and professional presence; comfortable interacting with senior executives and management teams

• Highly motivated, inquisitive, and a positive, can-do attitude

• Ability to take ownership, work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

 GA Value 

 General Atlantic offers a robust reward program to all employees that will support you and your family, maintaining fulfilling, secure and healthy lives now and into the future, which includes but is not limited to medical insurance, retirement savings contributions, mental and physical health resources and an equal pay program that allows you to earn a base salary of $150,000 –160,000   of which the exact amount offered will be driven by the degree to which you meet role requirements, additional special skills and experience.  Additional reward programs, such as annual discretionary bonuses and long-term incentive programs, are available for eligible employees and are offered as recognition for performance and one’s contributions towards the organization’s success.
