jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.description:
About Frontier Ventures
 Frontier Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm investing in Artificial Intelligence companies with network effects in the U.S. We partner with ambitious founders building technology companies with the potential to become global category leaders, typically first investing at the Seed and Series A stages.
 Our investment approach combines rigorous financial and commercial analysis with a deep understanding of technology. We believe that evaluating the next generation of AI companies requires investors who can understand not only markets and business models, but also products, technical architectures, data, and the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
 We are looking for an Investment Associate who brings that combination of technical and financial experience.
 The Role
 The Investment Associate will work closely with the Frontier Ventures investment team across the full investment lifecycle, from identifying promising companies and developing investment theses through diligence, execution, and portfolio support.
 This is a highly analytical and entrepreneurial role for someone who is equally comfortable evaluating a software architecture, discussing a product with a technical founder, analyzing a market, and building an investment case.
 Key Responsibilities
 Investment sourcing and market research
 • Identify and develop relationships with exceptional founders building early-stage AI and software companies.
• Proactively source investment opportunities through founder networks, accelerators, universities, technical communities, investors, and industry research.
• Develop investment theses around emerging areas of AI, software infrastructure, applications, and new technology-enabled business models.
• Track important technical developments, new companies, funding activity, and competitive dynamics across the AI ecosystem.
 Investment analysis and due diligence
 • Evaluate potential investments across product, technology, team, market, business model, competition, traction, and financial performance.
• Conduct technical diligence on software and AI companies, including assessing product architecture, technical differentiation, data advantages, scalability, and defensibility.
• Assess whether technology represents a durable competitive advantage or can be readily replicated.
• Analyze market size, customer economics, growth, retention, unit economics, and potential network effects.
• Build financial and operating models where appropriate.
• Conduct customer, founder, expert, and reference calls.
• Prepare investment memoranda and present recommendations to the investment team.
 Deal execution
 • Support the investment team throughout the transaction process, including diligence management, financial analysis, valuation, capitalization analysis, and transaction documentation.
• Maintain clear and rigorous documentation of investment opportunities and decision-making.
 Portfolio support
 • Work with portfolio company founders on strategic projects including market analysis, fundraising, business development, recruiting, and international expansion.
• Monitor portfolio company operating and financial performance.
• Help portfolio companies prepare for subsequent financing rounds and connect them with relevant investors, customers, partners, and industry experts.
 Building Frontier Ventures
 • Contribute to the development of Frontier Ventures' investment strategy and sector perspectives.
• Help improve internal investment processes, data infrastructure, research tools, and sourcing systems.
• Represent Frontier Ventures within the startup, technology, and venture capital communities.

jobs.title: Support & Marketing Associate for Startup Accelerator
jobs.description:
Location: Remote 
Job Type: Full-Time 
Salary: [Competitive – Based on Experience] 

 About the Founder Institute:  

 The Founder Institute (FI) is a global network of startup incubators, accelerators, and investors on a mission to activate and empower communities of entrepreneurs worldwide.

 Since 2009, we’ve helped launch over 8,000 companies in 200+ cities globally, which have raised nearly $2BN in funding. We are based in Silicon Valley and have remote team members across the United States, Europe, India, and Brazil. Our success has been documented in the New York Times , BusinessWeek , Forbes , TechCrunch , and more.

 About the Role: 

 We are seeking a Support & Marketing Associate with a passion for startups and entrepreneurship to join our team. 

 You will have the opportunity to see entrepreneurship and venture capital from many angles, and work for a company with a small and mission-driven team. 

 This role is 100% remote, and will require a Sunday-Thursday workweek. 

 Our Culture: 

 At the Founder Institute, we work a lot like the early-stage startups we support. That means things move fast, and we thrive on creativity, ownership, and a “let’s figure it out” mindset. Here’s what we look for in our team:

• You’re naturally entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and enjoy tackling challenges head-on.

• You prefer autonomy over hand-holding and don’t need a lot of oversight to get things done.

• You love learning new things, and when you hit a roadblock, your first instinct is to dig in, research, and find a solution—Google is your best friend.

• You’re open to feedback (even when it’s tough), and always looking to grow and improve—both personally and as part of the team.

 If that sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you. If not, no hard feelings—this kind of environment isn’t for everyone. 

 Still with us? Great—read on for more details!

 Key Responsibilities: 

• Customer Support & Engagement: Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, offering personalized assistance and proactive support.

• Assist with Program Admissions: Review applications to FI incubation and acceleration programs, and follow best practices for acceptance.

• Improve the Customer Experience: As our “feet on the ground”, your ideas will play a critical role in our ability to improve our customer experience.

• Host Live Q&A Calls: Host scheduled Q&A sessions with customers, addressing their concerns and providing expert guidance on our products/services.

• Host Info-Session Webinars: Conduct and facilitate informative webinars to educate customers on key topics, program qualities, and best practices.

• Improve Conversion & Retention:  Coordinate with the design and product teams to improve the usability and conversion of the website and overall conversion rate optimization (CRO). Coordinate with the marketing team on initiatives to increase conversion and retention.

• Improve Site and Email Copy: Update and improve copy across our marketing materials to properly address the changing needs of our customers.

• Maintain Organized Documentation & Processes: Track customer interactions, document frequently asked questions, and provide feedback to improve processes. 

 Qualifications and Skills: 

 Required: 

• Willing to work a Sunday-Thursday schedule

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Business-level fluency in English

• Comfort in hosting live calls and webinars

• Internet and computer-savvy

 Preferred: 

• Knowledge of startup accelerators and the startup/ venture capital industry

• 2+ years of professional customer service and/or marketing experience

• Experience using Google Suite, Powerpoint, Excel, Canva, Mailchimp, and various online CRM and marketing tool

 What We Offer: 

• Great upward mobility into a larger, conversion-focused marketing role (all senior team members at FI have grown into their roles from inside the company) 

• Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.

• Unlimited PTO

• Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with the autonomy to drive results in your own style.

• 
 Ability to learn from top entrepreneurs, investors, and executives throughout FI’s global network and suite of acceleration programs. 

 IMPORTANT: In your Cover Letter please write two paragraphs, the first on why you would like to work in the startup accelerator industry, and the second on how your personality fits well with the FI culture described above. Applications without this Cover Letter will be ignored.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Integrations
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us 

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 About the Role 

 The Product Manager, Integrations you will have ownership of a portfolio connectors and analytical use cases at Fivetran. Your vision, execution, and collaboration towards business-critical goals creates successful products that make analysts more productive and look like superheroes to their teams. 

 This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. The successful candidate must be able to work with overlap with US EST and PST time zones.

 What You’ll Do 

• Manage a portfolio of products and contribute to strategic decisions on growing and improving that portfolio, including optimizing revenue.

• Build the vision, strategy and roadmap for your portfolio.

• Learn what questions analysts are trying to answer, decide what data sources they need and design great data schemas to drive analytical success.

• Ensure we prioritize the most important product improvements.

• Collaborate with analytics to create reporting and ad hoc analysis using the data available and in collaboration with our key business partners.

• Work directly with multiple engineering teams and our operations teams to ensure Fivetran is delivering the highest quality data possible.

• Your guiding metric will be the Revenue Weighted Usage of your portfolio of products.

 You will play a key role in the growing and adoption of Fivetran's SaaS Connector Portfolio

 Skills We’re Looking For 

• Strong SQL skills

• Previous experience working as a product manager preferably for B2B SaaS products

• Proven track record of shipping data products that deliver measurable results.

• Proven ability to develop deep customer empathy and articulate customer problems.

• Demonstrated experience using data and analytical abilities to help solve problems and make decisions.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate with a talented team of engineers and designers.

• Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills with a confirmed ability to influence partners.

• High technical and analytical acumen.

• Embody team values of Curiosity, Ownership, Collaboration, Kindness, and Integrity

• A deep sense of empathy for the customer, ensuring that all solutions are customer-focused and deliver significant value.

jobs.title: Visiting Associate (Munich or Remote) - 6-12 months from October 2026
jobs.description:
About First Momentum Ventures 

 We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds , backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing.

 With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon , we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects.

 Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe . We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply . We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside.

 The Role 

 As a Visiting Associate , you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates.

 This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup , land a full-time VC role , or start their own company down the road.

 Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup , or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe .

 Tasks

• Find the most promising tech founders in Europe: Take the lead in sourcing high-potential pre-seed startups, running first calls independently, and developing your own conviction about which founders and ideas are truly exciting.

• Gain full exposure to the investment process: Work side-by-side with our investment team through the entire deal flow, from first contact and due diligence to investment committee and closing. You'll play a key role in evaluating opportunities and shaping investment decisions.

• Lead deep-dive research: Explore emerging technologies and market trends every week. Conduct sharp, data-driven analysis and present insights that influence our investment theses and strategic direction.

• Drive impact in portfolio projects: Support our portfolio founders hands-on, from building their go-to-market motion to automating workflows with AI and optimizing operations.

 Requirements

• You have 1-3 years of work experience in the startup ecosystem, consulting, or a technical role.

• You bring strong analytical capabilities and can move from technical papers to business models to founder conversations with ease.

• You work with extreme ownership and high agency, spotting opportunities, designing a plan, and executing without waiting for permission.

• You're genuinely curious about deeply technical domains. Whether you have an engineering background or just love learning how breakthrough technologies work, you're energized by technical depth.

• You communicate clearly and convincingly in both German and English, whether you're pitching a deal to partners or giving feedback to founders.

 Benefits

• Real ownership, not busy work : You'll make independent calls on deals, lead founder conversations, support DD processes end-to-end, and help drive critical projects for our portfolio companies.

• Technical depth you won't find elsewhere : Most of our team are engineers and scientists, which lets you develop a genuine understanding of breakthrough technologies, not just assessment skills.

• Exceptional colleagues who challenge you : Work alongside a team that values rigorous debate, mutual support, and winning together. You'll become part of the First Momentum family, even beyond your time with us.

• Full venture stack visibility : See everything from AI-powered sourcing to automated portfolio support. Gain the whole picture of how a leading European Deep Tech fund operates.

• Full flexibility with a remote-first culture balanced by regular in-person gatherings across Europe.

• Competitive pay: The compensation package will be adjusted to your professional experience and will be well above an internship salary.

• The perfect launchpad for your next move : Whether you're heading toward a full-time VC role, a Chief of Staff position in our portfolio, or eventually starting your own venture, this position sets you up for what's next.

 We're looking for candidates available for 6-12 months, starting January 2027.

jobs.title: Venture Scout (Remote in Europe)
jobs.description:
About First Momentum Ventures 

 We're building one of Europe's most distinctive early-stage venture funds. As students, we've deployed two funds (now totaling €35m) into ~50 pre-seed Deep Tech companies across Europe. Our portfolio has raised follow-on funding from top-tier European and US investors.

 Today, we're a community of over 100 (mostly technical) scouts, founders, and operators who help us identify the best technical founders before anyone else does. We accept only 1 in 15 applicants; this isn't just another community. We operate under clear rules that ensure everyone is committed, and we kindly offboard those here only for the VC tag.

 Note: This is an unpaid role with performance-based referral bounties for successful investments.

 Tasks

 What You'll Do 

 Source breakthrough companies. Connect us to the most promising technical founders in your ecosystem, people building in labs, at hackathons, in research groups, or launching their first startup.

 Represent us locally. Attend events, universities, and accelerators where technical founders gather. Make it easy for them to find us.

 Share your expertise. When we evaluate companies in your domain, semicon, robotics, climate tech, AI infrastructure, we'll tap your technical knowledge and ecosystem insights.

 Contribute to portfolio success. Our scouts don't just source deals. They actively support our portfolio companies through introductions, domain expertise, and ecosystem connections.

 Shape our strategy. Help us understand your local scene: which research is commercializing, which founders are worth watching, which technologies are gaining momentum.

 Requirements

 Who Thrives in This Role 

 You're technically fluent, whether as a CS/engineering student, PhD researcher, startup operator, or technical founder. You can have credible conversations with deeply technical people.

 You're embedded in a European tech ecosystem, connected to a university, research institution, or startup community. You know who's building what.

 You're genuinely curious about Deep Tech or industrial innovation. You follow research, products, and companies in areas such as TechBio, Energy, Manufacturing, and developer tools.

 You're entrepreneurial and self-directed . You create opportunities, follow through, and take ownership of your impact.

 You want to learn how early-stage investing works, and you're willing to put in the work.

 Benefits

 What You'll Gain 

 Real VC experience. See how deals happen from sourcing through investment decisions. Join workshops on term sheets, technical diligence, and portfolio support.

 A powerful network. Build relationships with founders, investors, and fellow scouts across Europe that compound over time.

 Domain expertise. Go deep on emerging technologies through deal reviews and virtual sessions.

 Career acceleration. Many scouts join startups, launch companies, or build VC careers. This role opens doors.

 Community access. Join a European community of technical builders and attend startup events where the most interesting work happens.

 Chapter Lead Opportunities 

 High-performing scouts can grow into Chapter Lead roles at their university or city. Chapter Leads take on additional responsibility:

• Recruit strategically. Build a scout presence across relevant faculties and fill gaps when scouts move on

• Foster community. Organize one meetup per quarter to keep your local scout network engaged

• Support events. Work with the First Momentum team to bring startup events to your ecosystem

 F6 Ventures is seeking an Investment Associate in Amman, Jordan to support the investment activities across sourcing, evaluation, execution, portfolio management, and fund operations. This entails having an active role throughout the investment lifecycle, from identifying promising startups and conducting due diligence to supporting portfolio companies and contributing to fundraising and investor relations activities. We’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical and financial skills with curiosity and a passion for entrepreneurship and innovation.
 Key Responsibilities
 Deal Sourcing & Investment Evaluation
 • Source and evaluate potential investment opportunities across priority sectors and markets.
• Build and maintain a strong network within the startup, investment, and innovation ecosystem.
• Conduct market research, competitive analysis, financial modeling, valuation, and due diligence activities.
• Participate in founder meetings and assess investment opportunities.
• Prepare clear and concise investment memos and presentations for management and the Investment Committee.
 Transaction Execution
 • Support deal structuring, negotiations, legal documentation review, and transaction execution.
• Coordinate with founders, legal counsel, co-investors, and other stakeholders throughout the investment process.
• Manage investment opportunities from initial evaluation through closing.
 Portfolio Management
 • Monitor portfolio company performance and track key operational and financial KPIs.
• Prepare portfolio reviews, investment updates, and performance reports.
• Support portfolio companies in fundraising, strategic initiatives, and growth opportunities.
• Evaluate follow-on investment opportunities and prepare investment recommendations.
 Fund Operations & Ecosystem Engagement

• Maintain investment records, portfolio databases, and reporting systems.
• Represent F6 Ventures at ecosystem events and contribute to strengthening the firm's presence.
 Required Qualifications

• 3–5 years of relevant experience in venture capital, private equity or investment banking.
• Strong financial modeling, valuation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic.
• Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to effectively leverage AI and technology tools to enhance research, analysis, and productivity.

 What We Offer

• Opportunity to work alongside exceptional founders, investors, and ecosystem leaders.
• Hands-on involvement across the full investment lifecycle.
• A dynamic, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven work environment.

jobs.title: Associate
jobs.description:
Engine Ventures 

 Engine Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm investing in foundational technologies that will define the next several decades of industry. We focus on sectors including compute, AI, energy systems, advanced manufacturing, robotics, biology, and infrastructure. 

 Since 2016, we have invested in over 70 companies building category-defining businesses. Our portfolio includes companies advancing core infrastructure for energy and compute, such as Celestial AI and Commonwealth Fusion Systems, alongside companies applying interdisciplinary approaches to disrupt conventional markets in critical minerals, fuels, and biomanufacturing. Together, these investments reflect the breadth of our focus across both digital and physical systems. We partner with ambitious founders tackling technically complex problems with the potential for large-scale impact. 

 We operate from Cambridge, MA, one of the world’s most concentrated ecosystems of research and innovation. 

 The Role  

 Engine Ventures is seeking an Associate to join our investment team. This is a core investing role at a moment of significant technological inflection across AI systems, compute infrastructure, energy, physical AI, and many other interconnected systems. 

 The Associate will work directly with founders and company leaders across stages, from early formation through growth. The role centers on identifying, evaluating, and supporting high-potential companies in technically complex domains, from next-generation semiconductors to grid-scale energy to programmable biology. 

 This position requires strong technical fluency, sound judgment, and intellectual range. The strongest candidates are able to analyze complex systems, develop independent perspectives on emerging markets, and assess both technical differentiation and commercial viability. They are motivated by investing as a craft and are comfortable operating in ambiguity. 

 Associates at Engine are deeply involved in the full investment process. You will work on diligence efforts and engage with portfolio companies on key strategic questions as they grow. 

 Key Responsibilities

• 
 Perform due diligence, including scientific, technical, and commercial assessment of investment opportunities, and compose investment memorandums. 

• 
 Develop and maintain a broad network of researchers and entrepreneurs to identify new investment areas and opportunities. 

• 
 Discuss, evaluate, and present new investment opportunities within a flat structure in weekly investment team meetings. 

• 
 Work alongside Partners to structure investments in deep tech. 

• 
 Support portfolio companies post-investment as they grow their teams, consider strategic priorities, develop business models, and raise follow-on capital. 

• 
 Represent Engine Ventures and our mission while advocating for Tough Tech in the startup and academic ecosystems. 

• 
 Be flexible to take on new responsibilities and special projects as they arise, to enable goals across fund programs, events, content, etc. 

 Skills & Qualifications
 
• 
 Advanced technical training (PhD or equivalent experience) in a relevant field such as electrical engineering, chemical engineering, computer science, physics, materials science, mechanical engineering, or related disciplines 

• 
 2-5+ years of experience in a demanding environment (e.g., deep tech startup, product or strategy role, or top-tier consulting) 

• 
 Demonstrated ability to understand and evaluate complex technical systems across domains. 

• 
 Strong commercial intuition and interest in how technologies scale into large businesses. 

• Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal judgment; ability to build trust with founders and teammates. 

• 
 Clear, structured thinking and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. 

• 
 High degree of ownership, with the ability to operate independently and drive work forward in ambiguous environments.

jobs.title: Associate, Energy Demand - Research & Innovation
jobs.description:
Founded in 2015, EIP is a global investment firm with more than $4.5 billion in assets under management. Since its founding, EIP has focused on leading the transition to a sustainable future by bringing together the world's most forward-looking energy, critical infrastructure, technology and industrial companies and the best-of-breed businesses that serve them. Our team has built deep domain experience investing globally in over 100 companies across venture, growth, private equity and credit.

 We’re seeking an Associate to join our Research & Innovation group: the team at EIP responsible for the strategic platform bridging EIP’s investment teams, corporate partners, and portfolio companies. This position will focus on energy demand, covering topics such as: AI infrastructure and data centers, real estate decarbonization, and utility customer solutions and operations. Within those domains, this role will support in the development of deep market insight and apply that insight to: A) help our corporate partners drive meaningful innovation in their business;  B) accelerate commercialization for our portfolio companies, and C) support our investment deal flow.   

 This is an opportunity to work at the nexus of technology innovators and established energy incumbents to accelerate change in our industry. We’re looking for an insatiably curious, analytically minded market researcher, who’s able to manage multiple workstreams and draw insights across an ecosystem spanning technical founders, startup commercial leaders, corporate innovation leads, and corporate finance professionals.   

 This position will be based in person at our Atlanta office.   

 Key Areas of Responsibility:   

 Generating sector research & insight   

• Support market analysis on a wide variety of topics – synthesizing industry research and data from diverse sources to generate insight that’s simply unavailable anywhere else 

• Develop market landscapes for investable target companies

• Identify the transformational impact that emerging technology might have on our strategic partners’ businesses

• Perform fundamental modelling of technology and market pathways to adoption   

 Engage our strategic partners   

• Support and lead working groups of subject matter experts and operational leaders from our strategic partner consortium 

• Work hand in hand with partners on building business cases and deployment pathways for transformational technology

• Support corporate venture capital teams on investment opportunities in EIP portfolio companies and deal flow   

 Establish thought leadership   

• Present and publish unique insights to share EIP’s views both within and outside of our immediate ecosystem 

• Develop credibility as a trusted internal advisor on key trends and markets.   

 Create value for EIP investment strategy & portfolio   

• Collaborate with our investment teams to source deal opportunities and build conviction in investment decisions 

• Share actionable insight with our portfolio on market dynamics & opportunities

• Support portfolio companies by advising on product development roadmaps & go-to-market strategy   

   Requirements   

• 2 years of experience in market analysis; management consulting; corporate strategy; investment banking, or other relevant fields   

• Proficient level of understanding of the utility industry and challenges facing both energy suppliers and customers, such as power capacity bottlenecks, lengthy timelines to power for large loads, and rising electricity rates for residential and commercial customers

• Bachelor’s degree in business or engineering field preferred (finance, electrical engineering, management, economics, mechanical engineering)

• Prior experience, or demonstrated interest in, the energy or climate tech sector

• Excellent analytical skills and capability to assess complex business cases

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Proven ability to juggle multiple competing priorities in fast paced environment with limited oversight

• Strong detail orientation and commitment to accuracy

• An independent mindset and intellectual curiosity

• A proven track record of working effectively on a team and being a good teammate

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, CoPilot/AI tools, and PowerPoint   

 This position offers a comprehensive benefits package and compelling compensation including base salary, annual bonus and potential participation in equity programs.    
 At EIP, we believe great investors exhibit strong passion, ambition and drive, an insatiable appetite to learn, strong business and interpersonal judgement, and a genuine interest in business, technology and how companies / industries work. As such, we have built a team of diverse individuals who exude these qualities and strive for excellence. Coupled with our unique investing platform, leveraging the insights, perspectives and guidance of our strategic partners, our team is poised to continue building on its track record of success.

jobs.title: FP&A & Strategic Finance – Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We're a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. Our structure organizes investments into focused portfolios that function as specialized operating groups, each developing deep domain expertise, proven operational playbooks and long-term partnerships with founders and management teams.

We combine operational rigor with a growth equity mindset - partnering closely with leadership teams to drive sustainable ARR growth, profitability improvements and industry-leading customer outcomes.



The Mission

Build financial infrastructure across portfolio companies so founders and leaders forecast accurately and make decisions with confidence.



What You'll Do

 - Build detailed operating models (revenue, retention, pricing, headcount, cash flow) that become the single source of truth for portfolio companies.

 - Design standardized financial reporting packages, KPI dashboards, and budget-versus-actuals frameworks for month-on-month performance analysis.

 - Own quarterly forecasting cadence: collect inputs, reconcile actuals, stress-test assumptions, and present findings to executives and investors.

 - Partner with accounting teams to diagnose and fix data quality issues at the root (chart of accounts, revenue recognition, timing gaps).

 - Identify and repair logical gaps, circular references, and broken assumptions in inherited models and data pipelines.

 - Conduct ad-hoc financial analysis on unit economics, pricing, hiring ROI, and cash runway with clear recommendations.



What We're Looking For



Must-haves

 - 1 to 3 years in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, or highly analytical corporate finance roles.

 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency: build models from scratch, link worksheets, create dynamic assumptions, stress-test scenarios.

 - Solid accounting and finance fundamentals: understand accrual vs. cash, P&L and balance sheet structure, working capital, revenue recognition.

 - Ability to overlap meaningfully with U.S. time zones (EST/CST) for weekly meetings and ad-hoc collaboration.



Nice-to-haves

 - Experience with SQL, Python, Looker, or Tableau for automating data pulls and building dashboards.

 - Prior exposure to SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, CAC, LTV, churn, net retention) or B2B unit economics.

 - Familiarity with ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct) or accounting software (QuickBooks).



Who you are

●       Take pride in accuracy and consistency, even on the unglamorous stuff

●       Catch issues early and fix them without needing a lot of airtime

●       Ask sharp questions and then go do the work to answer them

●       Communicate clearly in English, both in writing and live, because you will work with         

          U.S.-based executives and investors

●       Stay calm when priorities shift, and still deliver something clean


What We Offer

 - Salary: $15,000 to $40,000 USD based on experience and location.

 - Full remote work across India and South Asia, Latin America.

 - Exposure to early-stage to growth-stage software businesses with direct impact on scaling financial discipline.

 - Opportunity to build repeatable processes and infrastructure used across the portfolio.

jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.description:
Investment Associate | New York/San Francisco/Toronto - Full-Time / Part-Time | Onsite

Who We Are

Emergence is a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. We organize investments into focused portfolios with deep domain expertise and proven operational playbooks. We combine permanent capital with a growth equity mindset — partnering closely with leadership teams to drive sustainable ARR growth, profitability improvements, and industry-leading customer outcomes.



The Mission

Own the investment execution process end to end - from first look through close - on majority buyout transactions in enterprise software.



What You'll Do

 - Lead financial and operational due diligence on acquisition targets, owning the workstream from kickoff to IC.

 - Build comprehensive financial models covering unit economics, SaaS KPIs, valuation, and operating leverage.

 - Run quality of earnings analyses and own the net working capital bridge and indebtedness definitions.

 - Write and present Investment Committee memos with clear diligence findings and a defensible point of view.

 - Assess and synthesize deal terms and majority buyout structures, identifying risks in negotiated positions.

 - Collaborate with legal, finance, and operations teams to drive clean deal execution and post-close integration planning.

 - Develop retention analyses and customer cohort work to evaluate pipeline health of acquisition targets.
   
   

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

 - 3 to 5 years of experience in private equity, growth equity, or investment banking with direct deal execution exposure.

 - Has run a full diligence process and contributed directly to a closed transaction.

 - Deep understanding of enterprise software and SaaS business models - can assess a business independently.

 - Strong financial modelling skills across LBO, DCF, and SaaS-specific KPI frameworks.

 - Can write a clear, concise IC memo that stands on its own without being walked through.

Nice-to-haves

 - Experience with majority buyout structuring and complex transaction terms.

 - Prior exposure to post-acquisition integration planning.

 - Software-focused PE or growth equity background.
   
   

Who you are

You have run a data room without being told what to look for. You have pushed back on a deal and explained why with numbers. You write things once and they are right. You pull problems toward yourself instead of waiting for someone to assign them. You have changed your view on a business because the data said something different and you said so out loud.



What We Offer

Competitive base with bonus and meaningful carry participation. 

Direct ownership of deal execution with exposure to the full lifecycle from sourcing through close and post-acquisition integration.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff (AI-Native)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Embedding VC is an early-stage venture fund investing at the frontier of AI. Embedding Labs is our sister studio, where we incubate and build AI-native companies from scratch alongside founders.
 We're looking for a Chief of Staff who can move fluidly between both sides of the house: helping the fund run better and helping the studio build faster.
 The Role 
 This is a hybrid operator role for someone who is comfortable being hands-on with AI tools, telling our story to the outside world, and keeping the internal machine running smoothly. You'll work directly with the founding team across investment, community, and company-building workstreams.
 We're not looking for a traditional "chief of staff" who just manages calendars and decks. We want someone AI-native: someone who reaches for AI tools by default to build, automate, and ship.
 What You'll Do 
 • AI Development — Build and maintain internal tools and workflows using AI (Claude, agents, automations) to speed up how the fund and studio operate, from deal research to content generation to portfolio tracking. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be fluent in using AI-assisted coding and automation tools to ship real things.
 • GTM — Own parts of how we show up externally: social content, community events (like our Weekly Launch Hour), and outreach to strategic partners. Help sharpen our narrative and get it in front of the right people.
 • Operations — Keep the day-to-day running: scheduling, coordination across the fund and studio, vendor and admin logistics, and process design as we scale. You'll be the person who notices what's broken and fixes it before anyone has to ask.
 Who You Are 
 • 1 to 3 years of experience, in any of: startups, VC, consulting, studio/incubator environments, or a fast-moving operating role
 • Genuinely AI-native: you use AI tools daily, not occasionally, and you default to building with them
 • Strong writer, comfortable producing external-facing content in a clear, human voice
 • Organized and low-ego: happy to do both strategic and unglamorous work
 • Curious about the AI landscape and able to hold your own in conversations with founders and researchers
 Nice to Have 
 • Experience in venture capital, a startup studio, or an early-stage startup
 • A portfolio of things you've built using AI tools (internal tools, content, automations, side projects)
 What You'll Get 
 • Direct exposure to both venture investing and company-building, at the earliest stages of both
 • A seat close to the founding team, with real ownership over how we operate and communicate
 • A flexible, builder-first culture where "I automated this with AI" is the default answer, not the exception

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Design team at ElevenLabs is crafting experiences for the next generation of audio workflows using generative AI. You’ll work in entirely new and unexplored problem spaces, like crafting experiences around voice cloning that will allow people to generate content in realistic voices, languages, and accents, to create universally accessible content, safely. You’ll reimagine how creative teams craft sounds just by describing them, and how they bring it all together in one AI-first generative audio platform. The work here has the potential to revolutionize workflows for creators to media and entertainment, publishing giants, to defining entirely new spaces like conversational AI companies.

You will work with our Engineering and AI Research teams to successfully communicate, evolve, and execute a strong product design standard that showcases ElevenLabs as an innovator in the generative AI audio space. You are a crucial component of our company’s growth and product launches through your contributions to short and long-term strategic direction, creating and maintaining high visual standards and a strong focus on user needs. You have an owner’s mentality, taking pride in your work and in your team’s work, and view what you do as a part-owner and builder of ElevenLabs.

You'll work closely with Nev Flynn https://nevflynn.com/,  Austin Malerba https://x.com/austin_malerba?lang=en, and collaborate closely with our frontend engineers to achieve outcomes.

If you love the intersection of design and engineering, as well as having an interest in the business side this could be a great fit. You might be a designer turned engineer, an engineer turned designer, or an ex-founder.



WHAT YOU BRING

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic product designers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects and designs. Even directly sharing a rough figma of your work is a great way to show us your craft! We do require:

 - Creative thinking toward establishing and executing on the vision for team initiatives. Challenge the status quo, push innovation and inspire people toward a unified outcome.

 - Efficiently execute to ship products that deliver impact for our business and customers.

 - Partner with the leadership team to successfully communicate concisely across the team and influence product and design outcomes.

 - Will work across the entire business stack and make an impact at different stages of the product: building vision & strategy, ensuring all the loose ends are tied up when executing, and making sure the operational components to support onboarding are in place, not just the product

 - It is preferred that you can get in the weeds with your engineering partners and make sense of technical constraints, while still pushing forward and maintaining a high design bar and level of execution

 - Work closely with stakeholders across the organization, partnering with Engineering, Customer Support, and Growth to define new products and features and launch them




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in  London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Product Designer, Growth
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

 We're looking for a Product Designer to join Growth at Discord and help shape how people find Discord, get set up, and stay connected over time.

 Growth sits at the front door of our consumer org. We're responsible for how Discord shows up in the world — how new people discover us, how they land and get started, and how existing users stay close to the conversations and communities they care about. It's a broad, fast-moving surface area, and design plays a central role in making each of those moments feel unmistakably like Discord.

 This role spans the full breadth of what Growth owns:

• Notifications — helping users stay connected to what they care about, even when they're away. We're making notifications more intelligent, trusted, and effective: reaching people at the right moments, coordinating delivery thoughtfully, and giving users real control over their experience.

• Off-platform — how Discord shows up beyond the app itself, across embeds, links, invites, web pages, and text messages. These are often someone's first impression of Discord, and there's a lot of room to make them better.

• Onboarding — rethinking how new users arrive, understand what Discord is, and find their footing in those first few minutes.

• GSEO — a growing effort to build the web experiences that help new people discover Discord through search in the first place.

 You won't own all of this at once, but you'll work across it — and you'll help us shape how these pieces fit together into one coherent growth experience rather than a set of disconnected products.

 What You'll Be Doing 

• Own end-to-end initiatives across Growth — a new notification type, an onboarding flow, an off-platform surface like invites or embeds, or a web experience built to bring new users in — designing across all platforms (iOS, Android, Desktop, Web)

• Design with high craft and velocity — creating production-ready specs and high-fidelity prototypes while knowing when to ship vs. polish

• Influence scope and strategy in partnership with your PM, engineering lead, and cross-functional teammates, balancing growth velocity with user value

• Use data and research to inform decisions, partnering with research and data science teams to validate designs and understand user behavior

• Think in systems — considering how discovery, onboarding, off-platform touchpoints, and re-engagement work together to create one cohesive experience

• Collaborate and communicate effectively — sharing work early and often, telling compelling stories about your design rationale, and building relationships across teams

• Drive projects autonomously — managing your own time and deliverables while knowing when to escalate blockers

 What you should have 

• 3+ years of product design experience designing consumer-facing digital products — though we're open to strong candidates with 2+ years who demonstrate exceptional craft and potential.

• Strong visual design foundation with demonstrated aesthetic taste. You have a high level of skill crafting beautiful interfaces and an eye for creating delight in every product experience — typography, color, hierarchy, and composition are second nature to you. You're comfortable working with design systems.

• Solid interaction design skills — you create intuitive flows, understand information architecture, and can design for complex, multi-step experiences. You're comfortable designing systems, not just screens.

• High proficiency with Figma and prototyping tools (Protopie, Framer, Principle, etc.) — you use prototypes to communicate your vision, test concepts, and build alignment with stakeholders.

• Experience shipping products collaboratively in cross-functional teams with engineering, product management, research, and data science.

• Ownership mindset with a bias toward action — you proactively drive projects and decisions forward. You help guide product vision through design explorations, documentation, and presentations.

 Bonus Points: 

• Personal use of Discord and passion for gaming or community platforms

• Experience designing growth, onboarding, acquisition, or lifecycle products

• Understanding of how products reach and grow users across surfaces — notifications, messaging, web, SEO, or shareable/viral loops

• Familiarity with experimentation frameworks and data-driven iteration

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $148,000 to $166,500 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. 
 Why Discord?  

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! 

 Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

 Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking  HERE.

jobs.title: Accounting Systems & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
What You’ll Be A Part Of: 

 Founded in 2015 by CEO Barry Silbert, Digital Currency Group is the most active investor in the blockchain sector with a mission to accelerate the development of a better financial system through the proliferation of digital assets and blockchain technology. Today, DCG sits at the epicenter of the industry, backing more than 200 blockchain-related companies in over 35 countries. DCG also invests directly in digital currencies and other digital assets.

 We passionately believe digital currency and blockchain technology will drive global economic and social change. Our unique model enables us to deploy our resources to build over the long term.

 What is the Role? 

 The Accounting Systems & Operations Analyst will sit within DCG's accounting team and work across both accounting operations and financial systems. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is also curious about technology, process improvement, and the evolving use of AI in finance.

 The role will support month-end accounting, reconciliations, internal controls, and audit readiness while also serving as a key resource for NetSuite, SAP Concur, and related accounting tools. The right candidate will be comfortable learning on the job, investigating issues, supporting users, documenting processes, and helping a lean team make practical use of new system capabilities.

 What You'll Be Responsible For: 

• Prepare and support journal entries, account reconciliations, intercompany activity, and other month-end close responsibilities.

• Support accounting for prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accruals, and assigned balance-sheet and income-statement accounts.

• Maintain accurate, organized, and review-ready support for accounting entries, reconciliations, close checklists, audits, and internal reviews.

• Research reconciling items and accounting questions, identify the underlying issue, and follow through to resolution.

• Serve as a key point of contact for day-to-day NetSuite and SAP Concur questions from accounting and business users.

• Support NetSuite administration, reporting, saved searches, workflows, user access, testing, data validation, and issue troubleshooting within established review and approval procedures.

• Support SAP Concur Expense and Travel administration, user questions, testing, reporting, and ongoing process improvements.

• Assist with testing system enhancements, releases, integrations, and finance transformation initiatives; document results and retain appropriate support.

• Maintain process documentation, user guidance, system records, and internal-control support so information remains current and audit-ready.

• Help evaluate and responsibly apply NetSuite AI capabilities and other approved AI-enabled finance tools to improve efficiency, reporting, and user support.

• Collaborate with Accounting, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders on ad hoc requests and special projects.

 What You'll Bring: 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or active CPA candidacy is preferred but not required.

• Approximately 3-7 years of experience in accounting, financial systems, finance operations, public accounting, or a combination of these areas.

• Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals, including debits and credits, journal entries, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial-statement impact.

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite including user support, reporting, testing, troubleshooting, or system administration.

• Strong Excel skills and the ability to organize, analyze, and explain financial information clearly.

• Public accounting experience, preferably with a Big Four firm, is strongly preferred; financial services, fintech, technology, or multi-entity experience is a plus.

jobs.description:
Job Location: Toronto, ON or Montreal, QC
 Who we are :
 Diagram is a venture builder and early-stage investor that conceives, launches, and invests in transformative companies in the Fintech and ClimateTech sectors. Since 2016, we’ve raised over $480M and launched or invested in around 50 companies.
 We work hand-in-hand with experienced founders, combining access to capital, hands-on support, and a deep ecosystem of partners to launch and scale businesses. Our ecosystem includes 200+ investors, including 60+ entrepreneurs with exits exceeding $15B, as well as a global network of corporate partners.
 Diagram is part of Sagard, a global multi-strategy alternative investment platform with over US$46B in AUM
 What we are looking for :
 We are looking for an Associate, Venture Creation to help launch new Diagram ventures, reporting to Diagram’s Fintech Venture Creation Principal.
 The successful candidate will bring a highly entrepreneurial mindset and strong desire to build the next generation of technology companies.
 This person will work directly with Diagram Partners, potential founders and expert advisors to lead the development, evaluation, de-risking and building of new Fintech/Insuretech ventures. The Associate will play a key role in turning ideas into companies, and shaping Diagram’s portfolio.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 • Identifying opportunities for new ventures to build and developing in-depth theses and perspectives on opportunity areas;
• Conducting user and market research, assessing business models and unit economics, assessing moat/defensibility to evaluate potential ideas;
• Generating and pitching new venture ideas, including developing pitch decks and investment memos
• Building prototype leveraging AI tools, leading build of MVP in collaboration with engineering, AI experts and other technical expert;
• Owning the work plan and leading the venture during pre-seed (E.g., leading partnerships with early design partners, securing pilot customers);
• Pitching ideas to potential founders, participating in the vetting and team x idea matching process, and building close relationships with founders
• Contributing to building Diagram's culture and brand in the community (e.g. attending startup community events, conferences, etc)
 You should have: 
 • A track record of outstanding performance
• A proven entrepreneurial mindset, high degree of ownership and a self-starter mentality
• Intellectual curiosity and rigor
• Strong communication skills (verbal and written) - be comfortable pitching ideas, and be able to produce high-quality deliverables
• Demonstrated ability to use AI technologies to create/build and leverage to assist in day to day work/activites
• 1-3 years of work experience in relevant fields such as:
• Early stage venture capital investing (Seed or Series A)
• Early-stage tech incl. product management, design-thinking / human-centered design, engineering, or other experience within tech startups
• Consulting or advisory focused on tech products / businesses
• Venture building at a venture studio
• Analytical skills and the ability to build financial models
• A technical (Engineering, Computer Science, Economics) or business degree
• Knowledge, experience or network in FinTech or InsureTech are a plus
 What we offer: 
 • A unique opportunity to learn how to build a VC-backed company 0-1;
• An essential role in something big, meaningful and different;
• The opportunity to push yourself, have ownership and impact;
• A team of accomplished, ambitious and supportive individuals that will help you grow;
• An ecosystem with many stretch opportunities including the potential to join a Diagram portfolio company;
• Competitive compensation, including upside in the companies Diagram creates;
• Beautiful offices in great locations (Montreal, Toronto);
• Generous benefits including a telemedicine service for you and your family.
 How to apply: 
 In order to be considered for the role, please apply to the role and attach: 
 • Your resume
• One thematic analysis - show us an example of how YOU think like a founder/entrepreneur by sharing with us an area you see opportunities for innovation
• Tell us how have you meaningfully used AI in the last 12 months
 Guidance for the thematic idea: Create a max 2 page (word) memo or 10-slide presentation around a Fintech or Insuretech theme of your choice, addressing the following questions:
 • Pain Points: What are big problems to be solved in the theme?
• Market Timing: What makes this area ripe for disruption today? What are the market headwinds and/or tailwinds?
• Market Sizing : How big is the market today? What’s the market size projected in 2040?
• Competition : Who are a few venture backed companies in the space?
• Interesting Angles : What are a few ideas you’d be interested in exploring?
 We are less interested in exhaustive research and more interested in how you think. Approach this as if you are pitching a new venture theme internally at Diagram. We’re looking for sharp insight, strong judgment, and clear venture angles - not a consulting-style industry report.
 We encourage you to focus on a clearly defined theme within Fintech or Insurtech rather than covering the sector broadly. For example, instead of writing about “AI in Fintech,” you might explore a focused theme such as agentic payments infrastructure. Depth within a well-defined wedge is stronger than a high-level overview of an entire category.
 Note: we will select the top applicants to present their thematic analysis to us. Interviews will start following the close of applications.

jobs.description:
CSQ327R60

 About the Team 

 The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

 You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

 Role Description 

 As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a "product manager for the field," owning the entire non-technical lifecycle of an FDE engagement.

 You will partner with our Account Executives to build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and, most importantly, scope the value . You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing.

 This role requires a rare mix of C-suite gravitas, deep product-style thinking, and a hands-on, "get it done" execution mindset.

 What You’ll Do 

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value ($10M+ problems), and define the pilot (MVP, success criteria, timeline).

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Act as the "CEO" of the project by authoring the PRD, prioritizing the engineering backlog, relentlessly managing scope, and acting as the primary hands-on QA tester.

• Agile Project Execution & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team via an agile process, manage all stakeholder communications from the C-suite to individual engineers, and act as the "escalation manager" to unblock all technical or political issues.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement.

 Requirements 

• Executive Presence & Communication: A "Trusted Advisor" with C-suite gravitas and superb communication skills. You are opinionated, humble, and can build rapport and drive decisions in days, not weeks.

• Product & Strategy Mindset: A "Product Thinker" and "Systems Thinker" who can perform a SWOT analysis, understand a competitive landscape, and define "what" to build and "why."

• Relentless Execution: An "Execution Driver" with a "Hands-On" mentality. You are relentless, an expert at escalation, and willing to do the unglamorous work to get the project done.

• Ideal Experience: 2+ years as a Deployment Strategist OR 2+ years at a high-growth startup in a "builder" or "founder" capacity. (Alternatively: 5+ years in a senior, client-facing "product" or "delivery" role at a top-tier tech company or consultancy).

jobs.title: Venture Scout
jobs.location: Berlin, DE or Remote (Germany) CVX Ventures Berlin, DE or Remote (Germany)
jobs.description:
CVX Venture Scout Programme 

 Do you have a passion for sourcing investments and making a difference for growth companies? Do you want to assist an extraordinary team of talented, motivated, driven individuals who all share a deep passion for entrepreneurship? If so, you may be our new Venture Scout. Please note, this is not a full time role, but we will provide remuneration based on success criteria. 

 Introduction 

 The CVX Venture Scout Programme is building a network of highly talented VC scouts, to assist us in sourcing attractive investment opportunities, in their specialist fields. You will learn and develop some of the most important skills required to be in VC, and meet with some of the most interesting and entrepreneurial founders in your market, and help shape the future.

 As part of your role as a CVX Venture Scout, the Investment Team will look to you to identify exciting startups, speak with them and conduct research on them, including their teams, markets, and competition. Based on your findings, you will write a 1-2 page proposal memo summarising your investment thesis, and may be asked to present it in-person or online to the CVX Investment Team.

 Expectations 

 We aim to use our Venture Scout Programme not only to discover exceptional investment opportunities but also to gain a deeper understanding of you and your vision. If you are interested in joining the CVX Investment Team, this is an excellent first step towards not only gaining an introduction to the VC ecosystem and learning essential VC skills, but also demonstrating how you think about investments, analyse them, and present your insights to us. As we grow our Investment Team, the Venture Scout Programme will be the first pool of resource we look to hire from.

 Compensation 

 We want to remunerate good work and give credit to your role in the investment process, where successful. We will therefore compensate you when a deal that you take forward to the investment team receives funding from our network of investors, with an opportunity for you to benefit from the upside too.

 Our Mission 

 CVX is one of Europe's fastest-growing venture investors, and we help ambitious and promising growth companies reach their full potential by investing capital, knowledge, time, skills, and network. We are driven by our conviction that the best investors are often those who, in addition to capital, provide founders with the right knowledge and experiences, skills, and networks in relation to the stage and industry in which the company operates. CVX always invests together with the best business angels for the respective founder, and today we have over 700 partners in our network who invest in companies and bring their skills into play where they can really add value.
