jobs.title: Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
Crossover is an early-stage venture capital fund that combines diversified exposure to small, high-access pre-seed and seed funds with concentrated direct investments in the breakout companies they surface.
 We back founder- and operator-led funds with privileged access to the talent-dense ecosystems where the next generation of category-defining companies is being formed. We then use proprietary portfolio data and our relationships with those managers to identify the highest-potential companies early and invest directly alongside leading Series A and B firms.
 Crossover operates as a small, tech-forward team led by Silicon Valley veterans with more than 50 years of combined experience building and investing in private technology companies.
 Role Description
 We’re hiring an Investment Analyst to help build and continuously improve the data, analytical tools, and systems that support Crossover’s investment and operations activities.
 This is a high-trust, high-agency role at the intersection of investing, data, AI, and operations. You will work closely with the Managing Partner and operations teams across our fund portfolio, more than a thousand underlying companies, and Crossover’s direct investments.
 What You’ll Own
 Investment Data & Internal Systems
 • Manage the collection, ingestion, and quality of data from underlying funds, portfolio companies, financing announcements, and other relevant sources.
• Own and improve Crossover’s proprietary datasets and internal systems, including Airtable and custom-built AI workflows.
• Analyze fund and company data to identify trends, portfolio developments, and potential investment opportunities, and combine proprietary information with external data to answer investment questions.
• Develop processes, taxonomies, QA checks, and automation that improve data quality, reduce manual work, and make information easier for the investment team to use.
• Help build and improve AI-enabled tools for investment research, portfolio monitoring, sourcing, and analysis.
 Investment & Portfolio Operations
 • Support fund and company diligence through research, data collection, and analysis.
• Maintain accurate investment records, ownership information, portfolio data, and supporting materials.
• Monitor underlying funds and portfolio companies for financings, material developments, and other relevant activity, and ensure important information is captured in our systems.
• Support special projects related to fund evaluation, direct investments, portfolio construction, market mapping, and investment strategy.
 As part of a small team, you will also be expected to take on projects and responsibilities outside these core areas when needed.
 Who We’re Looking For
 We care more about slope, judgment, and ownership than checking every box. The strongest candidates will likely have 2–5+ years of professional experience in an analytically rigorous environment.
 • High agency. You solve problems without needing step-by-step instructions.
• Analytically curious. You enjoy digging into data, identifying patterns, and understanding what the information actually means.
• Exceptional attention to detail.
• Systems thinker.
• Technically curious. You actively use modern software and AI tools. You do not need to know how to code.
• Investment-oriented. You are genuinely interested in venture capital and technology companies.
• Low ego.
 Location and Working Style
 This is a San Francisco Bay Area-based hybrid role, with flexibility to work remotely.
 Compensation
 The expected base salary range is $125,000–$160,000, depending on experience and fit, plus an annual performance bonus and benefits. For exceptional candidates who can grow with Crossover over the long term, the package may also include participation in the economics of the firm.
 How to Apply
 Please apply here or email hello@crossovervc.com with “Investment Analyst” in the subject line. Include your resume and a short note explaining why you’re interested in the role and why you believe you’d be a strong fit.

jobs.title: Student Venture Partner
jobs.description:
Contrary is a talent and research-driven investment firm, backed by some of the world’s most iconic entrepreneurs. We invest in a small number of exceptional people and the companies they build, and work closely alongside them to build enduring businesses from seed to scale.
 With this approach, we’ve backed iconic companies like Anduril, Ramp, Hallow, Zepto, and many others.
 Each year, we assemble a selective team of exceptional student Venture Partners (VPs) to partner closely with us and invest in the next generation of top founders. VPs hail from universities across the US and Canada, and are a group of top founders, builders, engineers, researchers, designers and writers.
 Being a Venture Partner
 As a Venture Partner, you'll be the go-to resource for founders and builders on campus. One day, you might grab coffee with someone brainstorming ideas for space manufacturing. The next, you'll research the latest AI trends or enterprise sales software as we evaluate relevant companies.
 You'll join a team of like-minded builders, learn how to think like an investor, and see what goes into starting and scaling a successful company.
 We look for independent thinkers with diverse experiences and a history of excellence.
 Previous VPs have started companies in high school, forgone careers as professional athletes, and built software projects with millions of users. There is no specific VP archetype. The only requirements are that you love tech and early-stage startups, and will put in the time and effort to make the most of the opportunity.
 All the details you'll need
 • We review applications as they come in, so apply now. The sooner the better. We have a final deadline of Sunday, September 13th at 11:59pm PT.
• We generally prefer people with more than one year of school left, but have made exceptions in the past.
• Our selection process includes 3 steps: an interview with a member of the Contrary HQ team, a more casual chat with existing VPs at your school (if applicable), and a conversation with our founder, Eric.
• Reach out to vp@contrary.com (vp@contrarycap.com) with any additional questions. We're always happy to chat and/or direct you to the appropriate resource.
• The Venture Partner role is a school-year commitment that lasts until you graduate. The community and network you join is life-long.

jobs.title: Investor Relations
jobs.description:
Austin, TX | Full-Time, In Office 

 Position Overview 

 Contrarian Thinking Capital is an early-stage venture fund co-led by Christopher Petkas and Codie Sanchez. We invest in the real economy: the businesses that keep the lights on, move the freight, defend our shores, and maintain the infrastructure.

 We’re looking for a head of Investor Relations to own the capital side of the fund: raising it, keeping it, and running the operations behind it.

 This role is responsible for driving the LP pipeline from first contact to signed subscription docs, serving as a primary point of contact for our limited partners, producing the communications that keep them informed, and coordinating the fund operations that keep everything clean and audit-ready.

 This role sits between our General Partners, our limited partners, and our fund administration, working closely with the investment team, finance, legal, and our media and community teams, who are often where our next LP relationship starts.

 What we’re looking for 

 We are intentionally leaving a rigid years-of-experience bar aside, but this is a role for someone who has done this work before and done it well. The strongest candidates tend to share these traits:

 • You have raised capital. You have been part of real fundraises, you understand how allocators think, and you know the difference between a meeting and a commitment.
• You understand how a fund works. Capital calls, distributions, subscription documents, LPAs, fund administration, and DDQs are familiar territory rather than a learning curve.
• You are exceptional with people. You build trust quickly, read a room well, handle sensitive conversations with discretion, and make our partners feel genuinely well served.
• You write with precision. Your communications are clear, credible, and on-brand; the kind of writing that increases an investor’s confidence.
• You are highly organized. Details do not slip on your watch. You value clean systems and you build them.
• You can represent the brand. You move comfortably between an approachable, human register and a precise, institutional one, and you know which each moment calls for.
• You are discreet and trustworthy. You will handle confidential financial and investor information, and we need full confidence that it is in careful hands.
 
 Who You Are 

 • You take ownership of outcomes rather than tasks
• You’re organized to the point that things don’t slip, and you build systems so they can’t
• You’re comfortable in a small team where you’ll be a center of gravity and hands-on at the same time
• You handle sensitive conversations with judgment and discretion
• You’re direct in communication and welcome the same in return
• You want to help build a fund, not just administer one
 
 Why This Role Matters 

 Raising capital is the constraint on everything else we want to do. Right now that work is split across two General Partners who also need to be sourcing and closing deals, which means LP relationships get less attention than they deserve and the operational side runs tighter than it should. This role takes that on end to end. You’ll be the person our LPs actually know, and the reason our back office is clean when it counts. The quality of our LP base over the next few years is largely going to be a function of how well this seat is run.

 What is Contrarian Thinking? 

 Who we are: We are an investment and advisory firm powered by media and led by veterans of Wall Street, Private Equity, and the operators of Main Street businesses.

 Our Ecosystem 

 1. Capital & Investment — We invest in businesses through diversified strategies, and support our portfolio in scaling to create enduring, profitable businesses.

 2. Education & Advisory — We assist in the full cycle of acquiring and scaling businesses through our two cohorts: the Academy and the Boardroom. Our vetted platform of buyers and builders utilize our campus, curriculum, systems and advisors to buy, invest in, and scale businesses.

 3. Events & Community — We produce nationwide events for buyers and builders with live workshops, chapter meetups, weekly calls, and annual conferences. 

 4. Media & Content — We aim to be the largest and most trusted business media company in the world through podcasts, YouTube, books, and online education. 

 Come build with us. 

 Location: Austin, TX — Full time in office.

 Type of Employment: Full-Time

 Crew Benefits 

 • 100% Company-paid health, dental, and vision for all full-time Crew Members with an option to add any dependents.
• Unlimited PTO Policy (with approval from your Direct Support) + 8 paid US holidays
• On-time direct deposit pay 2x/month
• Option to enroll in a 401(k) plan with competitive match options
• Employee-only co-invest opportunities
 
 How To Apply 

 You in? Great! Click the link on top to apply!

jobs.title: Investment Analyst Intern/Freelance - Secondary Market
jobs.description:
Join the Firm Redefining Private Market Access

 Clifton Partners is where institutional discipline meets entrepreneurial edge.

 We operate at both ends of private markets: as a family office deploying our own capital, and as an advisory boutique. That order matters—we build conviction by investing our own money first, then share our best opportunities with the world's leading families, funds and founders.

 We don't operate like an investment bank. We source, structure and distribute access to the companies shaping tomorrow—the entrepreneur's way: faster, sharper, closer to the people who build—and we've already moved billions doing it, for companies like OpenAI, SpaceX, Revolut, Mistral, and Anthropic.

 Our founding partners bring an unmatched combination: one built the secondary market playbook at UBS, the other built and sold tech companies worth $150M+.

 Together, they're creating the platform that connects the world's best private companies with the capital that understands them.

 The Partners You'll Learn From

 Diane-Rose Dupré

 Diane-Rose Dupré didn't just work at UBS—she became their youngest team head ever in France, leading the Venture & Growth Solutions team.

 She personally structured secondary deals for Revolut's and Klarna's expansion rounds, and OpenAI and Anthropic transactions. Her network reads like a who's who of global institutional investors and the largest family offices.

 When institutions need complex secondary solutions, they call Diane.

 Guillaume Moubeche

 Guillaume Moubeche built lemlist from $1,000 to a $150M valuation, then reached $45M ARR while staying 70% owner.

 He sold 20% for $30M to focus on what he does best: spotting and accessing tomorrow's winners.

 His portfolio includes positions in Groq, Ledger, BackMarket, Revolut, Anthropic and more. His content reaches 250,000+ tech founders and investors weekly.

 When founders need liquidity advice from someone who's been there, they call Guillaume.

 Why This Job Is Different

 At Clifton Partners, you won't be a junior analyst formatting slides. Here you can earn a level of ownership almost no finance or business experience offers, alongside people operating at the top of their game. You'll be:

• Structuring Real Deals: Work on live $10M–$100M transactions for companies you've read about in TechCrunch.

• Accessing Exclusive Networks: Interface directly with secondary investors, family offices managing billions and founders building unicorns.

• Creating Market Intelligence: Your analysis will influence how institutional capital flows into private tech.

• Content Creation at the Core: Content is central to how we build our network and our edge. You'll contribute directly—from BILLIONS, Guillaume's show with unicorn founders, to the analysis and ideas we put in front of the market.

 What We're Looking For

• Education: Tier 1 business school (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, LSE, LBS, Bocconi, or equivalent).

• Languages: Fluent in English and in French.

• Experience: 6+ months in investment banking, boutique advisory or private equity.

• Bonus: Family office or VC experience, or involvement in entrepreneurial experience.

• Mindset: Entrepreneurial self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

• Technical: Strong financial modeling, and fluent with AI tools to work faster and sharper.

• Communication: Exceptional presentation skills and ability to distill complex information.

• Passion: Genuine interest in technology, startups, and content creation.

 The Deal

• Duration: 4–6 months with potential for full-time conversion.

• Location: Fully remote with occasional Paris, Monaco, London, Geneva and Dubai meetings (expenses covered).

• Compensation: Competitive monthly salary (€2,000).

• Access: Direct mentorship from the partners and the full team, not associates.

• Network: Introductions to our network of 500+ institutional investors.

• Start date: September / October.

 How to Apply

 We don't want your standard cover letter. Send us:

• Your CV—one page max.

• Your take—pick a private tech company and tell us why it's overvalued or undervalued (Loom format).

• Your edge—what unique insight or connection do you bring? (200 words).

• Optional: Something you've created—business, article, model, podcast or newsletter.

• References from previous experiences.

 Email gaspard@clifton.partners, simon@clifton.partners and d@clifton.partners with the subject line “Investment Analyst – [Your Name]”. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Start early.

 Hiring Process

• First screening based on profile.

• Case—48 hours maximum, five slides on a specific topic.

• Final stage—Q&A, final fit check and entrepreneurial mindset.

jobs.title: Investor Relations Associate
jobs.description:
The Investor Relations Associate will get to know every active investor in Texas and help facilitate millions in venture capital funding by connecting our portfolio founders to angels and venture investors.  You will be responsible for the execution of key Investor Relations programs including Investor Office Hours, helping portfolio startups understand different fundraising options and access IR resources, onboarding new investors into our community, and assisting with the launch of new IR initiatives. You’ll use Capital Factory’s network of active investors and proprietary software tools to curate matches between investors and founders. You’ll get three years of venture capital experience in a year by observing large volumes of early stage companies and learning how VCs view and evaluate potential investments. 
 Capital Factory attracts the best startups in the state and connects them with exactly who they need to grow their business - whether that’s their next partner, mentor, client, employee or investor. Our Ventures Team facilitates all of these interactions - and we’re seeking a strong leader with a proven background in the startup community to optimize and grow our programming opportunities across Texas. 
 What you will do…
 • You’ll make valuable introductions between founders and investors when there is mutual interest. 
• Be the primary point-of-contact for investors, building a long term relationship. You’ll be responsible for sharing relevant startups, events, and other opportunities with them, and tracking their engagement.
• Organize office hours, in-person and virtual, for investors to meet with relevant portfolio founders.
• Network with venture capitalists and angel investors to establish deal flow relationships with them.
• Attend events with investors and introduce new portfolio companies.
• Take calls and meetings with investors to better understand their investment thesis and which companies to introduce them to.
• Make over a dozen curated introductions between investors and our portfolio founders everyday.
• Attend our weekly Ventures Team Sync, Investor Relations Sync and other relevant meetings. 
• Attend our monthly First Look events. 
 Requirements 
 You’ll know you’re successful if…
 • Our Founders have an exceptional experience and receive meaningful value from connections made with our investor network.
• Our Investor Office Hours program continues to grow and meetings have a 90%+ utilization rate.
• Investors rave about the startups they meet with. 
• You build strong relationships with our VIP stakeholders and receive introductions to new investors on a regular basis. You work with high-level professionals and don’t get intimidated easily.
• Assigned tasks are completed in a timely manner with minimal mistakes and your team trusts you to execute independently.
• You have a productive and collaborative relationship with all internal teams, especially the Mentor, Venture Programs, and Ops Teams. 
 About you…
 • You have experience with the startup and technology markets.
• You have a basic understanding of startup funding terms, options, and mechanisms.
• You like using data to understand problems and make connections.
• You are organized and plan ahead, but you don’t get stressed out when things change at the last minute. Because they will. You roll with it.
• You have a proven ability to manage multiple projects at a time while paying strict attention to detail.
• You have the ability to deliver high quality work, on time, in a dynamic organization under time pressure.
• You are able to work at least 45 hours per week. You do what it takes to get the job done!  
• You plan to stay in Texas and fully commit to this position for 2+ years.
 Benefits 
 • 4 weeks paid time off (one week is between Christmas and New Year’s) 
• Personal health, vision and dental insurance paid 100% by Capital Factory
• Additional benefits such as 401k program (50% company matching), life insurance, short & long term disability and and employee assistance program
• Parental leave including 10 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 4 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents
• $1,000 personal innovation budget on your first year anniversary and then an additional $500 each anniversary thereafter
• Coworking membership at Capital Factory with garage parking space, metro pass, or rideshare credits and access to the onsite gym
• A priceless network
 About our team... 
 • We have a passion for startups and technology
• We have excellent written and verbal communication skills
• We are professional and presentable and greet everyone cheerfully. We're ready to deal with an immature student, a pushy salesperson, top VCs, a fortune 500 CEO, and even the President of the United States.
• We are excited to work in downtown Austin and have reliable transportation.
• We have a quiet place with fast internet where we can work remotely.
• We have a reliable laptop computer and smartphone.
• We are security aware. We have a passcode on our computers and phones and use a password manager.
• We are available during SXSW (Spring Break) and Startup Week (the week before Austin City Limits Music Fest).
• We get to Inbox Zero every day.
 About Capital Factory 
 Capital Factory is the center of gravity for entrepreneurs in Texas, the number one startup state in the U.S. Hundreds of thousands of entrepreneurs, programmers, and designers gather day and night, in-person and online for meetups, classes, and coworking. With boots on the ground in Austin, Dallas, Houston and San Antonio, we meet the best entrepreneurs in Texas and introduce them to their first investors, employees, mentors, and customers. According to Pitchbook, Capital Factory has been the most active investor in Texas since 2010.

jobs.description:
Booz Allen Ventures Associate The Opportunity:   

 Booz Allen Hamilton Ventures, a $ 3 00M corporate venture capital fund, is seeking a n   Associate   to   manage   investment opportunities, inform investment theses in key categories, and support fund leadership   with   due diligence and fund operations. In this position, the   Associate   will project manage active deals through the investment process,   conduct due diligence,   and   regularly meet   with founders and investors.   

 The Booz Allen Hamilton Ventures team will source, negotiate, and execute investments in earl y   companies, such as Seed though Series B , as well as follow-on rounds, consistent with the fund’s investment strategy. The fund will focus on sectors aligned with Booz Allen Hamilton’s innovation thes e s, such as Defense Technology,   Data Science,   Space ,   Quantum   and   Deep Tech, and targeted platforms, such as Cybersecurity and   Defense Technology Group. 

 What   You’ll   Do:   

 • Due diligence:  Support all aspects of the deal review process, including quantitative analysis, such as financial modeling and sensitivity analysis, competitor and market scans, customer and investor interviews, and technology reviews.   Will also support negotiations with   investment targets.   

• Deal origination and screening:   Identify   and source strong investment opportunities in key focus sectors, and review a high-volume of inbound pipeline to triage relevant opportunities   

• Market research:  Perform in-depth research to support new and existing investment thesis development, including producing written research/analysis, sector presentations, white papers, and investment memos for the Booz Allen Hamilton Ventures team and Booz Allen Hamilton stakeholders.   

• Tool management : Manage internal pipeline and portfolio management   tools and   contribute to internal-facing reporting on portfolio health and investment theses. Coordinate with relevant internal teams, such as legal and accounting, through deal processes.   

• Portfolio engagement : Support commercial engagements, such as pilots, between portfolio companies and Booz Allen Hamilton in addition to   utilizing   Booz Allen Hamilton Ventures’ collective networks to drive value for the portfolio.   

• Networking:  Develop relationships with relevant founders, VCs, and corporate executives, along with key internal stakeholders, to support new investment and portfolio management activities.   

• Marketing:  Help extend Booz Allen Hamilton Ventures’ reach in key communities by hosting and attending industry   events and   producing written or audio/video content, such as podcasts.   

 Join us. The world can't wait. 

 You Have: 

 • 2 + years of experience in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or with a technology company   

• Experience conducting financial analysis, financial modeling, valuation assessments, and investment diligence activities   

• Experience evaluating technology companies, startup business models, market opportunities, and competitive landscapes   

• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating stakeholders across cross-functional teams   

• Experience developing written analyses, investment memoranda, presentations, or executive-level briefings   

• Knowledge of venture capital investing, startup ecosystems, and emerging technology markets   

• Ability to communicate effectively with founders, investors, executives, and technical stakeholders   

• Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative information to support business and investment decisions   

• Bachelor's degree   

 Compensation 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $86,800.00 to $198,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
 Candidate AI Usage Policy

However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge.  Work Model 
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner | FinTech / Wealth Management / SaaS / Agile
jobs.description:
ABOUT BIP CAPITAL 
 BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi-stage, multi-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009.
 ABOUT BIP VENTURES 
 BIP Ventures, the North American-focused venture capital division of BIP Capital, is a highly active venture capital firm based in the Southeast. BIP Ventures partners with extraordinary founders to drive exceptional outcomes. Since 2007, BIP Ventures has invested in the success of B2B software and tech-enabled service businesses at all stages of maturity. In addition to capital, it supports entrepreneurs with access to infrastructure, acumen, and talent, resulting in category-leading companies.
 OUR PHILOSOPHY 
 We are champions of our investors' goals and stewards of founders' dreams, but more than that, we are ethical, honest partners who serve, educate, and protect our founders and investors. We take on the challenges and complex conversations because we operate out of integrity and genuine care.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic, growth-oriented Associate Product Owner to join our BIP Wealth Tech team and contribute to the development of BIP's innovative technology products. This is a support-focused, execution-oriented role, an excellent opportunity for a motivated early-career product professional who is eager to learn, comfortable with shifting priorities, and ready to grow within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
 As an Associate Product Owner for BIP Wealth Tech, you will work hands-on with our platform team, which is responsible for our core CRM platform development, supporting backlog management, writing user stories and release notes, managing our Jira Service Desk, performing QA, and collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders. You'll be the face of our support queue, responding to users effectively and building trust through clear, timely communication. We're looking for someone who is personable and engaging in stakeholder conversations, eager to learn how to drive UI adoption through demonstrated value creation, and comfortable getting hands-on with integrating third-party systems into existing workflows. The ideal candidate brings curiosity, decisiveness, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex domain, including finance and wealth management concepts.
 LOCATION: Hybrid with ability to be on-site when required out of Buckhead / Atlanta Office.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 • Backlog Support: Assist in maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog under the guidance of senior team members, ensuring the team is focused on delivering high-value work.
• User Story & Release Note Writing: Write and refine clear, concise user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria; draft release notes to communicate product updates to stakeholders.
• Jira Service Desk Management: Serve as the primary point of contact and face of the support queue, owning day-to-day triage and resolution of service desk requests, maintaining a 24–48-hour SLA for responses and escalating as appropriate.
• Sprint Participation: Actively participate in grooming and sprint planning sessions; support efforts to keep the backlog 1–2 sprints ahead with 'ready' work.
• QA & Feature Validation: Perform acceptance testing and quality assurance on user stories to ensure features meet requirements and are free of critical defects before release.
• Small-to-Medium Feature Delivery: Take ownership of small and medium-sized features end-to-end, from writing epics and stories as directed through to release.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a day-to-day liaison between engineering and business stakeholders; build strong working relationships, support UI adoption efforts, and keep communication clear
• Multi-System Requirements Management: Manage requirements across multiple systems, including third-party integrations into existing workflows, ensuring they are clear, traceable, and aligned across stakeholders and workstreams.
• Feedback Collection: Participate in sprint reviews, gather and document stakeholder feedback to continuously improve the product and inform backlog prioritization.
• Documentation: Support the creation of process flows, user guides, and internal documentation as needed.
• AI Solution Building: Assist in identifying opportunities to build AI solutions that augment or enhance existing workflows, partnering with engineering to translate ideas into clear, actionable requirements.
 Requirements 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 • Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience in product development, project coordination, or working within Agile/Scrum teams, specifically with software, platform, or web-based products. Experience in wealth management, fintech, or a related analytical or technology role will also be considered.
• Technical Acumen: Jira is the primary tool; Confluence is a plus. Experience with Rally or equivalent Agile platforms is acceptable. Basic familiarity with the software development lifecycle is expected.
• AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms, for prototyping, design exploration, or accelerating product workflows. Exposure to or interest in building AI solutions that augment or enhance workflows is a plus.
• Domain Comfort: Comfortable working within complex domains, including wealth management, finance, or venture capital concepts. You don't need to arrive as an expert, but you must be willing and able to learn quickly.
• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey ideas clearly to engineers, stakeholders, and teammates. 
• People Skills: Friendly, curious, and emotionally intelligent. You build rapport easily, especially with engineers, are personable and engaging in stakeholder interviews and conversations, adapt to various personalities, and bring energy that improves team dynamics.
• Self-Starter Mentality: You take initiative, ask questions to fill knowledge gaps, and demonstrate resourcefulness. 
• Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating within shifting priorities and frequent pivots. Open to feedback and quick to adapt to you, you see ambiguity as a normal part of a fast-paced environment.
• Analytical Skills: Ability to gather and interpret information to support product decisions and backlog prioritization. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are prioritized over deep analytics.
• Systems Integration Exposure: Exposure to or interest in integrating third-party systems into existing workflows is a plus; you don't need deep experience, but comfort learning how systems connect is important.
• Education: A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent work experience is welcomed.
 SUCCESS METRICS 
 • At 90 Days: Demonstrate foundational knowledge of our core CRM platform and other internal systems, and team workflows. Build positive working relationships with key stakeholders by supporting sprint ceremonies, triaging Jira Service Desk requests within the 24–48-hour SLA and contributing well-written user stories. Maintain a backlog with 1–2 sprints of groomed, ready work.
• At Six Months: Independently triage and resolve 90% of service desk requests within SLA, establishing yourself as a reliable face of the support queue. Contribute consistently to sprint ceremonies and maintain backlog management 3–4 sprints ahead. Take ownership of at least one small project end-to-end, delivering quality work from user story through release. Maintain accurate Jira documentation and actively support stakeholder feedback loops.
• At One Year: Demonstrate readiness to independently manage the backlog and own 1–2 active medium projects end-to-end. Begin contributing strategic insights to product decisions. Become a reliable resource across our core platforms, contribute to internal documentation, and show clear progress toward full Product Owner-level responsibilities.
 Benefits 
 WHY JOIN US 
 • Join a lean, agile team of startup-minded professionals who take ownership, move fast, and deliver high-quality, impactful products.
• Contribute to meaningful, innovative solutions, including our suite of internal and external platforms, that power the operations of a dynamic venture capital firm and its portfolio.
• Build and expand your product management expertise in an environment that values curiosity, autonomy, and continuous learning.
• Collaborate with smart, driven teammates who challenge each other to think bigger, move smarter, and constantly improve.
• Grow into a Product Owner or broader leadership role as we scale; your impact will be seen and valued every step of the way.
 WHY JOIN BIP CAPITA L
 • Top-quartile Performance: We are a leading venture capital firm in a vibrant tech ecosystem offering national prominence.
• Internal Growth: We foster critical thinking and promote internal advancement from day one.
• Unique Value Proposition: Our firm boasts a robust, defensible value proposition supported by a high-net-worth investor base.
• Merit-based Environment: We encourage you to bet on yourself, leveraging your merit to excel and thrive.
• Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, health and wellness plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.
 BIP Capital is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. BIP Capital is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

jobs.title: Client Success Analyst | Entry-Level / New Grad -Investment Operations / Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT BIP CAPITAL 
 BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi-stage, multi-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009. 
 WORKING ON BIP CAPITAL’S CLIENT SUCCESS TEAM 
 We hire intelligent and driven individuals who value teamwork and trust, extending this mentality to positively impact investors and advisory firms, in a constant search for excellence. The Client Success team is the connective tissue between BIP Capital and the investors and advisory firms who trust us with their capital. Our clients — whether high-net-worth individuals navigating their first alternative investment or seasoned RIAs managing complex multi-vehicle allocations — expect a level of responsiveness and care that matches the quality of our investment platform. This team exists to deliver that. 
 We are relentlessly client-first. That means meeting investors and advisors where they are: answering questions quickly, anticipating friction before it becomes a problem, and treating every interaction as an opportunity to reinforce confidence in BIP Capital. 
 This is not a passive support function. The team operates at the intersection of fund operations, investor relations, and advisor enablement, requiring equal parts technical fluency and interpersonal skills. We move fast, we solve problems, and we hold ourselves to a high standard — because our clients do too.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are seeking a full-time Client Success Analyst to join our team. This is a true entry-level opportunity and an apprenticeship-style role built for someone at the very start of their career who has a genuine interest in finance and private markets. You will work directly with the Senior Analyst and Senior Manager, supporting Level 1 investor inquiries, capital call and close tracking, account maintenance transactions, and reconciliations, and escalating more complex matters as you build your fluency in our platforms and processes.
 You will not be expected to manage investor relationships independently on day one. You will be expected to show up curious, execute well on the tasks in front of you, and learn quickly, taking on real ownership as your knowledge of fund operations and investor relations grows.
 This role offers a unique opportunity to build meaningful relationships with investors and advisors while developing hands-on expertise in fund operations, investor onboarding, and capital transactions. You will operate in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and contribute directly to BIP Capital's ability to deliver a top-tier investor experience.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The role requires a mix of interpersonal and analytical skills. As a Client Success Analyst, you will support the Client Success team across three core areas:
 Capital Calls & Closes 
 • Track capital call and close status for various investment vehicles; conduct investor follow-up and escalate to Senior Analyst or Senior Manager as needed.
• Review subscription documents and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy.
• Perform close reconciliations, flag variances, and work with third parties to resolve discrepancies; escalate to Senior Analyst as needed.
• Support operational coverage during peak capital cycles or team absences.
 Account Maintenance & Investor Inquiries 
 • Serve as the primary contact for Level 1 investor inquiries, resolving issues and routing escalations to the Senior Analyst or Senior Manager.
• Process account maintenance transactions including transfers, distribution instruction updates, and demographic changes.
• Assist with investor documentation requests and ensure accurate maintenance of investor records in internal systems.
 Entity Creation & Operational Support 
 • Support new entity creation in coordination with legal and compliance, including review of subscription packages and PPM documentation.
• Assist with custodian onboarding for new entities and facilitate capital call processing.
• Identify and support process improvements that enhance investor experience and operational efficiency.
• Provide general operational support including supporting investor events, data integrity projects, and other team initiatives.
 Requirements 
 Education and Experience

 OUR PHILOSOPHY 
 We are champions of our investors' goals and stewards of founders' dreams, but more than that, we are ethical, honest partners who serve, educate, and protect our founders and investors. We take on the challenges and complex conversations because we operate out of integrity and genuine care.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic, growth-oriented Associate Product Owner to join our team and contribute to the development of BIP's innovative technology products.  As an Associate Product Owner at BIP, you will work hands-on with our core technology platforms, including our internal CRM and fund management platform, our external investor portal, and our external advisor portal, supporting backlog management, writing user stories and release notes, managing our Jira Service Desk, performing QA, and collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders. jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

 We're looking for a product manager who thinks like a developer advocate and acts like a platform strategist. This role sits at the intersection of systems integration and developer experience and as AI transforms how scientists work, the stakes have never been higher. The world's most innovative life sciences teams are already building agentic R&D workflows on top of Benchling, and they need a platform that can keep up. Your job is to understand what they're building, identify the gaps before they become blockers, and make the case internally for what needs to get built next.

You'll own the developer platform roadmap, serve as the internal voice of the external developer, and ensure that customer and partner learnings shape priorities across the Build org. This is a role for someone who is always six months ahead, anticipating what cutting-edge life sciences teams will need to build next, and making sure Benchling is ready when they get there.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 

 - Own the end-to-end roadmap for Benchling's developer-facing products: REST APIs, MCPs, SDKs, API playground, code examples, and code recipes.

 - Our most sophisticated customers are building agentic R&D workflows on top of Benchling and need primitives that don't exist yet. You'll define what those primitives are, get them built, and make sure developers can actually use them.

 - Our partner ecosystem (Quilt, Calira, Code Ocean, Seqera, and others) needs extensibility that scales beyond one-off integrations. You'll work cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Customer Success to build the platform foundation that makes this possible.

 - Developers who try to build on Benchling today hit walls fast — in our docs, our APIs, and our support. You'll own the developer experience end-to-end and close the gap between what developers expect and what we deliver.

 - We don't have a clear line of sight into how developers are actually using our platform. You'll establish the feedback loops through interviews, support signals, and usage data and make sure those learnings shape roadmap decisions across the Build org.
   


QUALIFICATIONS



REQUIRED:

 - 3-5 years of product management experience, with hands-on ownership of API, SDK, or developer platform products

 - Technical fluency: you can read code, review API specs, and have credible conversations with engineers. You don't need to ship production code, but you need to deeply understand the systems you're building

 - Developer empathy at your core: you obsess over the developer experience and are constantly thinking about how AI-era tooling (MCPs, LLM-friendly APIs, agentic workflows) can supercharge what developers can do with Benchling

 - Familiarity with the modern developer stack — APIs, SDKs, documentation, and developer onboarding; you understand the tradeoffs and know what good looks like

 - Strong communicator: you write crisp requirements and can present clearly to engineers, stakeholders, and customers alike

Nice to Have:

 - Familiarity with the life sciences or enterprise SaaS domain

 - Experience building developer communities, running beta programs, or managing developer relations programs

 - Prior experience at a company with a platform business model or marketplace





HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#BI-Hybrid
#EN-1

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About Atomic
 Atomic is a venture studio and venture capital firm that builds and scales companies from the ground up. We partner with exceptional founders to launch transformative businesses across industries including AI, fintech, healthcare, consumer, enterprise software, and more. We've launched and scaled more than 20 companies including Hims & Hers, Exowatt, Replicant, Found, Golden Child, and Homebound.

 Position Overview
 We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly alongside our founder and Managing Partner, and give him meaningful leverage across everything he touches. The firm moves fast across a large and varied portfolio; this person makes sure the most important things move forward, that nothing critical falls through the cracks, and that the CEO’s time and attention go where they matter most.
 This role is both highly strategic and deeply hands-on. You'll operate as a thought partner and a doer - translating priorities into action, owning follow-through from start to finish, managing the flow of information and communication, and serving as a trusted bridge across the firm, its companies, and outside partners.
 This is also an AI-native role by design, and we expect it to evolve continuously. The best person in this seat instinctively uses AI to take work off their own plate - automating the routine so they can keep moving up to higher-leverage work. The job you start with shouldn't be the job you're doing a year from now.
 The best version of this person becomes genuinely indispensable, earns more responsibility over time, and builds a deep, lasting partnership with the firm and our portfolio.

 Responsibilities
 • Be a key point of leverage for the Founder and Managing Partner across the full range of his work, internal and external - taking things off his plate and extending his reach.

• Identify the few things that matter most and drive them home - taking the firm's most important projects and initiatives to timely, high-quality completion, and owning the outcome rather than just the to-do list.

• Be the forcing function for decisions and action. Surface what needs deciding, put a clear question in front of whoever owns it, and press until it's resolved.

• Own follow-through end to end: capture what needs to happen, run it down across whoever needs to move, and close the loop without being asked or reminded.

• Represent the CEO with internal and external stakeholders - in meetings, on email, and on calls - making sure he walks into everything prepared and walks out with the follow-ups handled.

• Manage the flow of information and communication around the CEO and the firm's executives, synthesizing the firehose into what people need to know and decide.

• Sit in board meetings and stand in for the CEO at portfolio companies he's most involved in to keep the highest priority projects moving forward

• Partner closely with Atomic's executives to keep the whole leadership group aligned and moving in the same direction.

• Be the trusted liaison across the team, the portfolio, and outside partners, and handle the most sensitive, confidential matters with complete discretion.

 Who You Are
 • An exceptional communicator . You write and speak with clarity, concision, and judgment - able to represent the firm to anyone, distill the complicated down to what actually matters.

• Highly organized . You bring structure to an inherently unstructured job - imposing order on the swirl of priorities, communications, and action items so nothing slips and the people around you can move faster.

• Action-oriented . You have a sharp instinct for the few things that matter most at any given moment, and you clear the decks to make them happen and drive them to done.

• Genuinely curious and humble . You ask good questions, listen more than you talk, want to understand before you act, and you're simply a good person to be around.

• Low ego, no drama. You care about the outcome, not the credit. You'll go deep on the work that needs to get done and do whatever the moment calls for without worrying about whether it's technically "your job." No politics, no theatrics, just a steady and straightforward presence people trust.

• High trust and range. We can hand you the most sensitive, consequential things and not think about them again - discreet, reliable, and steady when the stakes and pressure are high. And you move fluidly between a board-level conversation, a go-to-market problem, and an operational fire in the same day, with the instincts of a builder.

• AI-native . You already use modern tools to do the work of a team, and you're relentless about turning them on your own work - automating the routine and continually raising what you're capable of.

 Qualifications
 • A track record of operating at high velocity and high trust near the center of an ambitious organization - as a chief of staff, operator, founder, or in consulting, banking, or investing. We care far more about range, judgment, and drive than about any single pedigree.

• Time as an early or senior contributor at a fast-moving startup or high-growth company, with evidence you drove outcomes.

• Exceptional organization and execution, with the ability to keep a dozen plates spinning and never drop the one that matters.

• Scrappy and resourceful. You build structure where there is none and stay calm when the ground is shifting.

• Genuinely excited to commit to this role and grow alongside the firm.

 We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.
 -----
 Atomic is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law.
 Please review our CCPA policies here.

jobs.title: AI Analyst
jobs.description:
About Array Ventures

 Array Ventures is a pre-seed B2B deeptech fund that invests in technical founders from Day 0 to Series A. With $250M+ AUM across 4 funds and 80+ investments, two-thirds of Array's portfolio companies have gone on to raise from top-tier investors including a16z, Sequoia, Accel, IVP, and Menlo Ventures, and have exited to F500 companies like PayPal, Amazon, and Apple.

 We do not vibe-invest. The team dives into technical stacks, reads research papers, and evaluates the actual defensibility of what founders are building. We back hardcore AI, data, security, and infrastructure companies—the boring-but-beautiful stuff that actually makes the world run.

 Array also runs an in-house AI Lab where the team experiments with frontier tooling and builds internal systems alongside our portfolio. Think: a startup inside a VC. You get real ownership, no red tape, and direct access to Shruti and the broader network from day one.

 Quick facts
 
• $250M+ AUM across 4 funds
• 80+ portfolio companies; 2/3 have raised follow-on rounds from a16z, Sequoia, Accel, and more
• Successful exits to PayPal, Amazon, and Apple
• Processes 200–300 inbound deals per month, evaluated with AI-powered tooling
• Target: 9–10 investments per year, with 2–3 quality founder intros surfaced per week
• Active check size: $250K to $2.5M at inception
• Focus areas: AI infrastructure, Cybersecurity, HealthTech, FinTech, and enterprise SaaS
• Team of 4: flat, fast, and founder-empathetic
 
 Responsibilities
 This is not a coffee-and-spreadsheets analyst role. You are joining a four-person team at a pivotal moment in Array's growth, which means you will have real ownership across sourcing, diligence, and fund operations from week one. Day to day, that looks like:
 
• Source deals from two distinct pools: young builders (recent grads, hackathon participants, alumni networks) and experienced operators leaving AI labs or top companies to go build something
• Attend in-person events, hackathons, and community gatherings in San Francisco to build and maintain a live founder pipeline
• Programmatically build and iterate on internal tools to make sourcing smarter and faster, using the latest AI tooling
• Evaluate inbound and outbound deals with genuine technical depth: read the research papers, interrogate the architecture, pressure-test the market thesis
• Write tight investment memos that capture the technical reality and the business opportunity without losing the nuance
• Support the GP with operational tasks to keep the fund running while the investment team focuses on deals
• Make meaningful intros connecting portfolio companies and founders to investors, customers, and talent
• Contribute to Array AI Labs experiments and internal tooling workflows
 
 Is this you?
 You are still in a technical role, or just left one. You go to hackathons because you want to, not because someone told you to. You have opinions about AI tooling the rest of us have not heard of yet, and you have the GitHub commits to back it up. You think sourcing is a systems problem, and you have already started building the solution.
 
• Young, hungry, and self-directed: you generate urgency from the inside, not the outside
• Technically sharp: you can evaluate a deep tech stack, read a research paper, and spot the gap between what a founder says and what their system actually does
• Connected: you have a real network of builders, recent grads, and founders-in-the-making, not just LinkedIn connections
• Builder mentality: you have shipped something from 0 to 1, and you can prove it
• Comfortable holding many things at once: sourcing, diligence, ops, and community all land on the same plate
• Genuinely excited about enterprise AI—not just the hype, but the infrastructure, the data problems, the security challenges
• Individual contributor mindset: you want to do the work, not manage it
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 
• Software engineer at a high-signal startup such as Decagon, Sierra, Perplexity, or similar frontier AI companies
• CS degree from a top-20 program: MIT, Stanford, CMU, Berkeley, and similar
• Active in the SF AI community: attends hackathons, knows the scene, shows up
• Part of a VC fellowship program such as Khosla Fellows, Kleiner Fellows, Foundation Fellows, Bessemer Fellows, or a16z Fellows
• Angel investing experience or demonstrated VC interest beyond just applying to analyst roles
• Hands-on experience using and building with frontier AI tools, not just describing them
• Strong written communication: you can turn a complex technical idea into a crisp one-pager
• Bonus: active builder presence online (writing, building in public, or contributing to open-source)
 
 What we are NOT looking for
 
• Candidates from Array Ventures portfolio companies
• Candidates from large incumbents: NVIDIA, Apple, Google, Meta, or similar
• Candidates already working in a formal VC role who are not actively building or coding
• Anyone whose interest leans toward Web3, real estate, or consumer social
• Managers looking to manage: this role is an IC position
 
 Interview process
 • Recruiter Screen with HigherPeople
• Hiring Manager Screen with Shruti Gandhi
• Coding Assessment
• Deal Sourcing and Evaluation Case Study
• On-site Interview in San Francisco
 
 Perks
 
• Direct mentorship from GP Shruti Gandhi: fast feedback, no sugarcoating, full investment in your growth
• Front-row seat to 200–300 deals per month across the most interesting AI and deeptech companies being built right now
• Access to Array's network of top VCs, F500 corporate partners, and 80+ portfolio founders
• Real ownership from day one: you are in on every decision, not siloed into a function
• In-person in SF with a tight-knit, high-trust team of 4

jobs.title: Product Designer, Evals & Prompts
jobs.description:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Prompts spec out what Claude does. Evals measure whether it did. The Product Prompt and Eval Design team does both for product design: the system prompt that greets a new user, the tool descriptions that decide whether Claude searches, the instructions that keep a slide deck from tipping into slop, and the evals that test all of it. The point is to keep the model and the product aligned with what users expect, what the product strategy calls for, and what safety requires, on every surface and through every model launch.

 This role is a foundational member of that work on the eval side: building the evals that check the prompts, the harness that runs them, and the tools that let designers do this work themselves. It sits on the Product Prompt and Eval Design team in Product Design, works day to day with the team's surface owners and the engineers in each product team, and pairs per surface with the prompt engineering team at model releases.

 Key responsibilities

• Write and revise the prompts behind Claude's tools, features, and behaviors on a product surface; test the surface, turn findings into prompt fixes, ship them, and confirm the prompt users get is the one intended

• Build the graders that prove a prompt fix and rerun on the next model; turn designers' hand-run rubrics into automated evals, then read transcripts for what the eval missed

• Build visual, low-code eval tools designers can use without an engineer: assemble a comparison set from real transcripts, turn a plain-English rubric into a grader, compare prompt variants across models side by side, and read results in the tool rather than a notebook

• Watch designers use those tools and make them simpler

• Support model releases: test each surface against the new model, write prompt fixes and migrations, and write prompts for features launching with it, so the surface owner's call has numbers behind it

• Stand up and scale the eval harness: build the test environment that exercises our 50 to 100 tools with trustworthy settings, keep evals green across models, and call whether a regression is the harness or the model

• Package what prompting can't fix for training, with the eval attached: graders for crisp behaviors, human-feedback questions and good/bad pairs for fuzzy ones like writing quality

 Minimum qualifications

• Production-quality Python

• Experience building and maintaining evaluation pipelines for LLM products: graders, rubrics, comparison sets, regression suites, and the plumbing that runs them across models

• Experience building internal tools with a real interface for people who do not write code

• Experience standing up test harnesses, sandboxing tool calls, and pinning the settings that make runs comparable

• Experience shipping prompts, or working closely with people who do, and understanding why a prompt that works on one model fails on the next

• Reads transcripts, not only scores

 Preferred qualifications

• Has worked inside a model-launch cycle

• A/B testing experience and the ability to connect offline evals to online outcomes

• Front-end or notebook-to-app experience, and opinions about what makes an eval result legible at a glance

• Has turned product rubrics into training signal: graders, human-feedback questions, or preference pairs

• Cares how Claude behaves for the people using it, not only whether the metric moved

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $305,000 — $385,000 USD 

 Logistics 

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different 

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

• Own adoption, engagement, and satisfaction outcomes at the company level. Set the metrics, instrument them, and be accountable for moving them with clear attribution.

• Prioritize ruthlessly against a demand signal that will always exceed capacity; say no well and explain why.

 Ship, fast and with craft 

• Lead a dedicated engineering team from discovery through launch. Write the specs, make the calls, and keep velocity high without drama or burnout.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic . We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI , bio + healthcare , consumer , crypto , enterprise , fintech , games , and companies building toward American dynamism . a16z has $90B under management across multiple funds. 

 We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Accolade, BigHat Biosciences, Cedar, Devoted Health, EQRx, Freenome, Insitro, Omada Health, and PatientPing. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world. 

 The Role 

 The Bio+Health Business Development team supports and consults portfolio teams on their go-to-market strategy across market development and business development. The Associate will build commercial and strategic partnership opportunities for the portfolio within our network of executives, privately held companies, and federal agencies. Our team’s goal is to support each portfolio company in its pursuit of product-market-fit and scaled commercialization.  

 The BD Associate will be a key member of the Bio+Health Business Development team managing day to day interaction with the portfolio companies.  This team member will manage connections with industry partners, relationships and tracking of interactions, preparation of documents, project management and account management.   

 To join our team, you should be excited to: 

• Assist in managing the Firm's strategic relationships with key corporate partners in Healthcare 

• Create and manage dashboards that deliver key insights on industry developments and trends 

• Assist in the coordination and execution of strategic projects and portfolio support 

• Develop compelling presentation materials that communicate strategy and drive alignment across internal stakeholders, strategic partners, and portfolio companies. 

• Assist in coordinating and maintaining contractual relationships with external corporate partners   

 Minimum Qualifications 

• 3-5 years of corporate partnerships/consulting experience in healthcare  

• Self starter, self motivation, can do attitude and collaborative 

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work cross-functionally across the operational groups 

• Experience includes but is not limited to, partnerships, corp dev roles, M&A role, management consulting, and other healthcare-focused roles where relationship management was key priority 

• Demonstrated ability to multi-task and project manage key relationships 

• Strong Proficiency in Excel/Google suite 

• Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams 

 The anticipated salary range for this role is between $192,000 - $224,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope. 

 This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave. 
 a16z culture  

• We do only first class business and only in a first class way 

• We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business  

• We believe in the future and bet the firm that way 

• We are all different, we recognize that, and we win 

• We celebrate the good times 

• We do it for the team 

• We play to win 

 At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World. 

 Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here to learn about E-Verify. 

 Andreessen Horowitz hereby reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

This role will own key aspects of the event planning process, partnering across teams to bring exceptional experiences to life while ensuring every detail is executed seamlessly. 

 The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. They have excellent attention to detail, sound judgement, strong research skills, and a collaborative mindset. • Own systems management and reporting for production trackers, event plans and event communications

 What we’re looking for: 

• A strong communicator and collaborative partner who thrives in a team environment 

• An entrepreneurial mindset with the adaptability to navigate shifting priorities and embrace new challenges 

• Exceptional taste, sound judgement, and impeccable attention to detail 

• The ability to execute on a high volume of projects and ongoing programs while staying poised under pressure

• A creative thinker who knows how to bring a brand to life across a varied landscape both domestically and internationally

 Minimum Qualifications
