jobs.title: Client Services Associate
jobs.description:
About Alumni Ventures 

 Alumni Ventures is one of the world’s most active venture capital platforms, with $1.4B+ in assets raised and investments in 1,600+ companies. Our network of 850,000+ members and 40+ dedicated investors connects accredited individuals to high-quality venture deals—typically reserved for institutions—through our alumni-driven communities and diversified co-investment strategy. With offices in Boston, New York, Chicago, Menlo Park, Manchester, NH, London and Tokyo we’re rapidly growing and committed to fueling entrepreneurial success while developing the next generation of VC professionals. 

 We believe our best work happens when we’re together. AV operates as a 5-day-a-week, in-office culture because collaboration, mentorship, and shared momentum matter. 

 About This Role 

 As a Client Services Associate at Alumni Ventures, you'll play a vital role in supporting our investor community while gaining hands-on exposure to venture capital, startup investing, investor relations, and fund operations. 

 This role sits at the intersection of customer success, relationship management, investor communications, and financial services. You'll work closely with prospective and existing investors, Managing Partners, Community Managers, and cross-functional teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor engagement activities, and operational processes. 

 You'll help individuals navigate their journey with Alumni Ventures—from initial interest through investment and ongoing engagement—while developing expertise in client service, investor relations, venture capital, and business operations. 

 This is an ideal opportunity for professionals who are eager to learn, take ownership, and grow their careers in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Through hands-on training, mentorship, and direct exposure to senior leadership, you'll build valuable skills in communication, relationship management, project management, operations, and venture investing. 

 While prior venture capital experience is not required, successful candidates are often interested in investing, entrepreneurship, startups, financial markets, or business strategy and are excited to learn about the venture capital ecosystem. 

 What You'll Do 

 Investor & Community Support 

• Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for prospective and existing investors. 

• Respond to investor questions through email, phone, webinars, events, and other communication channels. 

• Provide timely, accurate, and thoughtful support using approved resources and internal playbooks. 

• Help individuals navigate Alumni Ventures' offerings, processes, and community experience. 

 Investor Support and Community Operations 

• Build strong relationships with investors, community members, and internal stakeholders. 

• Deliver a high-touch, service-oriented customer experience across the investor journey. 

• Anticipate needs, identify issues, and help resolve questions with professionalism and empathy. 

• Support investor onboarding and ongoing engagement efforts. 

 Partner Support & Operations 

• Collaborate closely with Managing Partners, Community Managers, and senior leaders. 

• Support fundraising initiatives, fund operations, club programs, and syndication activities. 

• Assist with virtual events, investor meetings, webinar preparation, and follow-up activities. 

• Help ensure smooth execution of key investor engagement and operational processes. 

 Data, Reporting & Process Improvement 

• Track engagement activity, investor interactions, and key business metrics. 

• Help maintain clean and accurate data in HubSpot and other internal systems. 

• Support reporting for Community Managers, Partners, and leadership. 

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, and the overall investor experience. 

 Strategic Projects 

• Participate in special projects and cross-functional initiatives. 

• Support research, process improvements, pilot programs, and team priorities. 

• Take on increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow. 

 Who You Are 

 We're looking for a client-centered, detail-oriented professional who is excited to grow in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

 Required Qualifications 

• 1+ years of experience in customer success, client services, relationship management, account management, hospitality, recruiting, operations, financial services, consulting, or another customer-facing environment. 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills. 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through consistently. 

• Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships and provide thoughtful support to customers, or other stakeholders. 

• Ability to learn and effectively use new systems, tools, and business processes. 

• Interest in learning about investing, venture capital, financial markets, startups, or related business topics. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms. 

• Experience supporting clients, customers, members, investors, advisors, or other external stakeholders. 

• Exposure to financial services, investing, venture capital, wealth management, banking, consulting, or related industries. 

• Experience coordinating projects, events, webinars, or operational workflows. 

 A Note to Candidates 

 We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you'd be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed above. 

 Our Culture & How We Work at AV 
 Regardless of title, this is what great looks like at AV. 

• Put team and stakeholders first. We win together and measure success by the value we create for our investors, founders, and each other. 

• Take extreme ownership and bias toward action. We act like owners, move with urgency, and follow through. 

• Debate rigorously and commit fully. We welcome diverse views, use data and sound judgment, and once aligned, execute as one team. 

• Focus on what matters most. We prioritize impact, simplify where possible, and channel energy where we have a real advantage. 

• Be AI-forward and tech-optimistic. We actively use AI and emerging technologies to work smarter, make better decisions, and amplify human judgment — not replace it. 

• Stay curious and think big.  We are continuous learners, aim high and build for long-term impact. 

 Benefits & Perks 
 We offer a flexible, employee-first benefits program designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits begin shortly after hire and are designed to give you choice and flexibility based on your needs. 

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including employer-funded deductible support and HSA contributions 

• Dental and vision plans with multiple coverage tiers 

• Tax-advantaged accounts including HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits (with monthly employer contribution) 

• 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting 

• Company-paid life and disability insurance , plus optional supplemental coverage 

• Additional support programs including EAP, health advocacy, and wellness resources 

• Flexible, unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave 

• 11 company holidays 

 Compensation 

 Compensation includes base salary plus equity and corporate bonus. 
 Privacy Policy   

 All employment is subject to passing a background check. Alumni Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. Privacy Policy

 Partner Support & Operations

 Strategic Projects

 Who You Are 

 We're looking for a client-centered, detail-oriented professional who is excited to grow in a collaborative, team-oriented environment. 

 Required Qualifications 

• 1+ years of experience in customer success, client services, relationship management, account management, hospitality, recruiting, operations, financial services, consulting, or another customer-facing environment. 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills. 

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through consistently. 

• Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships and provide thoughtful support to customers, or other stakeholders. 

• Ability to learn and effectively use new systems, tools, and business processes.

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms. 

• Experience supporting clients, customers, members, investors, advisors, or other external stakeholders. 

• Exposure to financial services, investing, venture capital, wealth management, banking, consulting, or related industries. 

• Experience coordinating projects, events, webinars, or operational workflows. 

 A Note to Candidates 

 We recognize that talent comes from many backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you'd be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed above. 

 Our Culture & How We Work at AV 
 Regardless of title, this is what great looks like at AV. 

• Put team and stakeholders first. We win together and measure success by the value we create for our investors, founders, and each other. 

• Take extreme ownership and bias toward action. We act like owners, move with urgency, and follow through.

• Stay curious and think big.  We are continuous learners, aim high and build for long-term impact. 

 Benefits & Perks 
 We offer a flexible, employee-first benefits program designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work. Benefits begin shortly after hire and are designed to give you choice and flexibility based on your needs. 

• Comprehensive health coverage with multiple plan options, including employer-funded deductible support and HSA contributions

• Company-paid life and disability insurance , plus optional supplemental coverage 

• Additional support programs including EAP, health advocacy, and wellness resources 

• Flexible, unlimited PTO and generous paid parental leave 

• 11 company holidays 

 Compensation 

 Compensation includes base salary plus equity and corporate bonus.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status. AlleyCorp is hiring an Associate to join our Healthcare investing team, based in New York City. In this role, you'll work directly alongside our healthcare investors across every stage of the investment process, from sourcing and evaluating new opportunities to supporting investments and growing great companies.
 A major focus of the role will be identifying exceptional healthcare founders and developing conviction around those opportunities. You'll spend significant time in the market — meeting founders, clinicians, operators, and other healthcare leaders – to develop relationships and spot emerging trends across the industry. If you're as much at home at a founder dinner and in a 7-tab spreadsheet, this is the right seat for you.
 We’re particularly interested in candidates who have a unique point of view of where healthcare is headed, specifically how AI and technology can increase the healthcare system’s capacity and capabilities.

 • Own top-of-funnel deal sourcing: proactively identifying deals through founder networks, clinical and health-tech communities, events, research, and your own instincts about where the market is moving.

• Build and maintain relationships across the NYC startup and healthcare ecosystem with founders, clinicians, operators, and other investors.
• Work closely with AlleyCorp’s portfolio companies to help accelerate growth and impact.

 • Obsessed with healthcare, tech, entrepreneurship, and the startup ecosystem.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Identity
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

 The Community You Will Join: 

 Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and our business, and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on. 

 The Difference You Will Make: 

 As Product Manager for Identity, you will help set the strategy and drive execution of mission-critical identity verification systems and experiences. Airbnb is special in that it’s a platform that brings people together. You’ll shape how we build trust between guests and hosts on Airbnb and beyond, and build an identity platform that will enable all the different ways we want our guests and hosts to interact on Airbnb now and into the future—and in the process, help create the most trusted community of travelers in the world.  

 A Typical Day:  

• Define and drive the roadmap for Identity on Airbnb — including mission-critical  identity verification technologies and flows, new identity-related features, and extending the value of a verified identity beyond the immediate Airbnb platform. 

• Make prioritization calls that balance multiple competing objectives: trust, guest experience, booking success, and overall marketplace health. 

• Partner with design, engineering, and policy teams to collaboratively drive execution of the roadmap you define. 

• Align cross-functional partners including Account, Trust & Safety, Guest Experience, Host Experience, and Customer Support — on shared goals and roadmap sequencing. 

• Identify and evaluate external partnership opportunities that could extend the reach and value of our identity ecosystem. 

• Design and oversee A/B experiments with rigorous metric design and long-term effect measurement and booking impact. 

• Translate complex technical tradeoffs into clear decisions for engineering teams and concise narratives for leadership 

• Foster an environment where product managers, engineers, designers and other cross-functional team members align on shared goals and collaborate on building the future 

• Stay close to guests and hosts: synthesize user research, marketplace data, and competitive signals to sharpen your intuition and refine strategy 

 Your Expertise: 

• 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years on identity and trust-related topics. 

• Track record of owning strategy and roadmap for technically complex systems — not just managing features, but setting direction and making hard prioritization calls 

• Experience with identity standards being developed around the world and the ability to chart an ambitious long-term path through this evolving space. 

• Ability to earn the respect of engineers and subject matter experts— engaging at a level that builds credibility. 

• Expertise in collecting and using data to perform business analysis and support product strategy decisions. 

• Clear, structured communicator who can distill complex technical tradeoffs for executives and translate strategy into actionable guidance for design and engineering 

• Comfort working in ambiguity and a bias toward innovative solutions rather than incremental onesExperience evaluating external partnerships and an understanding of how partnerships can accelerate strategy. 

• Demonstrated expertise pitching complex ideas to executive teams 

• Demonstrated experience in both inbound (feature definition) and outbound (communication and marketing) aspects of product management. 

 Your Location: 

 Due to the nature of this position, it is strongly preferred that the successful applicant will need to be based on the West Coast of the US to be able to collaborate efficiently with other members of the team in the pacific time zone. Currently, employees can not be located in: Alaska, Indiana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Delaware And Rhode Island. This list is continuously being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list.  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.  

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.  

 We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. 
 How We'll Take Care of You: 

 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.   

 Pay Range
 $200,000 — $240,000 USD

jobs.description:
About Aegis Ventures 

 Aegis Ventures partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. Our platform brings together market-shaping ideas, growth capital, and ambitious individuals to solve major societal problems. With a focus on innovations in healthcare, Aegis has launched four successful portfolio companies in partnership with Northwell Health and recently announced the Digital Consortium to co-develop, invest in, and launch new companies.

 About the Company 

 Avandra Imaging 's mission is to unlock clinical data to overcome previously impossible medical challenges, bringing hope and medical breakthroughs that transform patient lives. Avandra is poised to revolutionize healthcare research and innovation by creating the largest indexed data cloud of medical imaging. This platform will unlock unprecedented access to real-world imaging data, essential for biopharma research, medical device innovation, AI model training, and improved patient care. 

 Leveraging its strategic acquisitions, Avandra aims to aggregate and de-identify vast amounts of imaging data, providing frictionless access to this invaluable resource. With a national footprint of over 5,000 customer integrations and a market share of approximately 70%, this robust infrastructure supports their core business, ensuring continued growth and cash flow to fuel their innovative data cloud platform.

 About the Job 

 As our Product Manager , you will lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Avandra’s image exchange platform. This role is responsible for  evolving our industry-leading physical media solutions while bringing a new generation of digital  image exchange products to market. 

 This is a unique opportunity to build products that sit at the intersection of enterprise imaging and  real-world imaging data. The platform you build will not only help providers securely exchange  medical images, but also create new opportunities for health systems to participate in Avandra’s  imaging data network. 

 The ideal candidate has deep experience in enterprise imaging, understands clinical imaging  workflows, and has successfully brought healthcare software products from concept through  commercial launch.

 What You’ll Do 

 Product Strategy  

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for Avandra’s Enterprise Imaging portfolio.

• Define and prioritize initiatives that expand our digital image exchange capabilities while continuing to strengthen our physical media solutions. 

• Develop products that simplify how imaging moves between providers, patients, and  healthcare organizations. 

• Identify market opportunities and customer needs that differentiate Avandra in a rapidly  evolving imaging ecosystem. 

 Product Development  

• Lead products from concept through launch, working closely with engineering, design,  sales, customer success, and executive leadership. 

• Write clear product requirements and user stories that translate customer problems into actionable engineering work. 

• Balance customer requests, technical constraints, and business priorities when making roadmap decisions. 

• Partner with engineering throughout development to ensure successful delivery and product quality. 

 Customer & Market Engagement  

• Meet regularly with health systems, imaging centers, and strategic partners to understand  workflows and emerging market needs. 

• Gather customer feedback through interviews, product demonstrations, and beta programs. 

• Monitor competitive offerings and industry trends across enterprise imaging and healthcare interoperability. 

• Represent Avandra at customer meetings and industry conferences. 

 Data Network Innovation  

• Develop capabilities that make it easier for healthcare organizations to participate in Avandra’s imaging data network. 

• Work cross-functionally to ensure image exchange products create long-term strategic value across both clinical and data-driven use cases. 

• Partner with internal stakeholders to identify new platform capabilities that benefit providers, researchers, and life sciences organizations. 

 Product Launch  

• Partner with marketing and sales to develop product positioning, messaging, pricing support, and go-to-market plans. 

• Support customer enablement, product documentation, training, and launch readiness.

• Define success metrics and continuously measure product adoption and customer satisfaction. 

 What You’ll Need 

 Required 

• 5+ years of product management experience. 

• Experience building enterprise healthcare software products. 

• Strong understanding of enterprise imaging workflows, including PACS, VNA, DICOM, and  image exchange. 

• Experience leading products from concept through commercial launch. • Ability to translate complex customer workflows into intuitive software solutions. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Experience working closely with engineering teams in Agile development environments. 

• Bachelor’s degree.

 Preferred  

• Experience with healthcare interoperability technologies including DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.

• Experience in cloud-based SaaS healthcare platforms. 

• Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, and compliance requirements.

• Experience working directly with radiology departments, imaging centers, or health  systems. 

 What Success Looks Like in Year One 

• Successfully launch new digital image exchange capabilities that expand Avandra’s product portfolio. 

• Deliver a clear and executable product roadmap that aligns customer needs with company strategy. 

• Increase adoption of Avandra’s image sharing platform across existing and new customers.

• Improve the customer experience across both physical and digital image exchange workflows.

• Deliver platform capabilities that strengthen Avandra’s position as the trusted infrastructure for imaging exchange and imaging data. 

 What We Offer

• Competitive Package: Competitive salary, equity, comprehensive benefits, and hybrid work flexibility.

• Values-Driven Culture: We’re building a team grounded in Avandra’s 5 Core Values that guide how we show up every day:

• WIN with Integrity

• Radical Accountability

• Engage with Empathy

• Patients First

 Aegis Ventures is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer — we recruit, train, compensate and promote our team members based on qualifications. We encourage you to apply regardless of your race, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Associate, Primary
jobs.description:
About the job
 Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”) is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $76 billion* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension & Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025.

Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co-investments. Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000.

The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide.

Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto.

 • As of June 30, 2026. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request.

 Primary Investment Team

 The Primary Investment Team at Adams Street invests in premier buyout and venture capital funds at the time they are being raised. The team has been an active fund investor since 1979 and has established relationships with some of the world’s most sought-after General Partners. Investing with a broad global mandate and across a range of geographies, stages, and subclasses, the Primary Team has consistently delivered strong risk-adjusted returns and liquidity across multiple business and economic cycles.

 Responsibilities

 The Primary Investment Associate will be responsible for supporting activities involving sourcing, analyzing, and monitoring investment opportunities. The Associate will work closely with our US Primary Investments Team, and the role offers a diversified exposure to private equity and venture capital investing. Specifically, the individual will be involved with and responsible for:

 Assist In Evaluation And Monitoring Of Investment Opportunities

 • Meet with General Partner groups to evaluate potential investment opportunities and monitor existing investments.
• Perform quantitative analysis, including portfolio valuation, comparable company analysis, value driver analysis, performance attribution analysis, and others.
• Assist in preparation of investment memorandum.
• Perform industry / sector analysis.
• Assist in legal negotiation and documentation.

 Assist In Projects For The Primary Team

 • Manage deal pipeline and related documentation.
• Develop and maintain proprietary deal and market intelligence.
• Managing client support activities, including but not limited to, coordinating due diligence information gathering for new and existing clients, curating presentation materials, preparing RFPs and other client questionnaires, and responding to other ad hoc client requests as they arise.
• Conduct market research.

 Candidate Requirements

 We seek an individual who is self-disciplined, demonstrates creative thinking and has the following characteristics

 • Graduated from a top-tier undergraduate university. Business/Finance/Accounting background preferred.
• 1-2 years of work experience in a top-tier investment banking, private equity or financial consulting organization is ideal, but not required.
• Good understanding of the private equity and venture capital industry.
• Strong analytical, modeling, organizational, and writing skills.
• A professional presence combined with relationship and communication skills to interact effectively with internal and external parties.
• Self-starter with strong work ethic, who can handle projects from start to finish while negotiating multiple, competing deadlines.

 Please note, this role is intended to be a 2-year position. The role is based in Menlo Park, CA.

We offer a competitive U.S. benefits package designed to support health, financial security, and work-life balance. Highlights include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) with immediate vesting and employer match; profit sharing; flexible spending accounts (FSA); and paid parental leave, including adoption. Employees also receive generous paid time off, commuter benefits, employer-paid short- and long-term disability and life insurance, and access to additional voluntary benefits.

California Pay Transparency Range

$135,000—$145,000 USD Benefits found in job post
 Commuter benefits, Disability insurance, 401(k)

Job Description: 
 Investment Manager, 3M Ventures
 Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World 
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. 
 This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career. 
 The Impact You’ll Make in this Role 
 
 As an Investment Manager in 3M Ventures, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
 • Leading 3M venture investments aligned with areas of strategic interest across 3M’s broad set of businesses
• Managing the entire investment process, as needed, from mapping investment trends, developing investment themes, sourcing and maintaining a pipeline of relevant investment opportunities, conducting due diligence and valuation analysis, to pitching deals to the Ventures Investment Committee, closing deals, and managing portfolio companies and board observer roles post- investment
• Working closely with business and technical leaders to develop collaboration plans that provide value to 3M and partner companies, while forming trusted relationships with senior decision makers that enable effective communication and alignment around critical business decisions related to our projects
• Developing creative and highly tailored deal structures and processes that result in optimal solutions for unique project objectives
 Your Skills and Expertise  
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
 • Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution
• Five (5) years of entrepreneurial, business management, strategy, consulting, investment banking or business development experience in a private, public, government or military environment
• Experience in a deep tech field
 Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
 • MBA, or undergraduate degree in engineering or technical field
• Venture capital (VC) or corporate venture capital (CVC) experience, including strong knowledge of finance and various valuation techniques
• Experience as a board member or board observer for a venture-backed startup
• Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively engage directly with target company senior management
 Work location: San Francisco, CA 
 Travel: May include up to 25% domestic and international based on projects 
 Relocation Assistance: Not authorized 
 Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status). 
 Supporting Your Well-being  
 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

jobs.title: Venture Fellow
jobs.description:
About the Fellowship
 The Venture Capital Fellowship provides practical venture capital experience through deal sourcing, investment diligence, market analysis, and startup evaluation.
 Participants gain exposure to real deals while learning how venture capital firms identify, assess, and support high-growth startups. 1752vc invests up to $100,000 per company through a structured three-month investment program focused on AI, Enterprise Software, Fintech, Frontier Technology, Healthcare, and PropTech.
 Responsibilities
 Fellows will participate in:
 • Deal sourcing
• Startup research and market analysis
• Investment diligence and evaluation
• Founder outreach and relationship management
• Industry trend monitoring and competitive analysis
• VC education
 Ideal Candidates
 This fellowship is designed for:
 • Investment banking, consulting, finance, or strategy professionals
• Venture capital and private equity career aspirants
• MBA candidates and graduate students interested in investing
• Startup founders and operators seeking investing experience
• Emerging fund managers, angels, and family office professionals
 What You'll Learn
 • Venture capital investment processes
• Startup evaluation methodologies
• Deal sourcing and diligence frameworks
• Market sizing and competitive analysis
• Founder assessment and relationship management
• Portfolio support and venture operations
 Program Structure
 • 8 week structured fellowship
• Remote-first participation
• Flexible schedule for qualified professionals
• Exposure to active investment opportunities
• Collaboration investors and operators
 Location
 The fellowship operates virtually, with select optional in-person opportunities in Los Angeles.
 Compensation
 This is not a traditional salaried role. Compensation is available and tied to performance, with the potential for participants to share in the fund's upside.
 Equal Opportunity
 1752vc is committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion across all programs.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
Investment Analyst
 $120K to $180K • San Francisco (On-site) 
 Job type 
Full-time
 Role 
Investments
 Experience 
1–4 years
 Location 
San Francisco, California (On-site)
 About 16VC
 16VC is a venture capital firm investing in the next generation of AI and technology companies.
 We partner with ambitious founders from the earliest stages, providing capital, strategic guidance, and access to our network. We're looking for an Investment Analyst to help identify exceptional founders, evaluate investment opportunities, and support our growing portfolio.
 This is an on-site role based in San Francisco.
 About the role
 As an Investment Analyst, you'll work closely with our investment team to source, evaluate, and support early-stage startups.
 You'll spend your time meeting founders, researching markets, analyzing companies, and helping shape investment decisions. You'll also work with portfolio companies after we invest, helping track progress and identify opportunities for growth.
 If you're curious, analytical, and passionate about startups, AI, and venture capital, we'd love to meet you.
 What you'll do
 
• Source and evaluate early-stage startups

• Meet founders and build relationships across the startup ecosystem

• Conduct market research and identify emerging trends in AI and technology

• Perform due diligence, including business model, market, team, and competitive analysis

• Build financial models, market sizing, and investment analyses

• Prepare investment memos, presentations, and recommendation materials

• Monitor portfolio company performance and key metrics

• Support founders with strategic research and business insights

• Help improve internal investment processes and reporting

 What we're looking for
 You might be a great fit if you:
 
• Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Enjoy researching companies, industries, and markets

• Understand startup business models and venture capital

• Are comfortable working with financial models and data

• Communicate clearly in writing and presentations

• Take ownership and work well in a fast-paced environment

• Have a genuine interest in AI, technology, and entrepreneurship

 Preferred experience
 
• Experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or startups

• Financial modeling and valuation experience

• Market research and competitive analysis

• Excel, Google Sheets, and presentation tools

• Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Affinity or HubSpot

 Nice to have
 
• Experience working at an early-stage startup

• Angel investing or accelerator experience

• Technical background or understanding of AI and software products

• Experience evaluating SaaS or AI businesses

 Why join 16VC
 
• Work directly with founders and investors

• Evaluate cutting-edge AI and technology companies

• Gain exposure to every stage of the investment process

• High ownership and responsibility from day one

• Small team with meaningful impact

• Competitive salary and benefits

• Opportunity to grow with the firm

 Details
 
• Compensation: $120,000 to $180,000 USD base salary, plus bonus and benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience and skills.

• Location: This is a full-time on-site role based in San Francisco, California . Candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, the San Francisco Bay Area.

 We're looking for curious investors.
 We care more about your ability to identify great founders, think critically, and make sound investment decisions than where you've worked. If you're excited about AI, startups, and helping build the next generation of iconic technology companies, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary: 120K - 180K USD a year
